Once upon a time, there was a jolly penguin named Pip. Pip lived in a cold place with lots of ice and snow. He loved to slide on his belly and play with his friends.
One day, Pip saw a big, shiny fish on the ice. He wanted to eat it, but his friend Sam said, "Pip, you should ask if you are permitted to eat that fish. It may belong to someone else." Pip thought about it and said, "You are right, Sam. I should ask first."
Pip found the owner of the fish and asked, "May I please eat your fish?" The owner smiled and said, "Thank you for asking, Pip. You are permitted to eat it." Pip was very happy and shared the fish with his friends.
The moral of the story is to always ask for permission before taking something that isn't yours.

Once upon a time, there was a normal boy named Tim. Tim had a toy bear named Ben. Tim and Ben liked to play together every day. They had lots of fun.
One day, Tim and Ben found a big box. The box had a pretty wrap on it. They were very excited. They opened the box and found a big spoon inside. Tim and Ben looked at each other and smiled.
Tim and Ben took the big spoon to the kitchen. They found a big bowl and started to stir. They stirred and stirred until they made a yummy cake. Tim and Ben were very happy. They shared the cake with their friends and had a great day.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a toy laser. He was very excited. He showed the laser to his mom and dad. They smiled and told him to play with it outside.
Tim went outside with the laser. He pointed it at the ground and it became a big line of light. He laughed and ran around with the laser. His dog, Spot, chased the light too. They played together for a long time.
As the sun went down, Tim and Spot became tired. They went inside the house. Tim showed his mom and dad the fun he had with the laser. They were happy to see him excited. Tim knew he would have more fun with the laser tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a big house. In the house, there was an attic. The attic had a lock. A family lived in the house. They had a little girl named Lily.
One day, Lily found the key to the attic. She wanted to see what was inside. She opened the lock and went in. Inside the attic, she saw an enormous box.
Lily opened the enormous box. Inside the box, she found a lot of toys. She played with the toys all day. When it was time for bed, Lily locked the attic. She was very happy to find the toys.

Once upon a time there was a jolly family. Dad, Mom and the little boy. Every morning they would take a photo together. They would stand in a line outside the house, hug each other and smile. And then Dad would take the photo.
The little boy would be so excited. He would run around and jump up and down, and Dad and Mom would laugh. Then it was time for the photo. Dad, Mom and the little boy stood all together, with their arms around each other.
Then Dad took the photo. The little boy was so happy to be part of the family and having a jolly time outside. He couldn't wait to see the photo.
When the photo arrived, the little boy was so excited. He looked carefully and saw that it was the best family photo ever! Everyone was jolly and happy. They all hugged each other and smiled.
The little boy knew that this photo would be special forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy weapon. It was a big stick. He liked to play with it. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He wanted to bring his stick.
At the park, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue was very organized. She had a box for her toys. Tim showed Sue his stick. "This is my weapon," he said. Sue liked the stick too.
Sue had a toy sword. She showed it to Tim. "This is my weapon," she said. They played together with their weapons. Then, they put them in Sue's box. Tim's mom saw them and said, "You two remind me to always share and have fun." They all smiled and played until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue. Sue liked to play with chalk. She would draw on the ground with her chalk. She drew big and small shapes. Her favorite color was pink.
One day, Sue found a fit frog. The frog was green and could jump very high. Sue wanted to play with the frog. She picked up the frog and put it in her chalk box. The frog was not happy, but Sue did not know.
Sue went home and wanted to wash her hands. She left the chalk box with the frog outside. It started to rain. The rain washed away all of Sue's drawings on the ground. The frog jumped out of the box and went away. Sue was sad because her drawings were gone and the frog left.

One day, a little girl named Sue went for a walk. She loved to walk with her mom and dad. They walked on a busy street with many people. Sue saw a big, red ball and she insisted that she play with it.
As Sue played with the big, red ball, it bounced away from her. It went to a place where she could not see it. She was sad and wanted to find her ball. Her mom and dad said they would help her look for it.
They looked and looked, but they could not find the big, red ball. Then, something unexpected happened. A big, friendly dog came up to Sue with the ball in its mouth! The dog had found the ball for her! Sue was so happy, and now she had a new friend to play with on her walks.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little rabbit named Remy. Remy loved to play in nature and hop around with his friends. One day, Remy saw a big, red apple on the ground. He wanted to gain the apple for himself, but his friend Tommy the squirrel also wanted it.
Remy and Tommy started to fight over the apple. They pushed and pulled, trying to take it from each other. Their friends saw them fighting and felt sad. The fight became bad, and Remy and Tommy stopped being friends.
In the end, Remy and Tommy were both alone and sad. They had gained the apple, but they had lost their friendship. The other animals in the forest learned that fighting over things can lead to bad endings and hurt friendships. The moral of the story is that being kind and sharing is better than fighting and losing friends.

Jim was a 3 year old. One day, he went to the park. He wanted to see if he could number fast. He got out his rod and ran to the playground. He ran so quickly around the playground, he could barely even see the numbers he was counting. He ran so fast that by the time he finished counting he had gone around the playground five times! He had numbered so fast, it was unbelievable! He was proud of himself and proud of his rod he had used. He went home happy after counting so fast.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot wanted to become a guard dog. He wanted to keep his family safe and be loyal to them. Every day, he would watch the big dogs and learn how they guarded the house.
One day, Spot saw a squirrel in the yard. He knew that he had to be a good guard dog and protect his family. He barked and chased the squirrel away. Spot's family was very happy and proud of him.
From that day on, Spot became the loyal guard dog he always wanted to be. He would always keep his family safe and sound. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the library with his mom. He wanted to choose a book to read. There were so many books, he did not know which one to pick. He felt frustrated. His mom said, "Take your time, Tim. You will find a good book."
Tim looked and looked. Then, he saw a big red book on a high shelf. He wanted that book, but he was too small to reach it. He asked his mom for help. She got the book down for him. Tim was very happy and said, "Thank you, mom!"
When Tim opened the book, something unexpected happened. A tiny frog jumped out of the book! The frog said, "Hello, Tim! I was waiting for you to choose this book. Now we can be friends and read together." Tim and the frog read the big red book and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a young person who was very ignorant. Everyone around them thought they were silly. They always struggled to understand simple things.
One day, the young person was walking through the forest, when they suddenly spotted something. It was an old, broken toy.
Even though they were ignorant, they knew they could try to repair it. They thought it would be a great challenge.
So, the young person got to work. They figured out how to fix each piece and put the toy together.
When they finished, they were so proud! The toy was now perfect and able to play.
The young person was no longer seen as ignorant – everyone was in awe at their handywork. That day, the young person had learned a valuable lesson: you can repair anything if you have the courage to try.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Mandy. She was three years old and loved her blouse. It had beautiful flowers on it and she was so happy to wear it.
One day, Mandy asked her mom if she could go to the park. With a smile, her mom said yes. So, Mandy put on her blouse and raced outside.
At the park, Mandy saw a dog playing with another little girl. She wanted to play too, but she was a bit scared. That's when the little girl said, "I believe you can play, just be brave."
Mandy was grateful to her, so she took a deep breath, smiled and ran off to join the fun. She played with the dog and laughed with the other little girl and it was one of the most fun days she ever had.
She believes that she can do anything when she is brave and grateful. That's why Mandy loves her blouse. It reminds her of the day she was brave and the fun she had that day.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly dog named Spot. Spot loved to wrap himself in a big, soft blanket. The blanket had a symbol on it, a big red heart. Spot's best friend was a little girl named Lily.
One day, Spot and Lily were playing in the park. Spot said, "Lily, look at my blanket with the big red heart! I can wrap myself in it." Lily laughed and said, "Spot, you are so silly and smelly. But I love you and your blanket."
As the sun went down, Spot and Lily went home. They were tired from playing all day. Spot wrapped himself in his smelly blanket with the big red heart. Lily gave him a big hug and said, "Goodnight, Spot. I love you and your smelly blanket." And they both slept happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She had a pretty dress. She loved to wear her dress every day.
One sunny day, Jane went outside to play. She saw a nosy cat. The cat was very curious and wanted to know what Jane was doing. Jane liked the cat and wanted to play with it.
Jane decided to dress the nosy cat in a little dress too. They played together all day, and the cat loved wearing its new dress. They had so much fun, and they became best friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a red truck and a blue truck. They were best friends and always played together. But one day, they had a quarrel. The red truck was hurt and the blue truck was sad.
As they were sad and not talking to each other, a big wind came. The wind was so strong that it blew the red truck and the blue truck away from each other. The red truck and the blue truck were scared and missed each other a lot.
Then, something unexpected happened. The big wind blew them back together! The red truck and the blue truck were so happy to see each other again. They said sorry for the quarrel and promised to be best friends forever. And from that day on, they played together and never fought again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Suzie. She was three years old and loved exploring the world. One day, Suzie spotted an olive while walking around in the garden. She looked so surprised and asked her mum, “Mummy, what’s that?”
Mummy smiled and said, “That’s an olive, Suzie. It’s amazing and yummy!” Suzie looked curious and asked, “Can I try it?”
Mummy nodded and suggested, “Why don’t you give it a taste and see if you like it?”
Suzie tried the olive and it tasted amazing! She smiled and said, “This is delicious!” Mummy replied, “I’m glad you like it, Suzie. Olives can be really tasty and special!”
This was an amazing discovery for Suzie. From then on, she always looked forward to tasting more olives in her garden.

Tom and Jen are friends. They like to play in the farm. They see many animals in the farm. They see cows, pigs, chickens, and horses. They like to pet them and feed them.
One day, they see a new animal in the farm. It has horns, a beard, and a long tail. It makes a loud sound. "Baa! Baa!" It says. Tom and Jen do not know what it is.
"Let's guess what it is!" Tom says. "Is it a dog?" He asks.
"No, it is not a dog. Dogs do not have horns." Jen says.
"Is it a cat?" Jen asks.
"No, it is not a cat. Cats do not have beards." Tom says.
They think hard. They look at the animal. It is eating grass. It is jumping on a rock. It is dull. It is not colorful.
"I know what it is!" Tom says. "It is a goat!"
"Yes, you are right! It is a goat!" Jen says. "How did you guess?"
"I saw a picture of a goat in a book. It looks like this." Tom says. He shows Jen the book.
"Wow, you are smart!" Jen says. "Can we pet the goat?"
"Sure, let's pet the goat!" Tom says.
They go to the goat. They touch its fur. It is soft. They give it some grass. It is happy. It says "Baa! Baa!" again.
Tom and Jen smile. They like the goat. They make a new friend in the farm.

One day, a helpful boy named Tom went to the store with his mom. Tom saw a film about a funny dog who liked to joke. He asked his mom, "Can we buy the film, please?" His mom said, "Yes, we can watch it together."
When they got home, Tom and his mom put the film in the TV. They sat down to watch the funny dog joke and play. But something unexpected happened! The film was not about the funny dog, but a cat who liked to dance.
Tom was sad at first, but then he saw how funny the dancing cat was. He laughed and said, "This is a good surprise, Mom!" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, it is. Sometimes surprises can be fun too." So they watched the dancing cat and had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a wild dog named Spot. He loved to run and play all day long. One day, while Spot was running, he found a big tire in the grass. Spot thought it was a fun toy to play with.
Spot rolled the tire around the yard. He pushed it with his nose and chased it. As the tire rolled, it hit a big rock. The rock made the tire reveal a secret hiding place under the grass. Spot was very excited to find this new place.
Spot crawled into the secret hiding place and found a soft, warm bed. He was very tired from playing with the tire all day. Spot lay down in the bed and fell asleep. He had the best sleep ever and dreamed of more wild adventures with his new tire.

Once upon a time, in a jolly little town, there lived a kind man named Tom. Tom had a big sack. He would raise the sack up and down to show his friends.
One day, Tom met a little girl named Sue. Sue asked, "What's in the sack?" Tom said, "I don't know. Let's look inside." They opened the sack and found a big, red ball.
They played with the ball all day. But then, something unexpected happened. The ball started to grow bigger and bigger! Tom and Sue were scared, but then they saw a friendly cat.
The cat said, "Don't be scared. I put magic on the ball so we can all play together!" Tom, Sue, and the cat played with the big ball and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to imagine things in her head. One day, she thought of a beautiful place called a valley. In the valley, there were lots of trees, flowers, and a big blue sky.
Lily saw a big, graceful bird in the valley. The bird was very pretty and could fly high in the sky. It had long wings and a long tail. Lily wanted to be friends with the bird, so she waved her hand and said, "Hi!"
The bird saw Lily and flew down to her. They played together all day in the valley. They ran through the grass and picked flowers. When it was time to go home, Lily said goodbye to the bird. She knew she would always remember the valley and her graceful bird friend.

One day, a big, heavy yacht was on the water. It was a sunny day. The yacht went fast. The people on the yacht were happy.
A little girl named Lily was on the yacht. She said, "Mommy, I feel the wind on my face!" Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, Lily, it feels nice, doesn't it?"
Soon, it was time to go home. The yacht went back to the land. Lily and her mommy said goodbye to the yacht. They walked home, holding hands, feeling happy.

Lily and Sam like to play at the park. They run, jump, swing and climb. But their favorite thing is to slide. They slide down the big, yellow slide. They slide fast and laugh.
One day, they see a big truck at the park. It has a big hose and a big tank. A man is holding the hose. He says he is putting gas in the tank. Lily and Sam are curious. They want to see the gas.
They go near the truck and look at the hose. They see bubbles and hear a hiss. The man says, "Be careful, kids. This gas is not for playing. It is for heating the park. It can be hot and dangerous."
Lily and Sam are scared. They do not want to touch the gas. They run away from the truck. They go back to the slide. They slide down the big, yellow slide. They slide fast and laugh. They are happy and safe. They say, "We like to slide. We do not like gas."

Once upon a time, there was a thoughtful girl named Lily. She loved to play with her magic toy wand. Every day, she would stand in her room and wave her wand, pretending to do magic.
One day, Lily stood in the park with her magic wand. She saw a little bird with a hurt wing. The bird could not fly. Lily had an idea. She waved her magic wand and said, "Magic wand, please help the bird fly again."
The next day, Lily went back to the park. She saw the little bird again. This time, the bird could fly! The bird was so happy. Lily knew that her magic wand was very special.
Lily learned that being thoughtful and kind can make magic happen. She promised to always help others with her magic wand. And from that day on, Lily and her magic wand made the world a better place.

Henry and his mom were walking to the university. Henry was very excited because it was his first time. On the way there, they passed lots of people and shops. Mom didn't like how nosy the people were. Henry saw a big building in the distance and he asked his mom what it was. She said, "That's the university". Henry was so excited.
When they got closer, they saw a line of people waiting to go in. Henry asked his mom why they were there. Mom said they wanted to learn new things. This made Henry eager to go even more.
Suddenly, they noticed a nosy woman in the line. She was staring at them and it made Henry very nervous. Mom noticed too and she quickly pulled Henry away. As they hurried down the street, the nosy woman yelled out, "Where do you think you're going?" Mom simply ignored her and kept walking. Henry was scared but he knew his mom was there to protect him.
Finally, they reached the university safely. Once inside, Henry was mesmerized by all the interesting things to see and do. He forgot about the nosy woman and just enjoyed his first day. He would never forget it!

Mummy and Daddy had a new plan.
They said to their little daughter, "Let's decorate your folder!"
The little girl said "Yes!" She liked decorating things.
Mummy gave her some nice glittery stars and Daddy gave her some colour markers.
The little girl was so happy. She started decorating her folder.
But then something bad happened. The colour markers ran out of ink and the glittery stars fell on the carpet.
The little girl felt sad. She said, "Oh no! My folder won't be nice now".
Mummy and Daddy tried their best but they couldn't help.
The little girl stayed sad and the folder remained undecorated.

Once there was a girl called Lily. She found a rose in her garden and decided to pick it. She thought it was so pretty.
One day, when Lily went back to the garden, the rose was gone! She looked all around for it but couldn't find it. She started to weep.
Her mum came out and saw Lily crying. She said, "What's wrong my little one?"
Lily said, "Someone took my rose. It's so bad."
Mum gave Lily a hug and said, "We'll find you a new one. Don't weep anymore."
So, the next day, they went to the garden centre and picked out a special rose. Lily was very happy.
She planted the rose in the garden and took very good care of it. She never had to weep again. The end.

Once upon a time, in a big, green forest, there was a helpful dog named Spot. Spot loved to help his friends. One day, while walking in the forest, Spot could hear a sad sound. He knew someone needed help, so he followed the sound.
He found a little bird, who was crying. The bird said, "I lost my bone, and I am very sad." Spot wanted to help the bird find the bone. They looked under trees, in the grass, and behind rocks. Finally, they found the bone near a big tree.
The bird was so happy and thanked Spot for being helpful. They played together and became best friends. From that day on, Spot and the bird always helped each other and had lots of fun in the big, green forest.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. Tim loved to play near the pond. He liked to watch the ducks and splash in the water. Tim also liked to make wishes. He would close his eyes, make a wish, and then toss a small stone into the water.
One sunny day, Tim was playing near the pond. He found a big, wet rock. Tim thought it was perfect for making a big wish. He closed his eyes, made his biggest wish ever, and threw the rock into the water. The rock made a big splash!
But then, something unexpected happened. A big fish jumped out of the water and caught the rock in its mouth! The fish looked at Tim and said, "Thank you for the rock, Tim. I will make your wish come true." Tim was so surprised! He never thought a fish could talk or make wishes come true. From that day on, Tim and the fish became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He liked to play hockey with his friends. They had lots of fun playing together. But Tim was a little selfish. He always wanted the ball for himself and did not like to share.
One day, Tim played a joke on his friends. He hid the hockey ball so no one could find it. His friends looked and looked, but they could not find the ball. They were sad and asked Tim if he knew where the ball was.
Tim laughed and showed them the ball. But his friends did not think his joke was funny. They were very upset with Tim. They did not want to play hockey with him anymore. Tim was sad and all alone. He learned that being selfish and playing jokes can make you lose your friends.

Frankie was walking around the park when he suddenly heard a bouncing sound. He looked around and saw a violin bouncing across the grass. It was being held by a careless young girl who was chasing after it.
Frankie ran over and asked, “What’s that? It’s bouncing so much.”
The girl smiled. “It’s a violin. I’m playing a game to catch it before it stops bouncing. Would you like to join me?”
Frankie couldn’t believe his luck. He smiled and said, “Yes! Let’s play!”
They ran after the violin, bouncing and laughing. As it tumbled over the grass, they tried their best to catch it before it stopped. In just a few minutes, Frankie had learned how to play the bouncing game.
The violin eventually stopped bouncing and Frankie held it in his hands. He looked at the violin proudly and smiled.
The girl laughed. “You did really well for your first try! I’m glad I found you to help me play this game.”
Frankie was happy to have found such a fun game. He decided that he was going to play the bouncing violin game every day.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the store with her mom. She had her small purse with her. Inside the purse, she had her favorite toy, a little red car. Lily was very happy to go shopping with her mom.
Lily saw a big, tall man with an impressive hat. He looked sad. Lily wanted to support him, so she said, "Hi, why are you sad?" The man looked down at Lily and said, "I lost my special coin. It is very important to me."
Lily thought for a moment, then she had an idea. She opened her purse and took out her little red car. She gave it to the man and said, "Here, you can have my car. It will make you happy." The man smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are very kind."
Just then, Lily's mom found the man's special coin on the floor. She gave it to him, and he was so happy! The man gave Lily back her little red car and said, "Thank you for your help. Now we both have something special."
Lily and her mom went home, feeling happy and proud. They knew that helping others and being kind is the best thing to do.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little boy named Tim and his old cat, Mr. Whiskers. Tim loved to play with Mr. Whiskers in the garden. They liked to jump and run all day long.
One sunny day, while they were playing, Tim saw something shiny under a big tree. He went closer to look and found a pretty crystal. Tim picked it up and showed it to Mr. Whiskers. "Look, Mr. Whiskers! I found a crystal!" said Tim.
Mr. Whiskers looked at the crystal and meowed. Tim decided to keep the crystal and show it to his friends. They played with the crystal and had lots of fun. From that day on, Tim and Mr. Whiskers always played with the crystal in the garden. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a cat and a dog were playing in the park. The cat had a soft, red ball with a zip. The dog said, "Can I play with your ball, please?" The cat said, "Yes, but don't leave it in the mud."
They played with the ball, and the dog was very careful not to leave it in the mud. Suddenly, a big wind came and took the ball away. The cat and the dog were very sad. They looked for the ball, but they could not find it.
Then, they saw a big bird in the sky. The bird had the soft, red ball in its mouth! The bird said, "I found your ball. I will give it back if you play with me too." The cat and the dog were happy, and they all played together. The big wind was a good surprise because they made a new friend.

Once upon a time, a small girl named Sophie was playing in the park when she saw something special. It was a tank; a big, hard, metal tank. Sophie was amazed.
She ran over to the tank and said to it, “Hello!” But the tank did not answer.
Then Sophie had an idea. She asked her Mom, “Can we raise a small, soft animal in the tank, please?”
Mom looked surprised but answered, “Yes, we can try. Let’s see what kind of animal we can find.”
Sophie and Mom went to the pet shop and bought a small, soft bunny rabbit. They put the rabbit in the tank and watched as he hopped around and explored.
Sophie was so happy and felt very lucky to have such a precious pet. The tank was the perfect place for the bunny rabbit to live. The little girl and the rabbit were best friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a nice lady called Sally. Sally liked to bake. She would bake cakes, cookies, and pies. One day, Sally decided to bake something special. She gathered all her blocks and started to build a tower.
But Sally was weak, and the tower fell down. Sally was sad, but she still had one block left. She used it to make a cupcake! She took the cupcake to her friends and they all cheered.
The cupcake was big, and sweet, and delicious. Everyone was happy. They ate all the cupcake, and made a game of building towers out of the blocks.
The game was so much fun, and everyone felt strong. The towers were big and beautiful, just like Sally's. Sally was proud of the towers she and her friends had built.
Sally smiled, feeling happy and strong. Her friends were happy too, and they all thanked her for baking the special cupcake.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a doll named Daisy. Daisy was feeling uncomfortable one day. Lucy was very sad and didn't know what to do.
Lucy asked her mom, "Mom, Daisy is uncomfortable. Can you help?" Her mom gave Lucy a small pill. "Give this to Daisy, and she will feel better," her mom said. Lucy was happy and went to Daisy.
Lucy gave the pill to Daisy, but something unexpected happened. Daisy began to talk! "Thank you, Lucy, for helping me. I was worried that I would never feel better," Daisy said. Lucy was surprised, but she was happy that Daisy was feeling better. They both played and had fun, and Lucy never had to worry about Daisy being uncomfortable again.

One day, a cool cat named Tom went to the sand by the sea. He wanted to play and have fun. Tom saw his friend, a dog named Max. Max was a cool dog too. They liked to play together.
Tom said to Max, "Let's send a letter in a bottle to find new friends." Max liked the idea. They found a bottle and wrote a note. "Hi, we are Tom and Max. We want to be your friends. Please send a letter back to us."
They put the note in the bottle and sent it into the sea. They waited and waited for a new friend to find it. One day, they saw a big fish with the bottle in its mouth. The big fish looked at them and smiled. Tom and Max were very happy.
But the big fish was not a nice fish. It wanted to eat Tom and Max. The big fish opened its mouth wide and tried to eat them. Tom and Max were very scared. They ran away as fast as they could, but the big fish was too fast.
In the end, the big fish ate Tom and Max. They should have been more careful when making new friends. The sea can be a dangerous place.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a unique cat named Cocoa. Cocoa had a best friend, a little girl named Lily. They played together every day.
One day, Cocoa wanted to play with a ball. She asked Lily, "Please, can we play with the ball?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, Cocoa. Let's play!" They had a lot of fun playing with the ball in the yard.
As they played, a bird flew down and watched them. The bird wanted to be friends with Cocoa and Lily too. The bird said, "Please, can I play with you?" Cocoa and Lily were happy to have a new friend. They all played together, and had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue. Sue had a pretty blouse. It was her favorite. Her friend, Ann, liked the blouse too. Ann was jealous. She wanted a pretty blouse like Sue's.
One day, Sue and Ann played a game. They would take turns spinning around. When it was Ann's turn, she said, "I wish I had a pretty blouse like you." Sue smiled and said, "Maybe you will get one soon."
The next day, Sue's mom had a surprise for both girls. She had bought Ann a pretty blouse just like Sue's. Ann was so happy. She thanked Sue's mom and said, "Now we both have pretty blouses!" Sue was glad her friend was happy. They played together, wearing their pretty blouses, and took turns spinning around.

Once upon a time, there was a pink cat. The cat loved to watch TV. One day, the cat saw a fun show on the TV. The show was about a big dog who could print pictures.
The pink cat wanted to print pictures too. So, the cat asked a friend, a little bird, to help. The bird found a small box that could print. The cat and the bird were very happy.
Together, the pink cat and the little bird printed many pictures. They printed pictures of the big dog from the TV show. They showed their friends the pictures and everyone liked them. The pink cat and the little bird had lots of fun printing pictures and watching TV together.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red bird named Bob. Bob had a useful gem that he liked a lot. The gem was very pretty and shiny. Bob kept the gem in a little box in his nest.
One day, Bob had to leave his nest to find food. He was very hungry. He flew far away to look for food. While he was gone, a sneaky cat came to the nest. The cat saw the little box with the gem inside.
The cat took the gem and ran away. When Bob came back, he saw that his gem was gone. He looked everywhere for the gem, but he could not find it. Bob was very sad that his gem was gone. He learned that he should not leave his useful gem alone in the nest.

One day, a little bird was sitting on a branch. The bird was very sad because it was a boring day. The bird wanted to meet a new friend to play with. It looked around, but there were no other birds or animals to play with.
Then, the little bird saw a big tree with a lot of branches. It flew to the big tree and saw a funny looking bug. The bug was green and had many legs. The bird said, "Hi, I want to meet you!" The bug said, "Hi, I am a caterpillar. I like to eat leaves and play on the branches."
The bird and the caterpillar played together all day. They had lots of fun on the branches. Then, something unexpected happened. The caterpillar started to change. It spun a cocoon around itself. The bird was very surprised and did not know what to do. It waited and waited.
After some days, the cocoon broke open, and out came a beautiful butterfly! The bird and the butterfly were very happy to see each other again. They played together every day, and they were never bored again. The bird learned that even a boring day can turn into a fun day with a new friend.

Once there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was three years old. He had a big closet in his bedroom.
One day, Tim opened his closet to get something and he heard a strange noise coming from inside. Tim was curious and he stepped closer. Suddenly, he heard a voice whispering from the closet. It said "Come closer".
Tim was a bit scared but he was also very curious. He stepped closer and closer. Then he saw something really disgusting inside the closet. It was a giant bug!
The giant bug smiled at Tim and whispered "Dont be scared, I won't do anything bad. I just wanted to say hello!".
Tim smiled back and said hello. Then he gently picked up the bug and put it outside. He closed the closet door and never heard the bug whispering again.

Once upon a time, there was a furry dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his blanket. He would run, jump, and bow with his blanket all day long. Spot's friends liked to watch him play and have fun.
One day, Spot's friends wanted to play a game with him. They hid his blanket in a big tree. Spot looked and looked, but he could not find his blanket. He was very sad.
But then, Spot's friends had an idea. They all worked together to bow down the tree. The tree bent, and the blanket fell down. Spot was so happy to have his blanket back. He thanked his friends and they all played together with the blanket.

Anna and Ben were at the beach with their mom and dad. They liked to play in the sand and look for shells. They saw a big wave coming and ran to the water. "Splash!" They laughed as the water wet their feet.
But the water was very cold. Anna and Ben started to shiver. They ran back to the sand and wrapped themselves in their towels. "Brrr!" They said. "We are cold!"
Mom and dad came to them and gave them hugs. "You are brave to go in the water," mom said. "But the tide is too high and the water is too cold today. Let's go to the ice cream shop and get something warm to drink."
Anna and Ben nodded. They liked ice cream and hot chocolate. They followed mom and dad to the car. They saw the sun shining on the water. It looked lovely. They smiled and said, "We had fun at the beach!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl name Sarah. She woke up early one morning but it was not like any other morning. She felt a strange feeling in the air, it was uncomfortable and strange.
The air felt cold and clammy and Sarah could see out of her window a grey cloud in the sky, it was a tornado. Sarah was scared, she had never seen a tornado before and it looked very strange and uncomfortable.
Just then, Sarah heard a knock at the door. She jumped out of bed and went to answer it. It was her grandma, she had come to take her away from the tornado. “Come with me Sarah” said grandma. Sarah nodded and quickly ran out of the house with her grandma.
She felt safe with her grandma and she was very glad that grandma was there to take her away from the uncomfortable feeling in the air. “Let’s go Sarah,” said grandma. Sarah smiled and held her grandma’s hand.

Once upon a time, there was a man. This man was jealous of his friend's big toy car. One day, the man went to the store to buy a toy car just like his friend's. He was very happy.
The man played with his new toy car every day. He raced it around his house and even took it to the park. He was not jealous anymore. He loved his toy car so much.
But one day, something unexpected happened. The man found a magic wand in his toy car. He waved the wand, and suddenly his toy car became a real, big car! The man was so surprised and happy. In the end, he shared his big car with his friend, and they both had fun playing together.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play in the kitchen. They found a big bottle of sauce on the shelf and wanted to taste it. They opened the bottle and poured some sauce on their fingers. They licked their fingers and made a face. The sauce was terrible! It was hot and spicy and made their mouths hurt.
They wanted to get rid of the sauce, so they looked for a place to hide it. They saw a big pot on the stove and thought it was empty. They poured the sauce into the pot and put the bottle back on the shelf. They ran away to their room and drank some water.
But the pot was not empty. It had soup that Mom was making for dinner. Mom did not know that Ben and Lily had put sauce in the pot. She stirred the pot and smelled the soup. She thought it smelled strange, but she did not check. She poured the soup into bowls and called Ben and Lily to the table.
Ben and Lily came to the table and saw the soup. They felt scared. They knew they had done something bad. They did not want to eat the soup. They did not want Mom to eat the soup. They did not know what to do.
Mom took a spoonful of soup and put it in her mouth. She spit it out and coughed. The soup was terrible! It was hot and spicy and made her mouth hurt. She looked at the pot and saw the sauce. She looked at Ben and Lily and saw their guilty faces. She realized what had happened.
She was angry and sad. She asked Ben and Lily why they had done that. Ben and Lily started to cry. They said they were sorry. They said they did not mean to ruin the soup. They said they were curious about the sauce. They said they loved Mom and did not want to hurt her.
Mom felt sorry for Ben and Lily. She saw that they were sorry. She saw that they were curious. She saw that they loved her. She decided to forgive them. She hugged them and said it was okay. She said she loved them too. She said they should not play with sauce again. She said they should always tell her the truth.
She threw away the soup and made some sandwiches for dinner. She gave Ben and Lily some milk and cookies. They ate and smiled. They were happy that Mom forgave them. They learned their lesson. They never played with sauce again.

Once upon a time, there was a furry cat named Kitty. Kitty liked to explore and examine things. One day, Kitty found a tool in the garden.
Kitty said, "What is this tool?" She looked at it with her big eyes. The tool was shiny and new. Kitty wanted to play with it.
Kitty took the tool to her friend, Doggy. Doggy was big and friendly. Doggy said, "This is a tool to dig holes." Kitty and Doggy played with the tool in the garden. They had lots of fun digging holes together. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a clever little fox named Fifi. Fifi was very good at finding food and playing with her friends. One day, Fifi met a wise old owl named Ollie. Ollie could do a special thing called a spell. The spell could make things happen, like making flowers grow or rain fall.
Fifi wanted to learn the spell too. She asked Ollie to teach her how to do it. Ollie said, "If you want to learn the spell, you must trust me." Fifi nodded and said, "I trust you, Ollie." So, Ollie taught Fifi the spell. Fifi practiced and practiced until she could do the spell very well.
One day, Fifi's friend, a little squirrel named Squeaky, was very sad because his tree had no more nuts. Fifi wanted to help Squeaky, so she used her clever spell to make the tree have lots of nuts again. Squeaky was so happy and thankful. Fifi was glad that she trusted Ollie and learned the spell. From that day on, Fifi used her clever spell to help all her friends in the forest.

Lily and Sam went to the big store with Mom. They liked to look at the toys and books, but Mom said they could not buy anything. Lily and Sam were sad, but they did not cry.
Mom put some food and clothes in the cart. She pushed the cart to the line. Lily and Sam saw a big candy bar on a shelf. They wanted the candy bar very much. They asked Mom if they could have it.
"No, you can't have the candy bar," Mom said. "It is too much sugar and we have enough snacks at home."
Lily and Sam did not listen to Mom. They were stubborn. They grabbed the candy bar and tried to put it in the cart. Mom saw them and took the candy bar away. She put it back on the shelf.
Lily and Sam were angry. They did not want to give up the candy bar. They tried to resist Mom. They kicked and screamed and pulled Mom's hair. They made a lot of noise. Everyone in the store looked at them.
Mom was very upset. She was tired and embarrassed. She did not know what to do. She decided to leave the store. She took Lily and Sam out of the cart and carried them to the car. She did not buy anything.
Lily and Sam did not get the candy bar. They did not get any toys or books either. They made Mom sad and angry. They had a bad day.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived many animals. They all loved to go on safari. One day, a kind elephant found a big box of food. The food was available for all animals. The elephant was very happy.
The kind elephant wanted to spread the food to all his friends. He called the lion, the zebra, the giraffe, and the monkey. They all came to eat the food together. They were very happy to share the food with each other.
After the safari, the animals learned that it was good to share with others. They promised to help each other and share what they had. From that day on, the animals in the forest were always kind and shared with each other. The moral value of the story is to always share with others.

Tim and Kim are twins. They love to play in the park. They love to swing high and slide fast. They also love to chew gum. They always have gum in their pockets.
One day, they go to the park with Mom. Mom says, "Be careful with your gum. Don't swallow it or stick it on anything." Tim and Kim nod and say, "OK, Mom." They run to the swings and start to swing high. They chew their gum and laugh.
But then, Tim sees a big bird in the sky. He points and says, "Look, Kim, a big bird!" He opens his mouth wide. His gum falls out of his mouth. It flies in the air. It lands on the bird's wing. The bird squawks and flies away.
Kim sees what happens and says, "Oh no, Tim, your gum!" She tries to help him, but she forgets to hold on to the swing. She falls off the swing. She lands on the ground. Her gum falls out of her mouth too. It sticks to her hair.
Mom hears the noise and runs to them. She sees Tim and Kim with no gum and sad faces. She hugs them and says, "Don't worry, my loves. It's OK. It's just gum. We can get more gum later. But first, let's go home and clean up." She takes them to the car and drives home.
Tim and Kim learn a lesson. They still love to play in the park. They still love to swing high and slide fast. But they don't love to chew gum anymore. They say, "No, thank you" when Mom offers them gum. They say, "We don't want gum. We want hugs." Mom smiles and hugs them. She says, "I love you, my loves. You are smart and sweet." Tim and Kim smile and hug her back. They say, "We love you too, Mom. You are the best."

Once upon a time there was an old bald man who had a telephone. Every morning the man would lay on his bed and look around his room. He would wiggle his toes in his bed and think about the day. One afternoon, the man picked up the telephone and saw that there was a call for him. The man was so excited that he quickly layed the phone down and started jumping around his room. He was so happy that he wanted to call everyone he knew and tell them the news!
The man found a chair and layed it over to the telephone. He climbed up and picked up the phone again. He told the person on the other end of the line that he was so excited and they talked and talked. Soon, the man was saying goodbye and layed the phone back in its place.
The man jumped down from the chair and layed down on his bed again. He was so happy and couldn't wait to tell everyone his news. He later received a lot of congratulations and even a gift from his friends. That old bald man was truly a very lucky man!

One day, a little girl named Sue went to the park with her mom. Sue saw a swing and wanted to play on it. She was a bit scared, but her mom was there to encourage her. "You can do it, Sue!" her mom said.
Sue got on the swing and started to swing back and forth. She felt happy and brave. She saw a boy named Tim who wanted to swing too. "Hi, Tim! Do you want to swing with me?" Sue asked.
Tim was honest and said, "I am scared." Sue wanted to help. She told him, "It's okay, my mom helped me. I can help you too." So, Sue and Tim played on the swings together, and they both had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, in a lovely little town, there was a kind woman who loved to cook. She had a big pot and a big spoon. She used the pot and spoon to make tasty food for her friends.
One day, the sun was shining bright and warm. The woman wanted to cook something special for her friends. She thought and thought, and then she had an idea. She would cook a big meal outside, under the sun. She knew the sun would help make the food taste even better.
The woman invited all her friends to come and eat. They sat outside, under the lovely sun, and enjoyed the food she cooked. Everyone was happy and full. They all said, "Thank you!" to the woman for the yummy meal. The sun smiled down on them, and they had a great day.

Once there was a boy called Jack. Jack was very small and he only had 3 years. He had a friend called Linda. They were always playing together and they were very happy.
One day, Jack and Linda were in the garden. They were playing with a needle. Suddenly, the needle got separated from them. Linda started crying. Jack was so calm!
"Don't worry Linda", said Jack. "I can help find the needle."
So Jack and Linda started looking for the needle. Linda looked high, and Jack looked low. They looked and looked until they found the needle. Jack was so happy!
"See Linda, I told you we would find the needle. We are the best needle-finders ever!", said Jack with a smile.
Linda was very happy and she laughed and hugged Jack. They were so happy to be together again.

Once upon a time, there was a wide field with lots of carrots. A bunny named Bob lived in the field. Bob loved to eat carrots all day long.
One sunny day, Bob saw a girl named Sue. Sue was waving at him. Bob hopped over to Sue, and she gave him a big, orange carrot. Bob was very happy.
Sue and Bob played together in the wide field. They waved to the other animals and shared more carrots. They became best friends and had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, in a big garden, there was a pretty orange flower. The orange flower was very happy. It liked to dance and play with the other flowers in the garden. They all enjoyed the warm sun and the cool rain.
One day, a little girl named Sue came to the garden. She saw the orange flower and said, "Hello, pretty flower! You are so orange and bright. I like you." The orange flower was happy to hear that. It enjoyed being friends with Sue.
Sue came to the garden every day to play with the orange flower. They laughed and sang songs together. The orange flower and Sue were the best of friends. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a big toy network with lots of cars and trains. She loved to play with her toys every day. Mia had a friend named Tom. Tom was deaf, so they used their hands to talk. They liked to play together and have fun.
One sunny day, Mia and Tom were playing with the toy network. They decided to spread the cars and trains all over the room. They made the cars go fast and the trains go slow. Mia said, "Look, Tom! The cars are going all over!" Tom smiled and nodded. He used his hands to say, "Yes, it's fun to watch them go!"
As they played, they noticed a big mess of cars and trains on the floor. They knew they had to clean up. Mia and Tom worked together to put the cars and trains back on the toy network. "We did a great job," Mia said. Tom used his hands to say, "Yes, we did!" They were happy they could play and clean up together.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old house. Every day, it would watch the world around it, never missing a thing. One day, the house saw something very special. It saw two children, a boy and a girl, running around and playing.
The house watched as every day, the two children ran around, laughing and playing together, always near each other. They were so happy! The house wondered to itself whether these two children were special to each other, and each time, it was sure that the answer was yes.
One day, something special happened. A wind blew, and the boy ran to the girl and kissed her on the cheek. To the house, it was clear: this was the start of something special.
But the house also saw trouble. Suddenly, the girl started to move away from the boy, and the house saw the sadness in his face.
The wise old house wanted to help. It used the wind, and whispered messages to the two children. Then, something wonderful happened.
The boy and girl both heard the house's message, and ran to each other. They hugged tightly and kissed once more. The house was so happy, because it had helped the two children find their way back to each other.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big box of toys. He liked to sort his toys into groups. He had a group of cars, a group of balls, and a group of blocks.
One day, Tim found a thick arrow in the box. He did not know where the arrow came from. He looked at the arrow and thought it was very cool. He wanted to find more arrows to play with.
Tim asked his mom if she knew where the arrow came from. She said it was from a game they played at a party. Tim was happy to know about the arrow. He put the thick arrow with his other toys and sorted them again. Now, he had a new group of arrows to play with.

Once upon a time there was a cheerful little rabbit who wanted to go on an adventure. He hopped through the forest until he saw an old, dark tunnel. He stopped and looked inside.
"Where does this tunnel go?" he asked.
He listened to the trees and the wind. Then, a voice replied from deep within the tunnel.
"It goes to a magical place. Come on in, follow me!"
The rabbit was very excited and hopped into the tunnel. He followed the voice deep into the darkness until suddenly he saw a twinkling, beautiful lights. He hopped out of the tunnel and found himself in a beautiful, magical world.
He explored the world and it was even more cheerful than he had imagined. He saw beautiful flowers, colorful birds and friendly animals. Everywhere he looked, he could see something new and wonderful.
The little rabbit had the best adventure ever and he never forgot the wonderful place he discovered in the tunnel.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty bear. The bear was big and strong. He lived in a forest with many trees. One day, the bear met a small rabbit. The rabbit was very scared of the bear.
The bear wanted to be friends with the rabbit. He tried to think of a way to make the rabbit happy. The bear thought a hug would be nice. But the rabbit did not want a hug. The rabbit wanted to run away from the bear.
The bear felt sad and tried to hug the rabbit again. But the rabbit was too fast. The rabbit ran away and did not come back. The bear was very sad and stayed alone in the forest.

Once upon a time, a boy named Tim went to the market with his mom. Tim was very glad because he loved to see all the colorful fruits and vegetables. He liked to help his mom pick the best ones.
At the market, Tim saw a big, red apple. He wanted to grab it for his mom. But then, he saw another boy grab the apple first. Tim felt sad. He wanted to grab the apple for his mom, but the other boy had it now.
Tim's mom saw him looking sad and asked, "What's wrong, Tim?" Tim said, "That boy grabbed the apple I wanted for you." Tim's mom smiled and said, "It's okay. We can find another apple. It's good to share and let others have what they want too."
Tim understood the moral of sharing and felt better. He and his mom found another big, red apple, and they were both glad. From that day on, Tim always remembered to share and be kind to others.

One day, a boy named Tim was hungry. He went to the kitchen and saw a big pot of soup. The soup was hot and smelled good. Tim wanted to eat the soup, but his hands were filthy from playing outside. His mom said, "Tim, you must wash your hands before you eat the soup!"
Tim went to the bathroom to wash his hands. As he washed, he saw a small bug on the wall. The bug would blink its tiny eyes. Tim thought it was funny and wanted to show his mom. He carefully put the bug in a cup and ran back to the kitchen.
"Look, Mom! I found a bug that blinks!" Tim said. His mom looked at the bug and laughed. "That's not a bug, Tim. It's a toy I got for you!" She took the toy out of the cup and showed him how it worked. Tim was surprised, but he liked his new toy. Now, with clean hands, Tim and his mom enjoyed the hot soup together.

Sara likes to play with her toys. She has many toys in her room. She has dolls, cars, blocks, and books. She likes to make stories with her toys. She is happy.
One day, Sara finds a pepper in the kitchen. It is red and shiny. She thinks it is a toy. She takes it to her room. She wants to make a story with the pepper. She thinks the pepper is a hat for her doll. She tries to fit the pepper on the doll's head. It does not fit. She tries harder. She pushes the pepper on the doll's head. The pepper breaks. It is empty inside. It has seeds and juice. The juice goes on the doll's face. The doll looks sad.
Sara is surprised. She does not know what the pepper is. She thinks it is a bad toy. She does not like the pepper. She throws the pepper away. She wants to clean the doll's face. She takes a cloth. She rubs the doll's face. The cloth is wet. The juice is spicy. The juice goes on Sara's hand. Sara feels a pain. She cries. She runs to her mom. She shows her hand. She tells her mom about the pepper. Her mom is angry. She scolds Sara. She tells her not to play with food. She tells her to go to her room. She puts some cream on Sara's hand. She gives her a hug. She is sorry.
Sara is sad. She goes to her room. She looks at her doll. The doll still looks sad. The doll has a stain on her face. The stain does not go away. Sara tries to wash the stain. It does not work. She cries more. She hugs the doll. She says she is sorry. She wishes she did not play with the pepper. She wishes she had a good toy. She wishes she had a happy story. She is not happy. The end.

Once upon a time, in a big brown house, there lived a little girl named Lily. Lily had a big brown teddy bear named Mr. Bear. She loved to hold Mr. Bear close to her body when she was scared or sad. Mr. Bear was her best friend.
One day, Lily saw a small brown dog outside her house. The dog was all alone and looked very sad. Lily wanted to help the dog, so she went outside and held the dog close to her body, just like she did with Mr. Bear. The dog felt happy and safe in Lily's arms.
As Lily held the dog, she learned that being kind and caring for others made her feel good too. She realized that just like Mr. Bear helped her feel better, she could help others feel better too. The moral of the story is that when we are kind and help others, it makes us feel good inside.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a huge tree. Near the tree, there was a little hedge. A tiny bird lived in the hedge. One day, the bird wanted to visit her friend, the big bear.
The bird flew to the bear's house and said, "Hi, bear! I want to visit you." The bear was happy to see the bird. They played and talked all day. The bird told the bear about her home near the huge tree and the little hedge.
At the end of the day, the bear said, "Thank you for visiting me, little bird. I learned that you don't have to be big to be a good friend." The bird smiled and flew back to her home in the little hedge. And they both lived happily ever after.
The moral of the story is that size doesn't matter when it comes to being a good friend.

One day, a girl named Amy went on a vacation with her family. They went to a fine beach with soft, warm sand. Amy was very happy to play in the water and make sand castles with her brother, Tom.
Amy's mom said, "Amy, it's time to rest. Let's read a book together under the big umbrella." Amy liked to read with her mom. They sat down and read a book about a funny cat. The cat wore a big hat and liked to dance in the rain.
After they read the book, Amy's dad came over. He said, "How was the book, Amy?" Amy smiled and said, "It was fun! The cat was silly!" Her dad laughed and said, "That's great! Now let's all play in the water together." They all had a wonderful time on their fine vacation at the beach.

Once upon a time, in a little town, there was a sweet girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her big backyard. One sunny day, she found a small door in the ground. Lily was very curious about what was underground.
Lily decided to turn the handle and open the door. She climbed down the stairs and found a room full of candies and toys. It was like a magic underground playroom. Lily was so happy and excited to play with everything.
After some time, Lily's mom called her to come back home. Lily said goodbye to the underground playroom and closed the door. She promised to visit the sweet place again soon. Lily could not wait to tell her friends about the magical underground world she had found.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a foolish boy named Tim. Tim always wanted to go on a big journey. One day, Tim decided to accept a journey to find a big, shiny treasure.
Tim walked and walked for many days. He met a wise old man on his journey. The old man told him, "Be careful, Tim. The journey is long and hard." But Tim did not listen. He thought he knew better.
In the end, Tim learned that the wise old man was right. The journey was very hard, and he needed help. Tim went back to the old man and said, "I am sorry. I was foolish. Will you help me?" The old man smiled and said, "Yes, Tim. We will find the treasure together." And they did.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had an uncle who he loved very much. His uncle was big and strong. Tim liked to play with his uncle every day.
One day, Tim and his uncle went to the park. They saw a delicate butterfly on a flower. The butterfly was pretty and had many colors. Tim wanted to save the butterfly, so he asked his uncle for help.
His uncle was careful and picked up the butterfly. They saved the butterfly and let it fly away. Tim was happy, and his uncle was proud. They went home and had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Fin. Fin lived in the big ocean. He was a restless fish, always swimming around and playing with his friends.
One day, Fin met a new friend named Bubbles. Bubbles was a tiny crab. Fin asked Bubbles, "Do you want to hang out with me and play?" Bubbles said, "Yes, I would love to play with you, Fin!"
Fin and Bubbles swam and played all day long. They splashed in the ocean and had lots of fun. They were very happy to be friends. And from that day on, Fin was not restless anymore because he had a new friend to hang out with.

Tom and Sam were friends who liked to play with kites. They had a jolly time flying their kites in the park. They made their kites go up and down and left and right in the sky.
One day, they saw a big kite that was red and blue and had a long tail. It was the most beautiful kite they had ever seen. They wanted to have it for themselves.
"Who has that kite?" Tom asked.
"I don't know. Maybe we can ask him to share it with us," Sam said.
They ran to the boy who had the big kite. He was older and taller than them. He looked mean and angry.
"Hello, we like your kite. Can we play with it too?" Tom asked politely.
The boy looked at them and laughed. He said, "No, you can't. This is my kite and I don't share it with anyone. Go away, you little pests."
He pulled his kite hard and made it fly higher. Tom and Sam felt sad and hurt. They wanted to have some fun with the big kite.
They decided to wait until the boy was not looking and then grab his kite. They thought he was not fair and kind. They hid behind a tree and watched the boy.
The boy was busy flying his kite and did not see them. He made his kite do tricks and loops in the air. He was very proud of his kite.
Tom and Sam saw their chance and ran to the boy. They tried to take his kite from him. They pulled and tugged on the string.
The boy saw them and got very angry. He shouted, "Hey, stop that! Leave my kite alone!"
He pushed them away and made them fall to the ground. He said, "You are bad and rude. You don't know how to bow and say please. You don't deserve to play with my kite."
He took his kite and ran away. He left Tom and Sam on the ground. They were hurt and sad. They cried and wished they had their own kites. They learned a hard lesson that day. They should not try to take things that are not theirs. They should be polite and respectful to others. They should be happy with what they have.

One day, a boy saw a big taxi on the road. The taxi was rare because it was very big and very red. The boy wanted to ride in the taxi, but he had to be fast because the taxi was going away.
The boy ran and ran to catch the taxi. He did not want to miss it. He got close to the taxi, but then something unexpected happened. A big dog came out of nowhere and started to play with the boy. The boy forgot about the taxi for a little bit because the dog was so fun to play with.
When the boy looked back, the rare taxi was gone. He missed it because he was playing with the dog. The boy was very sad that he did not get to ride in the big red taxi. He went home and told his mom about the taxi and the dog. His mom hugged him and said, "Maybe you will see the rare taxi again someday." But the boy knew that the taxi was gone for good and he would never get to ride in it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She loved to help her mommy. One day, her mommy said, “Will you help me make squash?” The little girl smiled and said, “Yes!”
So the little girl and her mommy went to the kitchen. The mommy showed the little girl how to make the squash. The little girl washed the squash and chopped it into small pieces.
Next, the mommy and the little girl put the squash into a pot with some water. They put it on the stove to make it nice and hot. The little girl stirred the squash while the mommy watched. The cooking squash smelled yummy!
Finally, the squash was done cooking. The little girl and her mommy put the squash on a plate. Then they added some butter and salt. The squash looked and smelled yummy and safe.
The little girl and her mommy ate the squash together. It was delicious. The little girl was so proud that she could help make it with her mommy.

Once upon a time, there was a gifted dog named Yoga. Yoga could do many fun things that other dogs could not do. He could jump very high and run very fast. All the people in the town loved Yoga.
One day, Yoga was playing with his ball in the park. He was having so much fun that he did not see a big hole in the ground. Yoga ran and jumped, but he missed the ball and fell into the hole. Yoga was sad and scared.
A little boy saw Yoga in the hole and tried to help him. The boy got a long stick and put it in the hole for Yoga to grab. But something unexpected happened. The stick broke, and the boy fell into the hole too. Now, Yoga and the boy were both stuck in the hole, and they could not get out.

Once upon a time, in a pretty garden, there lived a little bee. The bee loved to fly around and visit all the pretty flowers. Every day, the bee would buzz and play with his friends, the butterflies and the ladybugs.
One day, the little bee had a dream. In the dream, the bee saw a big, pretty flower. The flower told the bee, "If you share your honey with your friends, you will be very happy." The bee woke up and thought about the dream.
The next day, the bee went to the big, pretty flower from his dream. He made some honey and shared it with his friends, the butterflies and the ladybugs. They all loved the honey and thanked the little bee. The bee felt very happy, just like in his dream. The moral of the story is: sharing with your friends makes you happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Bob. Bob loved to splash in the water at the beach. One sunny day, Bob went to the beach with his friend, Sam.
As they played, Sam said, "Bob, you have big muscles!" Bob laughed and said, "Thank you, Sam! I like to splash in the water with my strong arms."
They splashed and splashed all day long. Bob and Sam had lots of fun at the beach. They went home tired and happy from their day of splashing in the water.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw a fine, big tree. Tim loved to play near the tree. He told his mom about it. His mom said, "Be careful and don't go too far."
Tim went to the tree again. He saw a cat. The cat was stuck in the tree. Tim wanted to help the cat. He started to climb the tree. The cat was happy to see Tim. But Tim did not mention this to his mom.
As Tim climbed higher, he felt scared. He looked down and saw his mom. She was looking for him. Tim tried to call for help, but his voice was too small. Then, the branch broke. Tim fell down from the tree. The cat jumped to another branch and was fine. But Tim was hurt, and his mom was sad.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play dress-up. Lily has a soft pink dress and a bow for her hair. Ben has a blue shirt and a hat. They pretend to be a princess and a knight.
One day, they find a big box in the playroom. It has a tag that says "For Lily and Ben". They open the box and see many new things. There are shoes, gloves, capes, crowns, and more. Lily and Ben are very happy.
"Look, Ben, this is for you!" Lily says. She holds up a shiny sword and a shield. "You can be a brave knight and protect the castle."
"Wow, thank you, Lily!" Ben says. He takes the sword and the shield and puts them on. "And this is for you!" He shows Lily a necklace and a ring. "You can be a beautiful princess and rule the kingdom."
"Thank you, Ben!" Lily says. She puts on the necklace and the ring and smiles. "We look so nice. Let's play!"
They run to the castle, which is a big tent. They have fun playing pretend. They make up stories and act them out. They laugh and sing and dance.
They are very grateful for the big box. They wonder who gave it to them. They see a card on the box. It says "From Grandma and Grandpa. We love you and we are proud of you. Accept these gifts and have fun."
Lily and Ben hug the card. They say "Thank you, Grandma and Grandpa. We love you too. We accept your gifts and we are very happy." They put the card in the tent. They continue to play dress-up. They are the best friends.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a small, harmless bunny named Tim. Tim had a friend, a big bear named Ben. They played together every day. Tim trusted Ben, and they were very happy.
One day, Tim saw a big cut on Ben's paw. "Oh no, Ben! You have a cut! What happened?" Tim asked. Ben said, "I stepped on a sharp rock, and it hurt my paw." Tim wanted to help his friend, so he thought of a plan.
Tim went to find soft leaves and a long vine. He put the leaves on Ben's cut and tied them with the vine. Ben smiled and said, "Thank you, Tim. I trust you, and you helped me feel better." They played together again, and Tim knew that trust was important in a friendship.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to his friend's house to play. They were so excited to have fun together. They ran around the house and played with toys. Tim saw a big, tall furniture that he wanted to climb. His friend said, "Be careful, Tim!"
Tim did not listen. He started to climb the furniture. When he was at the top, he tried to twist around to look at his friend. But he lost his balance and fell down. Tim felt terrible pain in his arm.
Tim's friend called their moms. They took Tim to the doctor. The doctor said, "You should listen to your friends and be careful when you play." Tim learned that it is important to be safe and listen to others.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy bear he loved very much. One day, Tim and his bear went to play outside. It was a dark and cloudy day.
While they were playing, Tim fell down and hurt his knee. "Ouch!" he cried. His bear said, "Don't worry, Tim. I will help you." The bear found a bandage and put it on Tim's knee. The bandage made Tim feel better.
Then, a big bug came near them. Tim was scared of the bug. The bear told Tim, "I will make the bug go away." The bear gave the bug a little slap, and the bug flew away. Tim and his bear went back to playing and had a great day.

Once upon a time, a little girl called Ginny was walking in the park. She saw a big bird in the sky and thought it was very pretty. She watched it as it flew away. Suddenly, Ginny noticed a homeless man sitting nearby. He was very sad and did not have any food. Ginny thought for a moment and said to the man: "Want some pizza?". The homeless man looked up, surprised and happy. He nodded yes.
Ginny ran home and brought the man a pizza. The man thanked her, but said a harsh word and shook his head. Ginny was very surprised and asked why he had said such a harsh thing. The homeless man said: "We must be kind to each other and not use harsh words, even when we are desperate for help".
Ginny nodded and thanked the man for the lesson. She promised to always be kind to others and to observe how lucky she was to have a home and food.
Every time Ginny saw the homeless man, she brought him a pizza, so he would never be hungry again. She had learned the lesson that sometimes it pays to be kind, even to strangers.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He saw a harmless bug on the ground and watched it blink. Tim thought it was funny and wanted to show his mom.
"Mom, look at the bug!" Tim said with a big smile. His mom looked down and saw the bug too. "It's harmless, Tim. You can touch it if you want," she said. Tim gently touched the bug, and it blinked again.
Tim saw a big rope hanging from a tree. He wanted to play with it. "Mom, can I play with the rope?" he asked. "Yes, but be careful," his mom said. Tim took the rope and swung back and forth. He had so much fun.
The bug followed Tim and climbed on the rope too. Tim and the bug played together all day. When it was time to go home, Tim said goodbye to the bug and the rope. "Bye, bug! Bye, rope!" he said. Tim and his mom walked home, and he told her all about his fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a witch who lived in a small house. She was not a mean witch, but she liked to play tricks on people. One day, she saw a little girl named Lucy walking near her house. The witch thought it would be fun to play a trick on Lucy.
The witch put a big rock in the middle of the road. Lucy saw the rock and said, "Oh no! I need to be careful." She tried to walk around the rock, but it was too big. So, she asked the witch for help. The witch said, "I will help you, but first, you must say 'please stop playing tricks on me.'"
Lucy looked at the witch and said, "Please stop playing tricks on me." The witch smiled and made the rock disappear with her magic. Lucy said, "Thank you, witch!" From that day on, the witch stopped playing tricks on people and became friends with Lucy. They played together and had lots of fun.

Once there was a little girl who wanted to buy something from the vendor. But she didn't have enough money. The vendor was very kind and thoughtful and decided to lift her up on his shoulders so she could pick something she liked.
The little girl was so excited that she shouted with happiness. She chose something and then thanked the vendor.
The vendor was so happy to see the little girl with a smile on her face that he decided not to take her money. He said, "I'll take your heartful thank you instead".
The little girl was very grateful and thanked the vendor before running off. The little girl learnt a lesson that day - that giving could be more rewarding than taking.

One day, there was a little girl named Emma. She was three years old and she was very curious. She asked her mum if she could explore the garden.
Mum replied, "Yes, Emma. You can explore the garden, if you want to."
So, Emma went outside and started exploring. She was amazed to see a maze that seemed to have grown in the garden overnight. It was very big! She was a bit scared but she was excited too.
Emma said to her mum, "Mum, I see a maze. I want to explore it!"
So, Mum said, "Okay, Emma. But stay close, okay? It could be dangerous."
Emma was a bit scared but she walked inside the maze anyway. But she quickly noticed that some of the walls were too high and she couldn't climb them. She was getting a bit weak and she thought she might get stuck in the maze.
But then, she noticed that there was a door on one of the walls. She walked to the door and opened it to find that she was back in the garden. She had solved the maze!
Mum smiled and said, "Well done, Emma! You were very brave and clever to find your way out of the maze."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He did not like to eat broccoli. One day, his mom gave him a plate of broccoli for dinner. Tim looked at the broccoli and made a face.
"Why do I have to eat broccoli?" Tim questioned his mom. His mom said, "Broccoli is good for you. It makes you strong and healthy."
Tim was persistent. He asked again, "But I don't like it. Can I have something else?" His mom said, "No, you need to eat your broccoli."
Tim took a small bite of the broccoli. It was not as bad as he thought. He ate all the broccoli on his plate. His mom was happy, and Tim felt strong and healthy. From that day on, Tim liked to eat broccoli.

One day, a little bee named Buzz felt a strong urge to fly far away from his home. He wanted to see the big world outside. He knew it was foolish to go alone, but he didn't listen to his mom and dad.
Buzz flew far and far, and he saw new things. He saw big trees, pretty flowers, and fast birds. But then, he got lost. He didn't know the way back home. Buzz felt scared and sad.
Buzz met a kind ladybug who wanted to help him. The ladybug told Buzz, "Don't be foolish. You need to be safe and stay close to your home." The ladybug showed Buzz the way back to his family. Buzz learned his lesson and promised to listen to his mom and dad.

Once upon a time, there was a big building called a university. People went there to learn many things. But some people thought it was boring. They did not like to sit and listen to the teachers talk all day.
One day, a little boy named Tim went to the university with his mom. She had to do some work there. Tim brought his toy car to play with. He played with his car all around the big building. He saw a big box with a cloth that said "Do not cover." Tim was curious and wanted to see what was under the cloth.
Tim pulled the cloth and covered his car with it. Suddenly, the cloth started to move and shake! It was not a boring cloth, but a magic one! The toy car grew bigger and bigger until it was the size of a real car. Tim and his mom were very surprised. They had a fun ride in the magic car around the university. From that day on, Tim thought the university was not boring at all.

Timmy and his mom were playing outside in the snow. He had a big container of clay and some stale cookies.
"Mom, look at how icy the snow is! Can I make snow angels?" said Timmy excitedly.
"That sounds like fun. But let's part the clay first, so it's ready to make into something after," said his mom.
Timmy grabbed his shovel and began to part the clay into small, round pieces. He was so focused that he hadn't noticed how icy the snow had become.
Suddenly, he felt something slick under his feet. He looked down and saw that he had slipped and fallen on the icy snow.
"Oh no! Are you ok, Timmy?" His mom asked, running over to him.
"Yes, I'm ok. I just got a little slippery," he said, laughing.
His mom helped him up and brushed off the snow, then the two of them started to make snow angels together.
The clay would have to wait.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to play in the park. She saw a big, enthusiastic dog. The dog's name was Max. Max had a magic ball that could talk.
Max said, "Hi Lucy! Do you want to play with me and my magic ball?" Lucy was very happy and said, "Yes, Max! I want to play with you and your magic ball!"
Lucy and Max started to run and play with the magic ball. The magic ball could change colors when they threw it. Lucy threw the ball and it turned red. Max threw the ball and it turned blue.
They played and ran all day in the park. Lucy and Max were very tired, but they were happy. They had so much fun playing with the magic ball. Lucy said, "Max, I had a great time! Let's play again soon!" Max agreed and they both went home to rest.

One day, two friends wanted to go on a wild adventure. They needed a battery to power their car. But they realized the car doors were locked and they didn't have the key!
The friends searched everywhere but they couldn't find the key. Suddenly, the little friend found a key lying near a tree. It was the key to their car!
They put the battery into the car and drove away. They drove for a long time, going through wild forests and mountains. They saw lots of animals along the way and had lots of fun.
Finally, the two friends arrived home safe and sound. As soon as they got inside, they remembered to lock the car doors so it wouldn't get stolen.
The end.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play outside when the weather is good. But today, the weather is bad. It is raining and windy. Anna and Ben are sad.
"Can we play inside?" Anna asks her mom.
"Yes, you can. But you have to be careful. Do not make a mess," her mom says.
Anna and Ben go to Anna's room. They see a big box. It is locked. They wonder what is inside.
"Maybe it is a toy. Or a book. Or a cake," Ben says.
"Let's find out. Where is the key?" Anna says.
They look around. They see a small key on the shelf. Anna reaches for it. She takes it and puts it in the lock. She turns it. The box unlocks.
They open the box. They see a lot of clothes. They are clean and colorful. They are Anna's mom's clothes.
"Wow, these are pretty. Can we try them on?" Ben says.
"Okay, but we have to be quiet. And we have to put them back," Anna says.
They take out the clothes. They put them on. They pretend to be grown-ups. They have fun.
But then, they hear a knock on the door. It is Anna's mom.
"Anna, Ben, what are you doing?" she says.
She sees the clothes. They are on the floor. They are dirty and wrinkled.
"Oh, no. These are my clothes. You made a mess. You have to clean it up," she says.
