Anna and Ben are sorry. They say sorry to Anna's mom. They take off the clothes. They put them back in the box. They lock the box. They help Anna's mom to wash and iron the clothes.
They learn a lesson. They do not unlock things that are not theirs. They do not make a mess. They respect other people's things. They are good friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk with his dog, Max. They went to the park to play. Tim liked to see the big trees and the pretty flowers. Max liked to run and jump.
In the park, Tim saw a hidden look under a bush. He went closer to see what it was. It was a little box! Tim opened the box and found a toy car inside. He was very happy.
Tim and Max played with the toy car in the park all day. They had lots of fun together. When it was time to go home, Tim put the toy car in his pocket. They walked back home, excited to show their new toy to mom and dad.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big smile on his face every day. It was easy for him to be happy. He loved to play with his toy car and his dog, Spot. One day, Tim and Spot went to the park to play.
At the park, Tim and Spot saw a big box. They went to look at it. The box had a big smiley face on it. Tim and Spot were very curious. They wanted to see what was inside the box. Tim opened the box, and something unexpected happened.
Out of the box came a big, happy cat! The cat had a big smile on its face, just like the face on the box. Tim and Spot were surprised, but they liked the cat. Now, Tim, Spot, and the cat played together at the park every day. They all had big smiles on their faces, and it was easy for them to be happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a soft bunny named Bobo. Bobo loved to play outside in the sun. One day, it rained a lot, and a big rainbow appeared in the sky. Bobo was so happy to see the pretty colors.
Bobo had a friend named Timmy, the turtle. Timmy was slow, but he was very smart. Bobo said to Timmy, "Look at the rainbow! Can we keep it?" Timmy thought for a moment and said, "We cannot keep the rainbow, but I have an idea."
Timmy took Bobo to his house. He had a special thing called a printer. Timmy said, "We can print a picture of the rainbow to keep in our room." Bobo was so excited! They found a nice picture of a rainbow on the computer and printed it out.
Bobo and Timmy put the rainbow picture on their wall. Now, they could look at the pretty rainbow every day, even when it was not raining. They were very happy and played together all the time.

One day, a red cat named Tom found a red rag. Tom liked the red rag very much. He played with it all day. He would run with the rag in his mouth and hide it under the big tree.
Tom's friend, a dog named Max, saw Tom playing with the red rag. Max wanted to play too. He said, "Tom, can I play with the red rag too?" Tom said, "Yes, Max, we can play together!"
Tom and Max played with the red rag all day. They would run and chase each other, trying to get the red rag. They had so much fun. When the sun went down, they were very tired but happy. They knew they had a great day playing with the red rag.

Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there lived a little wolf. This wolf was very useful to his friends. He loved to help them in any way he could. One day, the little wolf saw a big tree with a red ball stuck in it. He knew his friend, the squirrel, loved red balls.
The little wolf had an idea. He saw a long stick on the ground. He thought that if he could wave the stick, he could get the red ball down. He picked up the stick and tried to reach the ball. But the stick was not long enough. The little wolf did not give up.
The next day, the little wolf found an even longer stick. He was very excited. He went back to the big tree and waved the long stick. This time, it worked! The red ball fell down. The squirrel was so happy to have his red ball back. The little wolf felt proud to be useful to his friend. And they played with the red ball all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a big bull. The bull was very honest. He lived on a farm with many friends. The bull had a best friend named Duck.
One day, Duck was very worry. Duck lost her toy. She said, "Bull, I can't find my toy. Can you help me?" The honest bull said, "Yes, Duck. I will help you find your toy."
Bull and Duck looked all around the farm. They asked all their friends to help. At last, they found the toy under a big tree. Duck was very happy. She said, "Thank you, Bull. You are a good friend." They played together all day and never worry again.

Tom was a little boy who liked to play with his toy dragon. He named his dragon Sparky, because he had red scales and could breathe fire. Tom and Sparky had many adventures together in the garden, the park and the bedroom.
One night, Tom was getting ready for bed. He brushed his teeth, put on his pajamas and hugged his mom and dad. He took Sparky with him to his bed and snuggled under the covers. He told Sparky a story about how they flew to a castle and saved a princess from a mean ogre.
"Did you like the story, Sparky?" Tom asked his toy dragon.
"Yes, Tom, I liked it very much. You are very brave and smart," Sparky said in a low voice. Tom did not know that Sparky was a real dragon who could talk, but only when no one else was around.
"Thank you, Sparky. You are my best friend," Tom said. He yawned and closed his eyes. He was very sleepy.
"Good night, Tom. Sweet dreams," Sparky said. He yawned too and curled up next to Tom. He was very hungry, but he did not want to scare Tom or his parents. He decided to wait until morning, when he could sneak out and find some food. He hoped there would be some cookies or cake in the kitchen. He liked cookies and cake very much. He closed his eyes and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat pastry. One day, she saw a pastry shop far away. "I want to go there!" she said to her mom.
Her mom took her hand and they walked to the distant pastry shop. When they got there, Lily saw a big pastry. "I want that one!" she shouted. Her mom smiled and bought it for her.
Lily shared her pastry with her friend, Tom. They both enjoyed it and laughed. "This is the best pastry ever!" Tom said. And they played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to study. He would sit in his room and look at his books all day. Tim had a small radio in his room. He liked to listen to it while he studied.
One day, the radio started to make a loud noise. Tim was scared. He didn't know what to do. He ran to his mom and told her about the noise. Mom went to Tim's room and listened to the radio.
Mom smiled and said, "Don't be scared, Tim. The radio is just playing a song with loud drums." She turned the radio down, and the noise was not so loud anymore. Tim felt better. He went back to study with his radio playing softly. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little monkey named Momo. Momo lived in a big tree with his family. He was a normal monkey who liked to play with his friends and eat bananas.
One day, Momo saw a big bird in the sky. He wanted to ask the bird if he could fly too. So, Momo climbed to the top of the tree and shouted, "Hey, bird! Can I fly like you?" The bird looked at Momo and said, "I don't think so, Momo. You are a monkey, not a bird."
Momo felt sad that he could not fly. But then he thought about all the fun things he could do as a monkey. He could swing from tree to tree and play with his friends. Momo decided that being a normal monkey was just as fun as being a bird. So, he went back to his friends and played happily ever after.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play with kites. They had a big red kite that could soar high in the sky. They took turns to hold the string and watch the kite fly.
One day, they went to the park with their kite. It was a sunny day with a lot of wind. They found a good spot to launch their kite. Lily held the string first and let the kite soar. She felt happy and said, "Look, Ben, our kite is so high and fast!"
Ben nodded and smiled. He waited for his turn to hold the string. He wanted to feel the kite soar too. But Lily did not give him the string. She said, "No, Ben, it's my turn. I want to play more."
Ben felt sad and angry. He said, "That's not fair, Lily. We have to share. Give me the string, please."
Lily shook her head and said, "No, Ben, it's mine. Go away."
Ben tried to grab the string from Lily. They pulled and tugged. The string snapped. The kite flew away. They watched it disappear in the sky. They felt sorry and cried.
They lost their kite and their friendship. They learned that being selfish and greedy is not sweet.

Tom and Lily were going to visit their grandma. They had to pack their bags with clothes and toys. Tom put his teddy bear and his ball in his bag. Lily put her doll and her book in her bag.
"Are you ready?" Mom asked.
"Yes, Mom!" Tom and Lily said.
They went to the car and put their bags in the trunk. Mom drove them to grandma's house. It was a long drive, but they saw many things on the way. They saw cows and horses and trees and flowers.
When they got to grandma's house, they ran to hug her. Grandma was very happy to see them. She showed them their room, where they could sleep and play. There were two beds with soft pillows and blankets. There was also a basket with some twigs and leaves.
"What are these for, grandma?" Lily asked.
"These are for making a nest, my dear," grandma said. "You can pretend to be birds and make a cozy nest with the twigs and leaves. You can also use some of the old clothes in the closet."
Tom and Lily liked the idea. They took some twigs and leaves and some clothes and started to make a nest on the floor. They worked together and made a big and comfortable nest. They put their toys inside and crawled in.
"This is fun, grandma!" Tom said.
"I'm glad you like it, my sweeties," grandma said. "Now, do you want some cookies and milk?"
"Yes, please!" Tom and Lily said.
They got out of the nest and followed grandma to the kitchen. They ate some cookies and drank some milk. They thanked grandma and gave her a kiss. Then they went back to their nest and played some more. They had a wonderful time at grandma's house.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a favorite toy, a small rag doll named Rosie. Lily and Rosie did everything together. They played, ate, and slept side by side.
One day, Lily and her family went to the park. Lily brought Rosie along. They played near a big tree. Lily whispered secrets to Rosie while they sat under the tree. They had so much fun.
But when it was time to go home, Lily forgot Rosie under the tree. At home, Lily felt sad. She missed her rag doll. The next day, they went back to the park. From a distant place, Lily saw Rosie under the tree. She ran to Rosie and hugged her tight. Lily whispered, "I will never leave you again."

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Bingo. Bingo lived in a small house with his human, named Tim. They played together and were very happy.
One day, Bingo saw a little bird outside. The bird looked sad and lost. Bingo wanted to help the bird, so he barked at Tim to come. Tim came and saw the bird too. Tim and Bingo decided to help the bird find its way back home.
They took the bird to a big tree, where it found its family. The bird was very happy and thanked Tim and Bingo. The moral of the story is to always be kind and help others when they need it.

One day, a pink ball rolled into a park. A girl named Lily saw it and wanted to play. She ran up to the ball and gave it a big kick. The ball went very high in the sky and came back down.
Lily saw a boy named Tim with a stitch on his shirt. She asked, "Do you want to play with my pink ball?" Tim said, "Yes, let's play!" They took turns kicking the ball and had lots of fun.
But then, a big dog saw the pink ball and wanted it too. The dog ran very fast and took the ball in its mouth. Lily and Tim tried to get the ball back, but the dog was too strong. The dog bit the ball and it popped. The pink ball was gone and they were very sad.

Once there was a boy called John. He was a happy boy and loved to mix things up. One day, he went to the shore with his friends. He saw a big pile of sand and decided to mix it all up. His friends were jealous of him having so much fun.
Suddenly, a big wave came crashing down on the shore. In an instant, all the sand John had mixed up was scattered and swept away. He was so shocked and upset. He had worked so hard to mix it all together.
His jealous friends laughed at him. They had been wondering how long it would take before he got in trouble for playing so much. John was so sad he ran away and never returned to the shore again.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max was a big, happy dog who loved to play. One day, Max felt sick and his family took him to the veterinarian. The veterinarian was a nice lady who helped animals feel better.
While Max was at the veterinarian, he saw a magic toy. The magic toy could make things disappear. Max felt a little guilty, but he wanted to play with the toy. So, Max took the magic toy when no one was looking.
Max played with the magic toy and made his ball disappear. He was so happy! But then, Max wanted his ball back. He didn't know how to make it come back. Max felt sad and guilty. He took the magic toy back to the veterinarian and said sorry. The nice lady helped Max get his ball back, and Max promised not to take things again.

Once upon a time there was a puppy who liked to play. He was very eager to go outside and explore. One day, he jumped into the closet and opened it. He escaped the closet and ran out the door.
He ran and ran until he was in a strange and unfamiliar place. He looked around and saw other puppies playing and having fun. He was eager to meet them, so he ran over to say hi. His new friends welcomed him and asked why he escaped the closet. The puppy said he was very curious and wanted to explore.
One of the puppies asked if he was scared. The puppy shook his head and said he wasn't scared at all. He said he just wanted to have some fun. The puppies laughed and said he was brave.
The puppy quickly made new friends and was happy. He had a lot of fun with his new puppy friends and went back home to his closet when it was time for bed. From week to week he kept going outside to play with his puppy friends and always thanked the closet for helping him escape.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a dress she loved very much. The dress was mighty pretty, with red and blue flowers on it. Mia wore her dress every day.
One day, Mia met a boy named Tim. Tim saw Mia's dress and said, "Wow, your dress is mighty pretty!" Mia smiled and said, "Thank you! I love my dress a lot!"
Mia and Tim played together every day. They had fun in the sun, and Mia's dress would dance in the wind. Mia and Tim became best friends, and they loved each other's company. And Mia's mighty pretty dress was always there, making them both happy.

One day, a dog named Spot wanted to have a party. He told his friend, Cat, "Let's have a party with all our friends!" Cat said, "Yes, let's do it!" They were very excited.
Spot and Cat had to jog to the store to get things for the party. While they were jogging, Spot said, "I hope we can find everything we need." Cat said, "Me too!" This was a hint that something might go wrong later.
At the store, they looked for party things but they could not find them. Spot and Cat felt frustrated. They said to each other, "What will we do now?" Then, they saw a big box by the door. The box had all the party things they needed! They were so happy and had a great party with their friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim was playing outside. He saw a big shadow on the ground. Tim was scared and started to cry. His mom heard him and came running.
"Why are you crying, Tim?" she asked. Tim pointed at the shadow and said, "Big shadow scare me!" His mom smiled and said, "Don't be scared. That's just the shadow of the tree. It's a good thing because it gives us shade when it's hot."
Tim stopped crying and looked at the tree. He saw that the shadow was not scary, but good. He learned that sometimes things that look scary can be good too. And he also learned to not be scared of shadows.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a brilliant boy who loved to play with his toy cars. One day, Tim decided to build a race track for his cars in the backyard.
He used a long drain pipe to make a tunnel for his cars to race through. Tim was very excited to see his cars go zoom through the drain. He worked hard to finish the track and couldn't wait to start racing.
When Tim finally finished the track, he called his friends over to play. They all had so much fun racing their cars through the drain tunnel. The brilliant sun shined down on them as they played all day long. And that was the best day ever for Tim and his friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to play. He went outside to find a friend to play with. He saw a girl named Sue. Sue was playing with a toy drum. Tim liked the rhythm of the drum. He asked Sue if she wanted to play with him.
Sue was happy to play with Tim. She said, "I am available to play with you!" Tim and Sue played with the drum. They made the rhythm go fast and slow. They had a lot of fun. They played a game where they would ask each other questions and answer with the drum.
After playing for a while, Tim and Sue got tired. They sat under a tree and talked. They were happy they played together. Tim and Sue became good friends. They promised to play together again soon.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the opera with her mom. Lucy was very excited because it was her first time going to the opera. She was also grateful that her mom took her there. At the opera, they saw people singing and dancing on the stage. Lucy clapped her hands and smiled.
During the show, a big, fluffy cat walked onto the stage. The cat started to sing with the people. Lucy was surprised and said, "Look, Mom! A cat is singing!" Her mom laughed and said, "Yes, Lucy, that is a very special cat who loves to sing at the opera."
At the end of the show, the cat jumped off the stage and walked up to Lucy. She was so happy and gave the cat a big hug. The cat hugged her back and said, "Thank you for coming to the opera, Lucy. I hope you had fun!" Lucy nodded and said, "Yes, I did! Thank you, Mr. Cat!" Then, the cat went back to the stage, and Lucy and her mom went home. They were both very grateful for the special day they had at the opera.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. In the park, there was a big fountain. The water in the fountain was deep. Tim liked to watch the water display. It went up and down, and it made him happy.
Tim saw a duck near the fountain. He wanted to talk to the duck. He said, "Hi, duck! Do you like the water display?" The duck looked at Tim and said, "Yes, I like it! It is fun to swim in the deep water."
Tim and the duck played near the fountain all day. They had a lot of fun. When it was time to go home, Tim said, "Bye, duck! I will come back to see the fountain and play with you again." The duck said, "Bye, Tim! I will wait for you here by the deep fountain."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the store with her mom. They wanted to pick some things to take home. Lily liked the store because it had many things to see and touch.
In the store, Lily saw something unusual. It was a big, round, and colorful ball. She had never seen a ball like this before. Lily said, "Mom, can I pick this ball, please?" Her mom looked at the ball and said, "Yes, Lily, you can pick that ball."
Lily was so happy to take the unusual ball home. She played with it all day and all night. The ball made her smile and laugh. And from that day on, Lily and the ball became best friends.

Johnnie was so excited. He had been invited to his Uncle's office. Johnnie had never been to an office before and he wanted to know what it looked like.
When Johnnie arrived, he met his Uncle who looked very serious. His Uncle showed Johnnie around the office and explained what everyone did. After that, they sat down.
Johnnie's Uncle asked Johnnie what he wanted to discuss. Johnnie was not sure and asked why they were discussing. His Uncle said they had to talk about something very important and expensive.
Johnnie instantly felt a bit scared. He did not know what it could be. His Uncle then explained that they were having a discussion about a new car that he wanted to buy. Johnnie smiled with relief and excitement.
Johnnie and his Uncle had a long discuss about the car. Eventually, his Uncle decided to go ahead and buy it. Johnnie was very happy for him.
Johnnie had foreshadowed that the discussion would be about something expensive. He had been nervous about what it could be. In the end, it was all about a very exciting, new car adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a musician. He played songs in the town. One day, he heard a sound. It was an unknown sound. He wanted to find it.
The musician started to follow the sound. He walked and walked. He went to a big tree in the woods. The sound was near.
Under the tree, he saw a small box. The unknown sound came from the box. The musician opened the box. Inside, he found a tiny bird. The bird was the one making the sound!
The musician and the bird became friends. They played songs together. The town loved their new music. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a playful dog named Spot. Spot liked to run and play all day. He lived in a big house with a big yard. One day, Spot saw a new path in his yard. He was very excited to see where it went.
Spot's friend, the bird, was flying high in the sky. Bird saw Spot on the path and knew it would include a fun adventure. Bird flew down to join Spot, and they walked down the path together. They saw many pretty things like flowers and trees.
As they walked, they saw something shiny at the end of the path. It was a big, red ball! Spot and Bird had so much fun playing with the ball. They were very happy they found the new path that day. And from that day on, Spot and Bird always played together on the path with their big, red ball.

One day, a cheerful boy named Tim went to the hospital with his mom. They went to see his friend, Sam, who was not feeling well. Tim wanted to make Sam happy, so he brought a big, red ball to play with.
In the hospital room, Tim and Sam started to play with the ball. They threw it back and forth, laughing and having fun. But then, they began to disagree about who should hold the ball. Tim wanted to hold it, but Sam wanted to hold it too.
Mom saw them disagree and said, "Why don't you both hold the ball and play together?" Tim and Sam listened to mom and held the ball together. They played and laughed, and Sam felt much better. The hospital room was filled with cheer, and Tim was happy he could help his friend.

Once upon a time, there was a baby. The baby lived in a house with his mom and dad. The baby liked to play with toys, but sometimes he felt bored. His toys were boring, and he wanted to find something new to do.
One day, the baby saw a big thing in the room. It was a thing called a scale. His mom and dad used it to weigh things. The baby thought it looked fun, so he crawled over to it. He wanted to see how much he weighed.
The baby climbed on the scale and saw the numbers. The numbers showed how much he weighed. The baby was happy to see the numbers change. He laughed and clapped his hands. The baby found a new fun thing to do, and he was not bored anymore.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient box in a small house. In the box, there was a game called chess. A kind grandpa lived in the house. He loved to play chess with his grandson, Tim.
One day, Tim went to the park. He saw a sad boy sitting alone. Tim wanted to help him. He thought about the chess game. Tim ran back home and asked his grandpa, "Can I bring the chess game to the park?"
Grandpa smiled and said, "Yes, you can." Tim took the chess game and ran to the park. He showed the sad boy the chess game and said, "Let's play together!" The sad boy's face lit up, and they played chess. They had so much fun.
The sad boy became Tim's new friend. They played chess every day at the park. Tim learned that sharing and being kind can bring happiness to others. And that was the moral of the story.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, John and Lee. They were playing together in the big, big stadium. It was smelly.
John and Lee were playing tag. They laughed and yelled as they ran around.
John stopped in a corner and said “Let’s keep playing here!”
Lee thought for a while. He said, “It’s too smelly here. Let’s go outside.”
John agreed, so off they ran.
As they ran, they heard music playing. Incredibly, the music seemed to be coming from the smelly stadium!
John stopped and said, “Let’s go inside and see what’s happening!”
Lee thought for a bit and then said, “Ok!”
They both held hands and carefully walked into the smelly stadium. Inside was a surprise party! There were lots of colorful balloons and a big cake in the middle.  Everyone cheered when they saw John and Lee.
John shouted, “This is such a surprise! Thank you!”
Lee smiled and said, “It sure is! I think this is the best surprise ever!”

Once upon a time, there was a thoughtful little girl named Amy. Amy loved to look at the stars in the sky. One day, she saw a very big star. She wanted to catch it and keep it with her.
Amy asked her mom, "How can I catch a star?" Her mom smiled and said, "You will find a way, dear." Amy thought and thought. She had an idea. She would use a net to catch the star.
That night, Amy took her net and went outside. She tried to catch the star, but it was too high. She did not give up. She climbed a tree and tried again. This time, she caught the star!
Amy was so happy. She showed the star to her mom. Her mom was proud of her. From that day on, the star stayed with Amy and shined bright for her every night.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Chloe. She was three years old and loved to explore.
One day, Chloe wanted to find something new to play with. She looked around her room and noticed that one of the shelves was full of toys. She went to take a look and was filled with delight! She picked up a toy and held it close to her chest.
Chloe's mom came into the room and saw her holding the toy. She said, "Chloe, that toy belongs on the shelf. Please surrender it and put it back so you can choose another one."
Chloe thought for a moment, then she smiled and handed the toy to her mom. She gave her mom a warm hug as a thank you for helping her learn about being a good listener.
Chloe took a few steps back to pick out another toy, but this time she remembered to put it back on the shelf when she was done playing.

Max was a friendly cat. He was always looking for ways to gain more friends. He had a plan to get more post. So one day, he went to the park. He was very flexible as he walked around, looking for friends.
Max went up to a dog. He said "Hi! Will you be my friend?". The dog said "Yes!". Max was so happy. He gained one new friend.
Next he saw a rabbit. He asked the rabbit to be his friend. Again, the rabbit said "Yes". Max's plan was working! He had two new friends.
Finally, he saw a squirrel. Max asked the squirrel the same question. Again the squirrel said "Yes". Now Max had three new friends!
Max was so happy. His plan worked and he had gained three new friends. He walked back home with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was a lucky girl because she had many friends. One day, Lucy and her best friend, Tim, went to the park to play.
As they played, Lucy saw an image of a big, friendly dog on a poster. She wanted to find the dog and be its friend too. Lucy told Tim, "I want to find that dog and be its friend. Will you help me?"
Tim agreed, and they looked for the dog together. They asked people if they had seen the dog, but no one knew where it was. Finally, they found the dog in a small house. The dog was sad because it was lost and missed its family.
Lucy and Tim decided to help the dog find its family. They knew they could do it if they trusted each other. They held hands and walked with the dog, asking everyone they met if they knew the dog's family. At last, they found the dog's family, who were very happy to see their pet again.
The dog's family thanked Lucy and Tim for their help. Lucy and Tim felt very proud and happy that they had trusted each other and found the dog's family. They knew they were lucky to have each other as friends.

Anna and Ben are twins. They love to play with their toys, but they do not like to share. One day, they both want to play with the same doll. They pull and tug and shout.
"Mine!" Anna says.
"No, mine!" Ben says.
They make a lot of noise and their mom comes to see what is wrong.
"Anna, Ben, what are you doing?" mom asks. "Why are you fighting over the doll?"
"Because we both want it!" Anna and Ben say.
Mom shakes her head. "You are family. Family should be kind and gentle to each other. You have many toys. You can take turns or play together. Can you please say sorry and share the doll?"
Anna and Ben look at each other. They feel bad for making mom sad. They remember that they love each other and they love mom.
"Sorry, Anna," Ben says.
"Sorry, Ben," Anna says.
They hug and give the doll to mom. "Can you please play with us, mom?" they ask.
Mom smiles and nods. "Of course, my lovely children. I am happy to play with you."
They go to the living room and have fun with the doll and other toys. They laugh and talk and hug. They are a happy family. They learn that sharing is caring and that family is lovely.

Once upon a time, there was a gifted bird named Blue. Blue loved to fly high in the sky and taste the sweet air. One day, Blue found a shiny diamond on the ground. It was so pretty, and Blue wanted to show it to his friend, Red the Squirrel.
Blue flew to Red and said, "Look at my pretty diamond! I found it on the ground." Red looked at the diamond and said, "Wow, it's so shiny! Can I see it?" Blue gave the diamond to Red, and they both looked at it together.
After a while, Blue and Red saw another friend, Green the Rabbit. Green was sad because he lost his diamond. Blue and Red knew they had to give the diamond back to Green. So, Blue said, "Green, we found your diamond! Here it is!" Green was so happy and said, "Thank you, Blue and Red! You are good friends."
The three friends played together and had lots of fun. The moral of the story is to always be kind and help your friends when they need you.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play with their cat, Fluffy. Fluffy was a soft and cuddly cat who liked to sleep on their bed and chase balls of yarn. Tom and Lily loved Fluffy very much, but sometimes they wanted to play with him in different ways.
One day, Tom wanted to dress Fluffy in a hat and a scarf and pretend he was a snowman. Lily wanted to make Fluffy a crown and a necklace and pretend he was a king. They both grabbed Fluffy and tried to put their clothes on him. Fluffy did not like this at all. He meowed and scratched and tried to run away.
"Stop it, Lily! Fluffy is my snowman!" Tom shouted.
"No, he is my king! Let go of him, Tom!" Lily yelled.
They pulled and tugged on Fluffy until he got free and hid under the sofa. Tom and Lily glared at each other and started to cry.
Fluffy felt troubled. He did not like to see his friends quarrel. He wanted them to be happy and play nicely. He peeked out from under the sofa and saw their sad faces. He decided to do something to make them feel better.
He came out from his hiding place and walked slowly towards them. He rubbed his head against their legs and purred softly. He looked at them with his big green eyes and licked their hands. He gave them a small meow and a smile.
Tom and Lily stopped crying and smiled back. They realized they had been silly and mean to Fluffy. They hugged him and said they were sorry.
"We love you, Fluffy. You are not a snowman or a king. You are our cat and our friend," they said.
Fluffy was happy. He jumped on their bed and invited them to join him. They cuddled and played with him until they fell asleep. They dreamed of having more fun adventures with Fluffy, but without quarreling.

Once upon a time, there was a small monkey named Mike. He lived in a dry jungle. Every day, he would look up at the sky and dream of what he could do. One day, he decided he wanted to learn how to fly.
So, Mike gathered all his courage and started to study. He watched other birds soar in the sky, and he read books about flight. He kept practicing day after day.
One day, Mike finally got the hang of it! He was so excited that he shouted, "I did it!"
A parrot in the nearby tree heard him. She flew over and said, "That's great! I can tell you worked really hard to study."
Mike smiled and replied, "I sure did! Now I can fly all over the dry jungle!" And with that, Mike flapped his wings and flew away.

Once upon a time, there was a hairy dog named Bobo. Bobo loved to play with his friends in the park. One day, he saw a big lollipop on the ground. He wanted to eat it, but he remembered his mom told him not to eat things from the ground.
Bobo went to his friend, a little bird named Chirpy, and told him about the lollipop. Chirpy said, "I believe you should give the lollipop to someone who lost it." Bobo thought about it and agreed. They went around the park asking if anyone lost a lollipop.
To their surprise, they found a sad little girl named Lily who had lost her lollipop. Bobo gave the lollipop to Lily, and she was very happy. In return, she gave Bobo and Chirpy some yummy treats. They all became good friends and played together every day.
The moral of the story is to always do the right thing and help others, even if it may not be easy or fun.

Jill was walking in the park with her grandpa one afternoon. They stopped at a bench and sat down together. "Grandpa, can I ask you something?" asked Jill, looking up at him.
Grandpa smiled at her. "Yes, ask away."
Jill paused and thought for a moment, then asked, "Do you ever feel grumpy?"
Grandpa smiled again, and replied "Sometimes I do."
Jill was quiet for a few moments. She then said, "I feel grumpy now!"
Grandpa gave her a quick hug. "That's ok, let's take a break and play tag. Be ready - I'll come after you!"
Jill's eyes lit up and she shouted, "Ready!" She then ran off and Grandpa chased after her. After a while, they stopped to rest. Jill had a big smile on her face, and Grandpa was happy too.
He smiled and said, "That was a lot of fun. You're very quick!"
Jill nodded and replied, "Yep, I sure am!" They both laughed, and Grandpa gave her another quick hug before they continued walking around the park.

It was raining outside. Jeannie looked out the window and saw the raindrops falling in all kinds of shapes. She thought it was so interesting and wanted to go outside.
Mom said to Jeannie, “No, it’s too wet. The rain outside tastes so bitter!”
But Jeannie was not about to give up. “Please, mommy? Please, can I go outside?”
Mom smiled and said “Okay, but wear your coat and hat, so you don't get too wet.”
Jeannie ran outside with her coat and hat on and put her hand out to catch the rain. She watched the raindrops as they landed in all kinds of shapes.
She laughed and smiled. The rain was cold and bitter but it was still lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful bird named Ella. Ella had many friends in the forest, and they all played together. They were a happy network of animals.
One day, Ella hurt her wing and could not fly. Her friends saw that she was sad and wanted to help her. They worked together to find a way to heal Ella's wing.
With the help of her friends, Ella's wing got better. She was able to fly again. The animals in the forest learned that when they work together, they can solve any problem. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the store with his mom. They were looking for some fruit to eat. Tim saw a big, round melon. It looked unusual. It was not like the other melons. Tim told his mom, "I want this melon!"
The next day, Tim and his mom cut the melon. Inside, it was not like the other melons. It was a funny color. Tim's mom said, "This is an unusual melon. I don't know if we can eat it." Tim was sad, but he wanted to try it.
Tim took a bite of the melon. It tasted very good! Tim's mom tried it too. She liked it! They both laughed and ate the unusual melon. It was a fun day for Tim and his mom. They were happy they tried the unusual melon.

Once upon a time, there was a wise squirrel named Sam. Sam was very good at finding food. One day, Sam found a big acorn. He was so happy and wanted to show his friends. Sam knew he had to behave and not be too loud.
As Sam was walking, he saw a little bird. The bird was sad because it could not find any food. Sam wanted to help the bird. He thought about his big acorn and decided to do something unexpected. Sam gave the bird his big acorn. The bird was so happy and thanked Sam.
But then, a plot twist happened! The bird gave Sam a secret. The bird told Sam about a tree with many acorns. Sam was so excited! He went to the tree and found so many acorns. Sam was happy that he shared his acorn because now he had more than he could ever eat.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Bob. He had a dog named Spot. Bob and Spot liked to play and learn together. One day, they went to the park to play with a ball. Spot liked to run and catch the ball with his mouth.
At the park, they saw a big bird with a hurt leg. The bird said, "Help me, please! My leg hurts!" Bob and Spot wanted to help the bird. Bob picked up the bird and put it in a box. They took the bird to a kind doctor to fix its leg.
The doctor looked at the bird and said, "This is not a bird, it's an eagle!" Bob and Spot were surprised! They didn't know they were helping an eagle. The doctor fixed the eagle's leg, and they all became friends. From that day on, Bob, Spot, and the eagle played and learned together at the park.

One day, a boy named Tom went for a walk on the street. He saw a big, ugly bug on the ground. Tom was scared, but he wanted to help the bug. He said, "Don't worry, bug. I will help you."
Tom took a leaf and tried to wipe the bug off the ground. As he wiped, something unexpected happened. The bug started to change! It became a beautiful butterfly. The butterfly said, "Thank you, Tom, for helping me!"
Tom was very happy to see the butterfly. He said, "You are not ugly anymore! You are very pretty." The butterfly flew away, and Tom went back home. He told his mom about the butterfly, and she was very proud of him.

Once upon a time, there was a cat named Tom. Tom loved to play with yarn. One day, Tom saw a new ball of yarn on the floor. He was very happy and started to play with it.
While Tom was playing, the yarn started to move! Tom was surprised. He did not know that the yarn could move by itself. He followed the yarn to see where it was going.
The yarn went into a room. Tom saw that it was not just yarn, but a long tail of a big, friendly dog named Max! Max wagged his tail and the yarn moved. Tom and Max became good friends and played with the yarn together. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play, run, and jump. One day, Spot found a tight ball. He wanted to play with it, but it was hard to hold.
Spot tried to pick up the tight ball with his mouth, but he could not do it. He felt a tickle in his nose and let out a big sneeze! The tight ball flew far away. Spot was sad because he lost the ball.
Spot's friend, a big cat named Fluffy, saw him and said, "Don't be sad, Spot. I will help you find your tight ball." They looked and looked, and finally found the tight ball under a tree. Fluffy gave Spot a treat for being a good friend. Spot was happy again, and they played with the tight ball all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. He lived in a little house. One day, Tom found a jar of magic powder.
Tom wanted to play a trick on his friends. He put the powder on his head. Suddenly, Tom's hair started to grow very fast. His friends laughed and laughed at him. But then, the hair did not stop growing. It filled the whole house!
Tom knew he had to escape. He tried to run out the door, but the hair was too thick. Then, Tom had an idea. He used the magic powder again. This time, the hair started to shrink. Tom was free! He learned to be careful with magic powder.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy motor car. It was his favorite toy. Tim had a friend named Sam. Sam also had a toy motor car. They both liked to play together.
One day, Tim and Sam decided to have a race with their motor cars. They both wanted to win, so they were very competitive. They said to each other, "Let's see who has the fastest car!" They started the race and their cars went very fast.
As the race went on, Tim's car started to grow bigger and bigger. It was going so fast that it crashed into a tree. The motor car broke into pieces. Tim was very sad because his favorite toy was broken. Sam felt bad too, and they both learned that being too competitive can sometimes lead to bad endings.

Once upon a time, there was a hot day. The sun was shining, and everyone was hot. A little boy named Tim felt very hot too. He wanted to play outside, but he was too hot. Tim's mom gave him a pill to help him feel better. Tim did not like the pill, but he took it anyway.
Tim went to play outside with his friends. They played and played, but Tim still felt hot. He did not know why the pill did not help. Tim felt sad and regret taking the pill. He wanted to feel better, but the pill did not work.
Then, something unexpected happened. The sky became dark, and it started to rain. The rain made everyone feel cool and happy. Tim felt better, even though the pill did not work. The rain was the real helper. Tim and his friends played in the rain and had a great time. They did not need the pill to feel better. The rain was the best surprise for everyone.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a gray cat. The cat liked to play and jump around. One day, the cat saw a long spear stuck in a tree. The cat was curious and wanted to remove it.
The cat climbed the tree and tried to remove the spear. It was hard, but the cat did not give up. After a while, the cat finally removed the spear from the tree. The cat was very happy and proud.
The cat took the spear and showed it to its friends. They all played with the spear and had a lot of fun. The gray cat was a hero to its friends. From that day on, the cat and its friends had many more fun adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She had a rare toy in her room. It was a big, red ball. Mia loved her ball very much.
One day, Mia went to the park with her mom. She wanted to carry her big, red ball with her. When they got to the park, Mia said, "Mom, can I play with my ball?" Her mom said, "Yes, Mia, you can play with your ball."
While Mia was playing, she felt an itch on her arm. She told her mom, "Mom, my arm has an itch." Her mom looked at her arm and saw a tiny bug. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Mia. I will help you with the itch."
Mia's mom helped her with the itch and then Mia went back to play with her big, red ball. She was very happy. Mia and her mom had a fun day at the park with the rare toy.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play in the garden. They had a big sunflower that they helped to grow with water and love. The sunflower was mighty and tall, and had a bright yellow face that smiled at them.
One day, Ben found a pair of scissors in the shed. He had an idea. He wanted to cut the sunflower and make a crown for himself. He thought he would be the king of the garden. He did not ask Lily or Mommy or Daddy. He just took the scissors and ran to the sunflower.
Lily saw him and shouted, "No, Ben, no! Don't cut the sunflower! It is our friend! It will be sad and die!" But Ben did not listen. He was naughty and selfish. He snipped the sunflower's stem and the big yellow face fell to the ground.
Lily cried and ran to the sunflower. She hugged it and said, "I'm sorry, sunflower. I'm sorry, Ben hurt you. You were so mighty and beautiful. I love you." The sunflower did not smile anymore. It was limp and brown.
Mommy and Daddy heard the noise and came to the garden. They saw what Ben had done and they were very angry and sad. They scolded Ben and took away the scissors. They said, "Ben, you were very bad. You hurt the sunflower and Lily. You did not share or care. You have to say sorry and learn your lesson."
Ben felt ashamed and sorry. He said sorry to the sunflower, to Lily, and to Mommy and Daddy. But it was too late. The sunflower was gone and Lily was sad. Ben had no crown and no friend. He wished he had not cut the sunflower. He wished he had been kind and good.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a pencil on the floor. He picked it up and started to chew on it. He liked the taste and kept chewing. His mom saw him and said, "Tim, don't chew on the pencil. It's not good for you."
Tim felt sad that he couldn't chew on the pencil. He put it down and went to play with his toys. But then, something unexpected happened. The pencil started to talk! It said, "Hello, Tim! Don't be sad. I am a magic pencil!"
Tim was very surprised. He picked up the magic pencil and said, "What can you do?" The magic pencil told Tim that it could draw anything he wanted. Tim drew a big, happy smile on his face and was not sad anymore. He played with the magic pencil all day and they had a lot of fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a band of three friends. They liked to play and sing together. They had a big show coming up, but their room was very messy.
One day, the first friend said, "We need to clean our room. It will be easy if we do it together!" The other two friends agreed, and they started to clean. They picked up toys, put away clothes, and made their beds.
As they cleaned, they found a pretty red ribbon. The second friend said, "Let's use this ribbon to make our band look nice for the show!" They tied the ribbon around their arms and smiled.
The big day came, and the room was clean. The band played their songs and everyone clapped. The friends were so happy that they had worked together to make their room clean and their show a success.

Once there was a girl named Summer. Summer loved to play in the park. One summer day, she was feeling very sad. She sat down on the grass and sighed.
Suddenly she saw a butterfly. She watched it flutter around her until it flew away. She wanted to catch the butterfly, but it was too fast for her.
Then she spotted a ladybug crawling near her feet. She was determined to catch it. She tried to grab the little bug but it was much too quick. Summer kept trying, but it wouldn't stay still.
At last, she had a plan. She took a big leaf and gently scooped up the ladybug. She was so proud of herself! She carefully cupped the ladybug in her hands, and smiled.
Summer was no longer sad. With her catch, she ran all the way back home.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Yesterday, Spot was very dirty from playing in the mud. So, his mom said it was time for Spot to bathe. Spot did not like to bathe, but he knew he had to listen to his mom.
While Spot was in the bath, he heard a noise. It was a little bird who flew in through the window. The bird was sorry for scaring Spot. The bird said, "I am sorry, Spot. I am lost and need help to find my way home." Spot wanted to help the bird, even though he was wet and soapy.
Spot and the bird became friends. The bird helped Spot finish his bath and then Spot helped the bird find its way home. The bird's family was so happy to see them! They all said thank you to Spot. From that day on, Spot didn't mind taking a bath because he knew that sometimes, unexpected and good things can happen when you least expect it.

Once upon a time, there was a creative girl named Lily. She had a big, red scarf. She loved her scarf very much. Lily wore her scarf every day, even when it was hot.
One day, Lily met a boy named Tom. He saw her scarf and said, "I like your scarf. It is very pretty." Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Tom. My mom made it for me." Tom wanted a scarf like Lily's, so they went to find Lily's mom.
Lily's mom was happy to help Tom. She gave him a blue scarf. Tom and Lily played all day with their scarfs. They were very happy. In the end, they became best friends. They always wore their scarfs, and everyone loved their creative look.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a pale boy named Tim. Tim liked to play near the big rail by his house. One sunny day, Tim saw a cute cat near the rail. The cat was playing with a ball.
Tim wanted to play with the cat too. He ran to the cat and they played with the ball together. They were having a lot of fun. But Tim was not careful, and he began to fall near the rail.
Just then, a kind man saw Tim falling. He quickly ran to Tim and caught him before he hit the ground. Tim was safe and the cat was happy. The kind man told Tim to be careful when playing near the rail. From that day on, Tim always remembered to be careful and he never fell near the rail again.

John and his mom were walking around the park. All around them people were happily chatting with their friends.
John's mom smiled at him.
"John, do you trust the police?" she asked.
John nodded, "Yes, mommy," he said quietly.
His mom smiled and pointed to a police officer who was chatting to a group of kids.
"See," she said. "That officer is friendly, it's okay to trust them."
John felt better. He felt safe knowing that the police were around to help if he ever needed them.
After a while, they said goodbye to the police officer and started to walk home.
John smiled. He felt happy and secure, knowing that he could trust the police.
As they walked home, the park was quiet and peaceful. John felt peaceful, too. He was so glad that he could trust the police.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to a big room. In the room, there was a man giving a talk. This talk was called a lecture. Tim did not want to be at the lecture. He wanted to play with his toys.
Tim sat next to an ugly frog. The ugly frog said, "I don't want to be at the lecture too. Let's go play outside!" Tim and the ugly frog left the room and went to the park. They played on the swings and slides.
Later, they went back to the big room. The lecture was over. Tim's mom asked, "Did you learn anything at the lecture?" Tim said, "No, but I made a new friend!" Tim and the ugly frog smiled and played together every day.

Mercy and her mom were walking near the park on a sunny day. Her mom said, "Let's get an umbrella so that we don't get wet if it rains."
Mercy was so excited! She ran up to the store and asked the shopkeeper, "Can I buy an umbrella please?"
The shopkeeper smiled and replied, "Of course, my clever little girl. Here, take this one."
Mercy said thank you and showed her mom her new umbrella.
Her mom smiled and said, "Let me introduce you to a special trick." She held the umbrella and spun it around, making it open. Mercy was amazed! She started spinning the umbrella around, trying to make it open like her mom. After a few tries, it worked!
Mercy and her mom laughed and smiled. Mercy's mom said, "Now you know how to always stay dry if it rains."
Mercy was so proud to learn how to do this clever trick with her new umbrella.

Once upon a time, there was a brave sailor. He was on his boat in the ocean and he was watching the world around him. Suddenly, a big wave appeared and his boat started to rock. The brave sailor almost fell in the water, but he managed to stay on the boat.
He tried to steer away from the wave, while looking around the ocean to see if he can find help. He kept watching and then, he saw a whale in the distance. He was glad and steered his boat towards the whale. He knew that whales were friendly animals and he hoped the whale would help him.
When he got closer, the brave sailor called out to the whale. The whale stopped and he could see that it was trying to help him. The whale pushed his boat in the opposite direction of the wave and the sailor was safe. The sailor thanked the whale for its help and sailed away.

Sara and Ben were twins who liked to play outside. One night, they saw the moon was big and bright in the sky. They wanted to go to the moon and see what was there.
"Let's escape from our room and go to the moon," Sara said to Ben.
"How can we go to the moon?" Ben asked.
"We can use our blankets and pillows to make a rocket," Sara said. "We can put them on the bed and pretend to fly."
They sneaked out of their room and took their blankets and pillows. They piled them on the bed and climbed on top. They made noises like a rocket and imagined they were flying to the moon.
When they got to the moon, they saw it was white and soft. They jumped and bounced on the moon. They saw stars and planets and met a friendly alien. They had fun on the moon.
The moon was peaceful and quiet. They felt happy and sleepy. They lay down on the moon and closed their eyes.
Their mom came to their room and saw them on the bed. She smiled and tucked them in. She kissed them and whispered, "Good night, my little astronauts. I love you."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Sue went for a walk with her mom. They walked by a store and Sue saw candy in the window. She was very happy.
Sue asked her mom if she could have some candy. Her mom said yes, but only one. Sue looked at all the candy and saw one that was very different. It was the most original candy she had ever seen. It was big, round, and had many colors.
Sue picked the original candy and said thank you to her mom. She shared the candy with her friends and they all loved it. They played and laughed under the sun, enjoying the sweet treat. And from that day on, Sue and her friends always remembered the special, original candy they shared together.

Once upon a time a happy family was planning a picnic. The father was packing the cooler with yummy snacks. The mother and children were counting up the plates. The friendly family was so excited to be outside and enjoy the day.
They all hopped into the car and drove to the park, but silly papa had forgotten his keys to the cooler! Without the keys, he couldn't open it and the hungry family was sad.
Luckily, the mom had an idea. She called a friendly neighbor for help. The neighbor had a spare key, and soon enough the cooler was open.
The family was very happy - now they could eat their lunch and play games. They had a great picnic and enjoyed the day.

One day, a dog named Spot had a broken collar. Spot liked to act funny and run around. His collar was very old and not good anymore.
Spot's friend, a cat named Fluffy, saw the broken collar. Fluffy wanted to help Spot. They went to find a new collar for Spot to wear.
They found a new collar that was nice and strong. Fluffy helped put the collar on Spot. Now, Spot could act funny and run around with a new collar. Spot and Fluffy were very happy.

Anna and Ben were playing with their dolls and cars in the living room. They liked to pretend that they were a king and a queen, and that their toys were their subjects. They made up rules and stories for their kingdom, and had fun dressing up and acting out different scenes.
"Queen Anna, I have a gift for you," Ben said, holding up a shiny necklace that he found in his mom's jewelry box. "It is very pretty and sparkly, like you."
"Thank you, King Ben," Anna said, smiling and putting on the necklace. "You are very kind and jolly, like a good king should be."
They hugged and kissed, and then continued their play. They decided to have a tea party with their dolls and cars, and invited their stuffed animals as well. They poured water from a plastic pitcher into plastic cups, and pretended to eat cookies and cakes from a plastic plate.
"Queen Anna, do you like the tea?" Ben asked, sipping his cup.
"Yes, King Ben, it is very yummy," Anna said, nodding her head. "But you know what? This necklace reminds me of something."
"What does it remind you of, Queen Anna?" Ben asked, curious.
"It reminds me of Mommy," Anna said, touching the necklace. "She always wears a necklace like this when she goes out with Daddy. She says it is her favorite."
"Me too, Queen Anna," Ben said, agreeing. "I like Mommy's necklace. It makes her look very pretty and happy."
They looked at each other, and then at the clock. They realized that it was almost time for Mommy and Daddy to come home from work. They quickly put away their toys and their costumes, and ran to the door to wait for them. They wanted to show them their necklace, and tell them about their king and queen game. They knew that Mommy and Daddy would be proud and happy, and that they would hug and kiss them, just like a king and a queen.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim lived in a big city with his mom and dad. He was a lucky boy because he had many friends to play with.
One day, Tim went to the park with his friend, Sue. They played on the swings and the slide. Sue said, "I love the park, but sometimes I don't like the city. It's too noisy." Tim looked at her and said, "I don't complain. I feel lucky to live in the city with my friends."
Sue smiled and said, "You're right, Tim. We are lucky to have each other and this fun park." They played some more and had a great day. From that day on, Sue never complained about the city again.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max wanted to go to the park to play with his friends. He saw a taxi on the street and thought it could take him there.
Max asked the taxi driver, "Can you take me to the park, please?" The taxi driver replied, "Yes, little dog, I can take you there." Max was very happy and got into the taxi.
But the taxi driver was not nice. He took Max far away from the park. Max was sad and scared. He did not know how to get back home. The taxi driver left Max in a place he did not know, and Max could not find his way back to his family.

Once upon a time, there was a doctor. The doctor was sad. He had a big mess in his room. He did not know what to do.
One day, a cat came in. The cat saw the mess. The cat started to wash the mess. The doctor was very happy. He thought the cat was magic.
But the cat was not magic. The cat had a secret. It was a mom cat. The mom cat brought her kittens to help. The kittens washed the mess too. The doctor was not sad anymore. They all became friends.

Once there was a girl who lived in an igloo very far away. She loved to play outside in the snow. One day she went out to play, but it was very hot. The sun was shining and the snow was starting to melt. The girl slipped and fell into a big pile of melting snow.
She felt scared and embarrassed. She didn't know what to do, so she decided to hide under her igloo. She stayed there for a long time until the sun went down and it got cooler. When it finally got dark, she came out from her igloo and felt much better. She had learned that sometimes when it's hot outside you just have to find a cool place to hide.

Once upon a time, there was a little bug. The bug had a friend, a tall bird. The bird could fly high in the sky. The bug wanted to fly high too, but it could only crawl on the ground.
One day, the bird said, "Bug, I will help you go high. Hop on my back, and we will fly together." The bug was very happy and jumped onto the bird's back. They flew high in the sky. The bug could see the whole world from up there.
At the end of the day, the bird took the bug back to the ground. The bug said, "Thank you, bird, for helping me fly high. I had so much fun!" The bird smiled and said, "You're welcome, bug. We can fly high together again soon." And from that day on, the bug and the bird were the best of friends.

Lily and Ben were playing with their toys in the living room. Lily had a doll with a pretty cloth dress and Ben had a truck with big wheels. They were having fun, but they also wanted to see what the other had.
"Can I see your doll?" Ben asked Lily.
"OK, but be careful. She is my favorite," Lily said and handed him the doll.
Ben took the doll and looked at her. He liked her cloth dress, but he wanted to see what was under it. He pulled the dress off the doll and saw that she had a chubby body.
"Ha ha, your doll is chubby!" Ben laughed and threw the dress away.
"Hey, don't do that! You are destroying my doll!" Lily cried and tried to get the dress back.
But Ben was faster and ran away with the doll. He wanted to see if the truck could run over her. He put the doll on the floor and drove the truck towards her.
"Stop, stop, stop!" Lily shouted and ran after him.
But it was too late. The truck hit the doll and broke her head. The doll was destroyed.
Lily saw what happened and started to cry. She was very sad and angry. She loved her doll and Ben had ruined her.
"Ben, you are mean! You destroyed my doll! I hate you!" Lily yelled and hit Ben with her fist.
Ben felt the hit and dropped the doll. He was surprised and scared. He didn't mean to destroy the doll. He just wanted to play.
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!" Ben said and tried to hug Lily.
But Lily pushed him away. She didn't want his hug. She wanted her doll back.
"Go away, Ben! You are not my friend anymore!" Lily said and picked up the doll.
She hugged the doll and ran to her room. She closed the door and cried. She wished she had never let Ben see her doll.

Once upon a time, there was a big, rough dog named Max. Max liked to play outside and get dirty. One day, Max saw a door open just a little bit. He wanted to see what was inside, so he took a peek.
Inside the door, Max saw a room called an office. There were lots of things in the office. There was a chair, a desk, and a big box with buttons. Max was curious and wanted to play with the buttons.
Max jumped on the chair and pushed the buttons on the big box. The big box made a funny noise. Max was happy and wagged his tail. Then, Max's mom came into the office and saw him playing. She laughed and gave Max a big hug. They played together in the office and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, a boy named Tim went on a safari with his mom and dad. They saw many animals like lions, elephants, and monkeys. Tim was very happy because he loved animals.
One day, they saw a sweet baby monkey all alone. Tim said, "Can we take the baby monkey home, please?" His mom said, "No, Tim. We can't replace its family. It has to stay here."
But Tim didn't listen. He took the baby monkey when no one was looking. When they went home, the baby monkey was sad and missed its family. Tim felt bad and knew it was wrong to take the baby monkey away from its home.
In the end, Tim and his family went back to the safari to return the baby monkey. But they couldn't find its family. The baby monkey stayed sad and alone, and Tim learned that he should always listen to his mom and dad.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a delicate bird named Bella. Bella was very pretty and loved to zip around the town. One day, while flying, she saw a big pile of coal.
Bella met a little boy named Tim. Tim said, "Bella, don't touch the coal. It will make you dirty." Bella did not listen to Tim and went to play with the coal.
Bella played with the coal and got very dirty. She tried to zip away, but she was too heavy from the coal. The people in the town could not help Bella. Bella was sad and could not fly anymore.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play outside. He saw a wet dog. The dog was very honest and nice. Tim wanted to play with the dog, but he forgets his toy ball at home. So, Tim and the dog played with a stick instead.
While they were playing, something unexpected happened. A big bird came and took the stick away. Tim and the dog were sad. They did not know what to do.
Then, the bird came back with the stick and a toy ball. The bird was honest and wanted to play too. Tim, the dog, and the bird played together all day. They had lots of fun and became good friends.

Once upon a time, there were two friends who were very creative. They loved to unpack things to see what was inside. One day, they decided to unpack their lunch box. Inside, the friends found lots of yummy food including butter.
The friends got so excited that they started to play with the butter. They made funny shapes with it and had a lot of fun. But then things started to go wrong. The butter got all over their clothes and all over the lunch box. It was a big mess.
The friends soon realized that playing with butter was not a good idea. So they started to clean up the mess. In the end, they had to throw away the lunch box because it was too messy. They were so sad and knew they should have been more creative by just eating the butter instead of playing with it.

One day, a brown dog named Max went to the park. He saw a big rocket. Max wanted to play with the rocket. He ran to it and tried to push it. But the rocket did not move. Max was sad.
A little boy named Tim saw Max. Tim said, "Max, you need to listen to me. I can help you play with the rocket." Max wagged his tail and listened to Tim. Tim told Max to jump on the rocket. Max jumped and the rocket moved a little. They both laughed and played together.
Soon, it was time to go home. Max and Tim said goodbye to the rocket. They learned that it is good to listen to friends. Friends can help you when you have a problem. And when you listen, you can have more fun together.

Once upon a time there was a panda. He wanted to go places but he was very stupid. He said to himself, "I am stupid so I can't go anywhere".
But one day, something amazing happened. A little girl came and said to the panda "come with me!". The panda was surprised, but he said yes and he went with the little girl.
They went walking together in the forest and the panda saw lots of different animals. They just had lots of fun together! The panda was so happy to be able to go with the little girl.
Then they reached a big waterfall and the little girl said, "Let's go swimming!". The panda was so excited. He jumped in the water with the little girl and together they had a great time.
At the end of the day, the little girl said goodbye to the panda. "I'm so glad we were able to go today!", said the panda. The little girl smiled and the two of them said goodbye.

One day, a little girl named Lucy and her mom went to the zoo. They saw many animals like big elephants, tall giraffes, and funny monkeys. Lucy was very happy.
At the zoo, Lucy saw a small toy elephant. She wanted it so much. She took the toy without asking her mom. Her mom saw her and said, "Lucy, you should not take things without asking. That is not nice."
Lucy felt sorry. She said, "I am sorry, Mom. I will not do it again." Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lucy. Just remember to ask next time." They put the toy back and kept looking at the animals. They had a great day at the zoo.

Once upon a time, there was a sweet penguin named Pippin. Pippin lived in a cold place with lots of ice and snow. He had many friends and they liked to play all day.
One day, Pippin and his friends found a big box. They were very excited and wanted to open it. They all tried to open the box together. They pushed and pulled, but the box would not open.
Then, Pippin had an idea. He asked his big friend, the whale, to help them open the box. The whale was very strong and with one big push, the box opened! Inside the box, there were lots of toys and treats for all the animals to share. Pippin and his friends were so happy and they played with their new toys all day long.

One day, a boy named Tim was eating his lunch. His mom gave him a dish with food. Tim did not like the food. It was dry and not yummy. He started to complain.
"Mom, I don't like this food," Tim said. "It's too dry and not good."
His mom said, "Okay, Tim. I will make something else for you."
Just then, something unexpected happened. A small bird flew into the house. The bird was very hungry. It saw the dry food on Tim's dish and ate it all up. The bird was very happy.
"Wow," said Tim, "the bird liked my food!" His mom smiled and said, "Sometimes, what we don't like can be good for others."
From that day on, Tim did not complain about his food. He knew that someone else might like it.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful girl named Sue. She loved to read books. One day, she found a big book about pepper.
Sue read the book and learned that pepper is a food. It can make things taste good. Sue wanted to try pepper. She asked her mom for some.
Her mom gave her some pepper. Sue put it on her food. She liked it! Sue was happy she read the book. Now she knew about pepper and could be helpful in the kitchen.

Once upon a time there was a kind girl called Lucy. Everywhere she went she rolled and laughed. She loved everyone and everyone loved her back!
One day, Lucy went for a walk in the park. She saw a big ball and started rolling it around. Then all of a sudden, a friendly dog came running along and joined her. They played together and the dog rolled the ball back to her every time.
The two of them played together until the sun went down. Lucy and the dog said goodbye before they each went their separate ways.
As she walked home, Lucy knew that she had made a new friend. She felt so much love in her heart and was so happy that she had found someone so kind.

One day, a big jeep went down the road. It was blue and shiny. A little boy named Tim saw the jeep and wanted to show it to his friend, Sue. Tim ran to Sue's house and told her about the jeep.
Sue and Tim went outside to see the jeep. The jeep stopped, and a nice man got out. He had a big bag of sour candy. The man asked, "Do you like sour candy?" Tim and Sue said, "Yes, we do!"
The man gave Tim and Sue some sour candy. They said, "Thank you!" and waved goodbye. The man got in the jeep and drove away. Tim and Sue ate the sour candy and smiled. They were happy they got to see the jeep and eat the sour candy.

Sam and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big tire in the grass. It is unknown. They do not know who put it there.
"Look, a tire!" Sam says. "Let's roll it!"
"OK!" Tom says. They push the tire and it rolls fast. They laugh and run after it.
But the tire rolls too fast. It goes to the road. There are cars on the road. The cars do not see the tire.
"Stop, tire, stop!" Sam and Tom yell. They are scared. They want to tell someone to help.
A man sees the tire. He is a policeman. He has a whistle. He blows the whistle loud. The cars stop. The tire stops too.
The policeman picks up the tire. He walks to Sam and Tom. He is not happy.
"Who does this tire belong to?" he asks.
Sam and Tom look at each other. They do not know what to say. They are sorry.
The policeman tells them, "This tire is dangerous. It could hurt someone. You should not play with it. You should play with safe things."
Sam and Tom nod. They say, "We are sorry, sir. We did not know. We will not do it again."
The policeman gives them a smile. He says, "It's OK. I'm glad you are OK. But next time, be careful. And if you see something unknown, tell an adult."
Sam and Tom say, "Yes, sir. Thank you, sir."
They go back to the park. They play with safe things. They do not play with unknown things. They are happy.

One day, a big, old turkey lived on a farm. The turkey liked to walk around and talk to his friends. He had a friend named Duck. Duck and Turkey liked to play together.
One day, Duck said, "Let's go swim in the pond." Turkey said, "No, I can't swim." Duck insisted, "But it's fun! You will like it." Turkey was scared, but he wanted to try.
So, Turkey and Duck went to the pond. Duck helped Turkey learn to swim. Turkey was happy and said, "Thank you, Duck! I like swimming now." They played in the pond all day and had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a big house with a warm fireplace. In the house lived a kind man, a sad woman, and a little girl. The woman was often miserable because she missed her family. The kind man and the little girl wanted to make her smile.
One cold day, the kind man and the little girl had an idea. They made a beautiful picture for the sad woman. They drew a big heart and wrote "thank you" inside it. They put the picture near the fireplace to surprise the sad woman.
When the sad woman saw the picture, she smiled and hugged the kind man and the little girl. They all sat by the fireplace, feeling warm and happy. The sad woman learned to be thankful for her new family. The moral of the story is that saying "thank you" can make someone feel better and bring people closer together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a cute dog named Max. Max was a good dog, but sometimes he liked to run away. This made Sue feel frustrated.
One day, Sue's mom gave her a leash for Max. She said, "Sue, use this leash to keep Max close to you." Sue was very happy. She put the leash on Max and took him for a walk.
As they walked, Max saw a big ball. He wanted to play with it. But now, Max could not run away because of the leash. Sue and Max played with the ball together. They had lots of fun. Sue was not frustrated anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He loved to draw on pages. One day, he found a big, fine book with many empty pages. Tom was very happy and he started to draw on the pages.
Tom drew a big, strong monster on one of the pages. The monster came to life! The monster started to destroy things in Tom's room. Tom was scared and did not know what to do.
Tom had an idea. He took a new page and drew a big, fine cage. The cage came to life too! Tom put the cage on the monster, and the monster was trapped. Tom learned that his drawings could be powerful, so he promised to be careful with his art.

John woke up and got ready for a big day. He quickly chose his favorite outfit and dressed himself. He looked in the mirror, smiled, and grabbed his backpack.
John's parents told him that he was going on an important bus ride. John wasn't sure what "important" meant, but he was excited to find out. He ran out of the house and hopped on the bus before it drove away.
The bus drove for what seemed like a long time, stopping at each stop to pick up more people. John saw a lot of interesting things out the window. Finally, the bus arrived at its destination.
John stepped off the bus and looked around. He saw a building with a lot of people and flags in front of it. He realized he was at a very important place. John was visiting an important government building to meet an important leader!
John remembered why he was there, stood up straight and smiled. He was ready to show everyone how important he was.

One day, a gorilla was in the forest. He liked to zoom from tree to tree. He was very fast and strong. Other animals liked to watch him.
One day, a little bird wanted to zoom like the gorilla. The bird said, "Can you teach me to zoom like you?" The gorilla smiled and said, "It is not easy, but I will try to help you."
The gorilla showed the bird how to zoom. The bird tried and tried, but it was not easy. The gorilla said, "Do not give up. Keep trying." The bird kept trying and got better and better.
In the end, the bird could zoom like the gorilla. The bird was very happy and thanked the gorilla. The other animals clapped and cheered.
The moral of the story is to never give up and always help others.

Anna loves to watch videos on her tablet. She likes to see animals, songs and stories. Sometimes, she watches too much and does not want to stop. Her mom tells her to turn off the tablet and play with her toys or read a book. But Anna does not listen. She insists on watching more videos.
"Anna, it is time to stop watching videos. You have watched enough. You need to do something else," her mom says.
"No, mom, I want to watch more. Just one more video, please. It is very fun," Anna says.
"Anna, you are being stubborn. Watching too much videos is not good for you. It can hurt your eyes and your brain. You have so many other things to do. You can play with your blocks, or your dolls, or your puzzles. You can draw a picture, or make a craft, or sing a song. You can be very clever and creative," her mom says.
"But mom, I like videos. They are also clever and creative. They teach me new things and make me laugh. Please, mom, just one more video," Anna says.
"Anna, I understand that you like videos, but you have to learn to balance your time. You can watch some videos, but not all the time. You have to share your time with other activities that are good for you. How about this? You can watch one more video, but only if you promise to do something else after. You can choose what you want to do, but you have to do it for at least 15 minutes. Do we have a deal?" her mom says.
Anna thinks for a moment. She really wants to watch one more video, but she also knows that her mom is right. She decides to agree with her mom. She says, "OK, mom, we have a deal. I will watch one more video, and then I will do something else. I will play with my puzzles. They are also clever and fun."
"Good, Anna, I am proud of you. You are a smart and good girl. You can watch your video now, but remember our deal. When the video is over, you have to turn off the tablet and play with your puzzles. OK?" her mom says.
"OK, mom, I will. Thank you, mom. I love you," Anna says.
"I love you too, Anna. Enjoy your video," her mom says.

Once upon a time, there was a sailor named Tom. He lived by the sea in a gloomy little house. One day, Tom saw a big ship. He wanted to sail on it, but the ship's captain said, "No, you can't sail with us."
Tom was sad, but he had an idea. He would make a yummy cake for the captain. He thought, "If the captain tastes my cake, he will let me sail with him." So, Tom made the best cake he could.
Tom gave the cake to the captain. The captain tasted it and said, "This is the best cake ever! You can sail with us!" Tom was so happy. He got on the ship and sailed away with the captain and his new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely little girl named Lily. She had no friends to play with. One day, she went to the park to find someone to play with. There, she saw a boy named Tom.
Lily went up to Tom and said, "Hi, I'm Lily. Do you want to play with me?" Tom looked at her and said, "Yes, but we have to measure how far we can jump first." Lily and Tom took turns jumping and measuring their jumps.
While they were playing, another girl named Jane came over. She wanted to play too, but she didn't want to share. Jane said, "I want to play with Tom, but not with you, Lily." This made Lily sad.
Tom didn't like that Jane was being mean to Lily. He said, "No, Jane. We can all play together and be friends." Jane thought about it and agreed to play with both Lily and Tom.
From that day on, Lily, Tom, and Jane played together at the park every day. They learned to share and have fun together. Lily wasn't lonely anymore, and they all became best friends.
