One day, a little spider went for a long walk. The spider saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. The spider started to climb, but it was a struggle. The tree was very tall, and the spider was very small.
"Help me!" the spider said to a bird. The bird flew down and said, "I can help you, little spider!" The bird picked up the spider in its beak and put it on the top of the tree.
At the top of the tree, the spider saw a big surprise. There was a party with many other spiders! The little spider was so happy. It danced and played with the other spiders all day long. The bird had helped the spider find new friends.

Lily was a little girl who liked to play with her toys. She had many toys on her shelf in her room. She had dolls, cars, blocks, and books. She loved her toys very much.
One day, Lily's mom told her to behave and not touch the oven. The oven was hot and could hurt her. Lily's mom was baking a cake for Lily's dad. Lily nodded and said she would behave. She went to her room to play with her toys.
But Lily was curious. She wanted to see the cake. She wanted to smell the cake. She wanted to taste the cake. She thought her mom would not notice. She sneaked out of her room and went to the kitchen. She saw the oven. She saw the timer. She saw the cake inside.
Lily reached for the oven door. She did not listen to her mom. She did not behave. She did not know the oven was very hot. She burned her hand. She screamed. She dropped the oven door. The cake fell out. The cake was ruined.
Lily's mom heard the scream. She ran to the kitchen. She saw Lily. She saw the oven. She saw the cake. She was angry. She was sad. She was worried. She hugged Lily. She scolded Lily. She took Lily to the doctor. Lily cried. She was sorry. She learned her lesson. She wished she had behaved.

One day, a little girl named Amy was playing with her ball in the park. She saw a big tree with a bird on the tip of a branch. Amy was nervous because she thought the bird might fall. She asked her mom, "What if the bird falls?"
Her mom answered, "Don't worry, the bird is safe up there. It knows how to fly and take care of itself." Amy felt better, but she still watched the bird.
Suddenly, a strong wind blew, and the bird lost its balance. But instead of falling, the bird spread its wings and flew away. Amy was surprised and happy to see the bird was okay. She learned that sometimes things look scary, but they can still be okay in the end.

Tom and Lily are friends. They like to play in the field near their house. The field has many flowers and bugs and birds. Sometimes they see a cow or a horse.
One day, they find a seat in the field. It is a big seat made of wood and metal. It has four legs and a back. But one leg is broken and the seat is not straight. Tom and Lily think it is a fun seat. They take turns to sit on it and pretend to fly or drive or sail.
But then, a big boy comes to the field. He is older and taller than Tom and Lily. He sees the seat and he wants it. He says, "This is my seat. Go away. You are too small to play with it."
Tom and Lily are scared and sad. They do not want to go away. They like the seat. They say, "No, this is our seat. We found it first. You are mean and rude."
The big boy gets angry and pushes Tom and Lily off the seat. He sits on it and laughs. He says, "This is my seat. I am bigger and stronger than you. You are silly and weak."
Tom and Lily are hurt and angry. They want to get the seat back. They look around and see a big stick. They pick it up and run to the seat. They hit the seat with the stick. The seat makes a loud noise and breaks more. The big boy falls off the seat and cries. He runs away.
Tom and Lily are happy and proud. They say, "We did it. We got the seat back. He is gone. He is a bully and a coward."
They hug each other and smile. They do not want the seat anymore. It is too broken and dangerous. They leave it in the field and go to play with the flowers and bugs and birds. They are friends. They are brave and kind.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play with her friends in the yard. One day, Kitty saw a band of ants. They were working together to provide food for their family.
Kitty thought it was fun to watch the ants, so she sat and watched them every day. She saw the ants work hard and provide lots of food for their family. Kitty wanted to help the ants, but she did not know how.
One day, a big rain came and washed away the ants' home. The little ants were sad and did not know what to do. Kitty remembered how the ants worked together to provide food. She knew she could help them. Kitty found a dry spot for the ants to make a new home. The ants were happy and thanked Kitty for her help. From that day on, Kitty and the ants were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily had a weird toy. The toy would shiver when Lily touched it. One day, Lily found a diary under her bed. She opened the diary and saw many drawings.
Lily showed the diary to her mom. "Mom, look at this!" she said. Her mom looked at the diary and smiled. "This is your big sister's diary, Lily. She drew these pictures when she was your age."
Lily thought it was fun to look at the drawings. She wanted to show her sister. She went to her sister's room and said, "Look, I found your diary!" Her sister laughed and said, "Wow, I forgot about that!"
Together, Lily and her sister looked at the drawings in the diary. They laughed and had a great time. Lily's sister even showed her how to draw some new pictures. From that day on, they shared the diary and drew pictures together.

Once upon a time, there was a small jeep. The jeep was fearful. It did not like to go fast. One day, the jeep met a big truck. The truck was not fearful. The truck liked to go fast.
The truck wanted to show the jeep how to go fast. The jeep was scared, but it wanted to try. The truck and the jeep went on a race. The truck went very fast. The jeep tried to go fast too.
But the jeep was too fearful. It went too fast and could not stop. The jeep hit a big tree. The jeep was broken and sad. The truck did not show the jeep how to be safe. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to dress up in her favorite clothes. One day, she put on her incredible costume. It was a police uniform!
Lucy went outside to play. She pretended to be a police officer, helping her friends and keeping everyone safe. She was very good at her job. All her friends thought she was the best police officer they had ever seen.
At the end of the day, Lucy went back home. She was very happy and proud of herself. Her mom and dad gave her a big hug, telling her she was an incredible police officer. Lucy smiled and knew that one day, she would grow up to be a real police officer, just like in her favorite costume.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a big box. He wanted to see if he could fit in the box. So, he got in and he fit! Tim was very happy. He played in the box all day.
Tim found a cherry tree near the box. The cherries were red and yummy. He picked some cherries and put them in his box. Tim ate the cherries and they were so sweet.
Then, something unexpected happened. A broken toy car rolled into the box. Tim was sad because it was broken. But, when he touched the toy car, it started to work again! The toy car was not broken anymore. Tim was very happy and played with the toy car and cherries in his big box.

One day, a big, strong bus went down the road. The bus was very happy. It liked to help people go places. The bus would stop, open its doors, and let people get on.
At one stop, a little boy got on the bus. He was scared. He had never been on a bus before. The strong bus saw the boy and wanted to help. The bus said, "Don't be scared. I will take you where you need to go."
The little boy felt better. He sat down and enjoyed the ride. When it was time to get off, the strong bus said, "Here is your stop. Have a good day!" The little boy smiled and said, "Thank you, strong bus!" The bus was very happy to help the little boy.

Tom and Mia were playing in the yard. They had a big box and some sticks. They wanted to make a house.
"I will serve you tea," Mia said. She had a cup and a spoon. She pretended to pour water from a can.
"Thank you," Tom said. He had a saw and a hammer. He pretended to cut and nail the sticks. "This will be a nice house."
They worked and played until it was dark. The sky was black and the stars were bright. They heard a noise from the bushes.
"What is that?" Mia asked. She was scared.
"Maybe it is a bear," Tom said. He was brave. He picked up his saw and held it like a sword.
They saw two yellow eyes and a big nose. It was not a bear. It was their dog, Rex. He came out of the bushes and wagged his tail.
"Rex!" Tom and Mia said. They were happy. They hugged their dog and gave him some tea.
"Let's go inside," Tom said. "It is too dark to play."
"Okay," Mia said. "But we can play again tomorrow."
They took their box and their sticks and their dog. They went inside their real house. They had dinner and a bath and a story. They went to bed and dreamed of their house.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tom. Tom was eager to get a new toy. He wanted a toy vehicle more than anything in the world.
One day, Tom's mom took him to the toy store. Tom was so happy to see all the toy vehicles. There were big ones and small ones, red ones and blue ones. Tom could not decide which one he wanted.
Finally, Tom picked a green toy vehicle. He was so eager to play with it. Tom and his mom went home, and Tom played with his new toy all day long. Tom was very happy to get his new toy vehicle, and he loved it very much.

Once upon a time, there was a little farm. On the farm, there was a big red barn. In the barn, there was a lot of hay for the animals to eat and sleep on.
One day, a small mouse found a cheap toy in the hay. It was a tiny car. The mouse liked to play with the car in the hay. But one day, the mouse lost the car. He was very sad.
The mouse had a friend, a kind cow. The cow saw the mouse was sad and asked, "Why are you sad, little mouse?" The mouse told the cow about the lost car. The cow said, "I will help you find it." They looked and looked, but they could not find the car. The mouse was still sad, but he knew the cow tried to help. The mouse said, "I forgive you, cow. Thank you for trying to help me." The cow and the mouse stayed friends and played in the hay together.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Max and Jane. They were nice and loved to play together. One day, Max and Jane decided to mix some colored paints and create something new.
Max said, "Let's make a picture!" But Jane said, "How can I help you?"
Max replied, "You can find the bandage and put it into the mixture."
Max mixed the colors and Jane helped him.
When the colors got mixed, it looked like a beautiful rainbow! They were so excited to see the rainbow they made. But then, something very bad happened.
The bandage had not been taken out and it stuck in the paint. Max and Jane could not take it out. They begun to cry as they did not know what to do.
But then they remembered that they had a brush. Max used it to remove the bandage from the mixture.
Max and Jane were so happy that they hugged each other. They were relieved to see the nice rainbow again.
The two friends enjoyed the rainbow and hugged each other for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there were two friends who did everything together. Their names were Mandy and Sammy. They liked to explore different areas and see what they could find. One day while they were walking, Mandy spotted something in the distance.
Mandy said, “Sammy, what’s that?”
Sammy looked over and replied, “It looks like some kind of pattern.”
Mandy was excited and said, “Let’s go check it out!” So the two of them started walking towards the pattern. As they got closer, Sammy said, “I think it’s a gray pattern.”
Mandy was even more excited and said, “Let’s hurry!” They ran all the way there, but when they got to the pattern, they were surprised. The pattern was actually moving in an orderly fashion, like it was under some kind of order.
Mandy and Sammy looked at each other. Suddenly, Mandy said, “I bet if we follow this pattern, it will lead us somewhere!” Sammy agreed and the two of them started following the gray pattern. They followed the pattern all the way to where it was leading: an amazing playground!
“We need to remember this pattern so we can come back again,” said Sammy, and the two of them

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy cat named Tom. Tom lived in a small house with his best friend, a little girl named Sue. One day, Tom saw a tie hanging on a chair. He thought it would be fun to play with the tie.
Tom jumped and grabbed the tie with his mouth. He pulled and pulled until the tie fell on the floor. Tom was so happy and started to play with the tie. Sue saw Tom playing and said, "Tom, be careful with my dad's tie!"
But Tom did not listen. He played with the tie all day, until it was time for bed. Sue was sleepy too, so she went to her room and covered herself with a blanket. Tom, still playing with the tie, accidentally pulled it under the blanket with him.
In the middle of the night, Tom woke up feeling scared. He couldn't move because the tie was wrapped around him! He tried to call for Sue, but she was too sleepy to hear him. Tom stayed stuck in the tie all night, and in the morning, Sue found him and helped him get free. But the tie was ruined, and Sue's dad was very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to decorate her room with pretty things. One day, she found a shiny jewel in her toy box. She was very happy and wanted to show it to her friend, Tom.
Sue ran to Tom's house and said, "Look, Tom! I found a shiny jewel! Let's decorate my room with it!" Tom looked at the jewel and said, "Sue, I think this jewel is fake. But it is still pretty. We can use it to make your room look nice."
Sue and Tom went to her room and decorated it with the fake jewel. They had a lot of fun. When they were done, Sue's mom came in and said, "Your room looks very nice! I am happy you had fun with your friend, Tom."
Sue learned that even if something is not real, it can still be fun and make things look pretty. The moral of the story is that it's not always about having real things, but about having fun and being happy with what you have.

Once upon a time, there was a big yellow banana. The banana lived in a nice fruit bowl with other fruits. They were all friends and liked to play games together.
One day, the banana said to the apple, "Let's have a race!" The apple agreed, and they started to roll down the table. The banana was winning, but then it slipped and fell. All the other fruits laughed at the banana. The banana felt embarrass.
Later, the orange came to the banana and said, "Don't feel bad. We all make mistakes." The banana smiled and thanked the orange. They all played together again, and the banana was happy.

One day, a ball named Bounce went to the harbor. The harbor was a place where boats lived. Bounce saw the water and the boats. He thought it was amazing.
Bounce met a boat named Bob. "Hi, I am Bounce," said Bounce. "Hi, I am Bob," said Bob. Bounce and Bob became friends. They played all day at the harbor.
Bounce liked to bounce on the ground. Bob liked to watch Bounce bounce. Bounce and Bob had a lot of fun at the harbor. They were happy friends.

One day, a modest boy named Tim went to the park. He loved to play with his red flag. He would run fast and watch the flag wave in the wind. When he arrived at the park, he saw a girl named Sue playing with her blue ball.
"Hi, Sue! Would you like to play with my flag?" Tim asked. Sue smiled and said, "Yes, I would love to!"
As they played together, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and took the red flag high up into the sky. Tim and Sue were very sad. They tried to jump and catch the flag, but it was too high.
Just then, a kind bird flew by and saw the red flag. The bird grabbed the flag with its beak and brought it back down to Tim and Sue. They were so happy! They thanked the bird and continued to play with the flag and the blue ball. From that day on, Tim and Sue became the best of friends.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a snake on the grass. Tim wanted to touch the snake, but his mom said, "No, Tim! Don't touch the snake. It could be bitter and mean."
Tim was sad, but he listened to his mom. They walked away from the snake. Suddenly, the snake started to talk! "Wait!" said the snake. "I am not a bitter snake. I am nice. I just want to be friends."
Tim and his mom were very surprised. They did not know that snakes could talk. They said sorry to the snake and became friends. They all played in the park together and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom loved to play with his baseball. One sunny day, Tom went to the park to play. He saw an interesting bug on the ground. Tom wanted to step on the bug.
Tom's friend, Sam, saw what Tom was going to do. "No, Tom! Don't step on the bug!" Sam said. Tom stopped and listened to Sam. Sam told Tom that bugs are important too, and they should not hurt them.
Tom learned that every living thing is important. He did not step on the bug. Instead, Tom and Sam played with the baseball together. They had a lot of fun. From that day on, Tom knew that he should be kind to all living things.

Once upon a time, in a calm little town, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her toys and have fun with her friends. One day, her teacher gave her a quiz at school. Lily was a little scared, but she knew she could do it.
After school, Lily went home and asked her mom for help. "Mom, can you help me remove the hard parts from my quiz?" she asked. Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Lily! Let's do it together."
They sat down and worked on the quiz. Lily felt happy and calm with her mom's help. When they finished, Lily thanked her mom and gave her a big hug. The next day, Lily took the quiz to school, and she did a great job!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She had a toy bunny that she loved very much. One day, Mia and her bunny went to play outside.
While they were playing, the bunny got caught on a small needle. The needle made a hole in the bunny, and some of its stuffing came out. Mia saw this and felt very sad. She picked up her bunny and said, "Oh no, bunny! We need to fix you!"
Mia's mom saw her sad face and asked, "What's wrong, Mia?" Mia showed her mom the hole in her bunny. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Mia. We can fix it!" They both went inside and her mom took out a needle and thread.
Mia's mom started to sew the hole in the bunny. Mia watched her mom fix her bunny and felt happy. She said, "Thank you, mom! Bunny is all better now!" They both smiled and Mia gave her mom a big hug.
After that, Mia and her bunny went back outside to play. They were careful not to let the bunny get caught on anything sharp again. Mia was happy that her bunny was fixed, and they played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a regular boy named Mark. Mark liked to eat avocados. One day, he found a big avocado tree. It had many avocados. Mark was very happy.
But there was a problem. A big bird lived in the tree. The big bird did not like Mark. The bird said, "You can't have my avocados!" Mark was sad. He wanted the avocados very much.
Mark tried to get the avocados when the bird was not looking. But the bird saw him. The bird was very mad. It flew down and took Mark's hat. Mark was sad and ran away. He did not get any avocados.

Once upon a time there was a nice girl called Amy. She was playing in her garden and she saw a pretty plant. She kneeled down and couldn't stop looking.
Amy said, "Oh, this plant is so nice!"
All of a sudden, the plant started to fall from the ground. Amy ran towards the plant and tried to catch it. But it was too late.
Amy said sadly, "Oh no, the plant fell down."
Luckily, the plant wasn't damaged and it was still nice. Amy was happy and gently put the plant back into the ground. She said, "Now it won't fall again!"
The end.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a boy named Tom. Tom was scared of the dark. He thought there was a ghost in his room. Every night, he would hide under his blanket and remain very still.
One night, Tom heard a noise. He peeked out from his blanket and saw an icy ghost. The ghost was cold and blue. Tom was so scared, he wanted to cry. But the ghost said, "Don't be scared, I am a nice ghost."
Tom and the ghost talked for a bit. The ghost told Tom he was lost and needed help. Tom was brave and helped the ghost find his way home. From that night on, Tom was no longer scared of the dark. He knew that even ghosts can be nice friends.

One day, a pink cat and a green dog were playing in the park. They saw a big lime tree. The cat said, "Let's eat some limes!" The dog agreed, and they both picked some limes from the tree.
As they were eating the limes, the sun got very hot. The cat started to feel funny. "I think I am melting!" the cat said. The dog looked at the cat and saw that the pink cat was turning into a pink puddle.
The dog was scared but knew what to do. He ran to the lime tree and picked more limes. He squeezed the limes on the pink puddle. The lime juice made the cat feel better, and she stopped melting.
The cat and the dog learned that it is important to help each other when they are in trouble. They also learned that sometimes, something unexpected like lime juice can save the day. And they played in the park happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a tall man. He was walking along when he saw a yellow sign. He stopped and looked at it. It had a big, zigzag line on it. He decided to follow the line.
So he started walking and the line got bigger and bigger and bigger and bigger. Soon he was climbing up a really tall hill. At the very top of the hill was another sign. He reached out and touched it.
When he touched it, he was sent flying in the air. He flew zigzagging all over the sky. It was so fun! He flew up, down, round and round. Up, down, round and round.
Finally, he flew back to the big yellow sign he had first seen. He waved goodbye and flew away. He had a really good time flying zigzag through the sky.

Once upon a time there was a brave cow. She lived in a big, green field with all of her farm friends.
One day, while she was walking in the field, she heard a strange noise. She stopped to have a look and saw the refrigerator shaking. It was trembling!
The cow was scared, but determined to find out what was happening. So, she bravely stepped forward and said, "Why are you trembling?"
The refrigerator answered back in a shaky voice, "I'm scared of the storm coming."
The brave cow knew she had to help the refrigerator. She said, "Let's go find a safe place together - then you won't have to tremble anymore."
The cow and the refrigerator ran off together, hand in hand. They found a safe spot until the storm had passed.
Since that day, the cow and the refrigerator are good friends. They spend their days playing games and helping each other out whenever one of them needs a hand.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mary. Mary was three years old and she loved to play. Every day, she would play with her toys and make them as clean as she could.
One day, Mary was getting her toys ready for play. She noticed something strange with her doll, Lucy. She saw that Lucy was very wet. Mary had to find a way to dry her.
She asked her mom: ''Mom, how can I dry Lucy?''
Her mom answered: ''Switch on the hairdryer. It'll help your doll to become dry.''
Mary happily followed her mom's instructions. She switched on the hairdryer. Soon, the hairdryer made Lucy nice and dry. She was as clean as she could be.
Mary was very happy. She gave Lucy a big hug and they started playing together.
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big red engine. It was very important. The engine had a job to save people. It was always ready to go.
One day, the engine heard a loud noise. It was a cat stuck in a tree. The engine went to save the cat. It put out its long ladder and the cat climbed down. The cat was safe now.
But then, something unexpected happened. The cat jumped back up the tree! The engine was confused. It saved the cat again. This time, the cat stayed on the ground. The engine and the cat became good friends. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to joke and play with his friends. They would run, jump, and laugh together in the park.
One sunny day, Buddy saw a fly. He tried to catch it, but the fly was too fast. Buddy jumped high and ran fast, but the fly always got away. Buddy's friends laughed and joked as they watched him try to catch the fly.
Then, something unexpected happened. The fly stopped and looked at Buddy. The fly said, "I like your jokes, Buddy. I want to be your friend." Buddy was surprised. He never knew that a fly could talk. They became friends and played together in the park every day. And that is how Buddy the dependable dog and the talking fly became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a wild forest, there lived a humble bunny. This bunny had many friends like birds, squirrels, and deer. They all played together in the big green forest.
One day, the bunny got lost while playing hide and seek with his friends. He looked around, but he could not find his friends. The bunny started to cry because he was scared and alone.
A kind deer heard the bunny cry and came to help him. The deer said, "Don't cry, little bunny. I will help you find your friends." They walked through the forest and soon found the bunny's friends. The bunny was very happy and thanked the deer. From that day on, they all played together and the bunny never got lost again.

One day, a little dog named Max was playing outside. He saw a big house with bars. Max did not know it was a jail. He went inside to look around.
In the jail, Max met a nice man named Tom. Tom said, "I wish I could go outside and play like you." Max did not want Tom to be sad. Max had an idea. He ran to get help.
Max found a police officer and showed him the jail. The police officer realized Tom was in jail by mistake. He let Tom out. Tom was grateful to Max and said, "Thank you, Max, for helping me."
They went outside and played together. Max and Tom became best friends.

One summer, Joe and his family were at the beach. The sun was shining, the water was cool, and everyone was having fun. But then, a gloomy cloud rolled in and it started to rain. Joe was so sad - he had been planning on playing in the sand all day!
Joe's dad had an idea. He found a big stick and started drawing a picture in the sand. He made a big mark with the stick to represent the rainy cloud, and a smiley face to make Joe happy. Joe thought the picture was so much fun!
But then, the wind began to blow and the mark started to fade. Joe's dad made another mark to keep the cloud in place, but the wind erased it too. Joe was getting worried - he didn't want to lose his picture!
Finally, Joe's dad had another idea. He grabbed some shells from the beach and started to mark the sand. The shells kept the cloud in place, and Joe was so happy! He was able to keep his picture, and the rain soon passed away. Joe had so much fun playing in the sand that summer, even with the gloomy cloud overhead.

Once upon a time, there was a tiny seed. It lived in the cold ground. The seed wanted to grow big and strong. One day, it started to rain. The seed felt the water and began to grow.
"Hello, little seed," said the wild bird. "You are growing up!" The seed grew and grew. It became a little plant. The wild bird was happy to see the plant grow.
"Thank you, wild bird," said the little plant. "I am not cold anymore." The wild bird and the little plant became good friends. They played and talked every day. The little plant grew up to be a big, strong tree, and the wild bird made a nest in it. They were happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a colorful bird. The bird loved to send sparks from its wings. The sparks were pretty and made people happy. Every day, the bird would fly and send sparks for all to see.
One day, the bird met a big, mean cat. The cat saw the bird's colorful sparks and wanted them. The bird did not know the cat was mean. The bird thought the cat was a friend. The bird showed the cat how to send sparks.
The cat was not nice. The cat took the bird's colorful sparks and ran away. The bird was very sad. The bird could not send sparks anymore. The people missed the pretty sparks too. The mean cat did not care. The cat kept the colorful sparks and the bird was sad forever.

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy cat named Tom. Tom liked to polish his toys every day. His toys were shiny and clean. One day, Tom found a needle in a box. He didn't know what it was, but it was shiny like his toys.
Tom took the needle and started to polish it. He made it very shiny. Then, he put the needle with his other toys. Tom was very happy to have a new shiny toy.
One day, Tom's friend, a little bird named Tim, came to visit. Tim saw the needle and said, "Tom, that is not a toy! It is a needle! It can hurt you!" Tom listened to his friend and put the needle back in the box. Tom and Tim played with the other toys, and they had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl named Lily. Lily loved to collect pretty things. She had a big wardrobe in her room where she kept all her special things.
One day, Lily found a shiny stone on the ground. "Wow," she said, "this is so pretty!" She picked it up and took it home. She wanted to put it in her wardrobe with her other special things.
At home, Lily opened her wardrobe and saw her friend, a tiny bird. "Hi, bird!" she said. "Look what I found!" The bird looked at the shiny stone and chirped, "That's so pretty, Lily!" They put the stone in the wardrobe and smiled. They loved collecting pretty things together.

Once there was a little girl called Gemma. She was only three. She had to stay in the classroom today. It was long and boring.
Gemma looked around. "Mummy, when can I go home?" she asked.
Mummy smiled. "It's not too long," she said. "Just stay here and play a little while longer and then we can go."
Gemma nodded, and continued to play. Soon, it was time to go home. Gemma was so happy.
"Come on, Gemma!" Mummy said. "Let's go home!"
Gemma smiled. "Yay!" She said.
They left the classroom and went home. Gemma had had a long day, but she was glad she had stayed.

One day, a little boy named Tim went outside to play. It was very cold, so he wore a warm vest. Tim saw his friend, Sally, and they decided to play a silly game.
In the game, they would run around and then yell "freeze!" When they said "freeze," they had to stop and not move. They laughed and had fun playing the game.
Sally said, "Let's play freeze tag!" Tim agreed, and they started to play. When Tim was about to tag Sally, she yelled "freeze!" and they both stopped. They laughed and played until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a green frog named Fred. Fred lived near a big pond with his family. One day, Fred saw a network of sticks and leaves in the pond. He did not know what it was.
Fred called his friend, Sam the snail. "Sam, come look at this," said Fred. Sam slowly came to see the network. Sam looked at it and said, "It's a net to catch bugs!" Fred and Sam smiled. They knew they could eat the bugs caught in the net.
Later, Fred's little sister, Lily, came to the pond. She saw the net and frowned. "What is this?" she asked. Fred and Sam told her about the net and the bugs. Lily was happy to learn something new. They all played together and had a fun day at the pond.

Once upon a time, there was an enormous theater in a big town. In this theater, many people came to watch plays and have fun. One day, a little girl named Lily and her mom went to the theater to watch a play.
Before the play started, Lily saw a man studying a book. He was wearing a funny hat and a big coat. Lily asked her mom, "Mom, why is he studying?" Her mom said, "He is learning his words for the play, so he can say them just right."
The play began, and Lily saw the man with the funny hat on stage. He said his words very well, and everyone clapped. After the play, Lily told her mom, "I want to study like the man, so I can be in a play too!" Her mom smiled and said, "You can do it, Lily! Let's go home and start learning."
From that day on, Lily studied her words every day. She practiced and practiced until she knew them all by heart. One day, she got to be in a play at the enormous theater, just like the man with the funny hat. Everyone clapped for Lily, and she felt very happy.

Billy was at a party and he knew he should be having fun. He saw his friends playing games and laughing, but Billy just blinked. It was too boring for him.
"What's the matter Billy?" asked one of his friends.
Billy sighed. "I don't know," he said. "This party isn't fun."
"Well, why don't you try playing these games with us?" his friend said.
Billy thought about it for a second and then smiled. He joined in and soon started to have a lot of fun. He laughed and smiled as he played the games and he wasn't bored anymore.
At the end of the party, Billy waved goodbye to his friends. He was happy to have gone to the party and he couldn't wait for the next one.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a little girl named Amy. Amy loved tea. Every day, she would have tea with her best friend, a teddy bear named Ben.
One sunny day, Amy saw her friend, Tom, playing with a new toy car. Amy felt jealous. She wanted a toy car too. She told Ben, "I want a toy car like Tom's." Ben said, "Let's go find one."
Amy and Ben looked everywhere. They looked under the bed, behind the door, and in the toy box. They could not find a toy car. But they found a big box of tea. Amy smiled and said, "I forgot how much I love tea!"
Amy invited Tom to have tea with her and Ben. They all had fun and laughed together. Amy learned that it is better to share and enjoy what you have, instead of being jealous of what others have.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lilly. Lilly had a great present to give. She wanted to call someone to come over to receive the present.
So Lilly called her best friend, Ben. She shouted "Ben! Can you come over please?"
Ben heard Lilly's call and quickly ran to her doorstep.
When he arrived, Lilly was so happy and showed him the present. "Wow! This looks great! What is it?" asked Ben excitedly.
"It's a surprise! Open it and find out," said Lilly, giggling.
Ben opened the present and a big smile appeared on his face. It was a big toy car that was bright blue and shiny.
"Thank you so much, Lilly!" Ben said with joy. "This is a great present!"
The two friends played with the car all day, having a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion named Leo. Leo was very popular. All his friends liked to play with him. One day, the sun was shining and the sky was full of colors. It was a beautiful rainbow!
Leo and his friends were playing near the rainbow. They were all very happy. Then, a little bird named Bella flew down and said, "Hi Leo! Can I play with you?"
Leo smiled and said, "Of course, Bella! Let's play together!" They all played and had a lot of fun. Suddenly, Leo let out a big roar! His friends laughed and roared too. They all roared together, making the forest full of happy sounds.
At the end of the day, the sun went down and the rainbow disappeared. Leo and his friends were tired but happy. They said goodbye to each other and went home. Leo knew that he would always remember this special day with his friends and the beautiful rainbow.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was very enthusiastic about his new toy. His mom and dad went to the store to buy it for him. It was a special toy called a thermometer. Tim was so happy to have it.
Tim would play with his thermometer every day. He liked to see how hot or cold things were. He would use it outside in the sun and inside his house. He showed his friends his new toy, and they thought it was very cool.
One day, Tim lost his thermometer. He was very sad. He looked everywhere for it, but he could not find it. His mom and dad saw how sad he was. They decided to go to the store and buy him a new one. Tim was so happy when he got his new thermometer, and he played with it every day.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had a red collar. The collar was smooth and shiny. Spot liked to play with his friends, Tom and Sue. They would run and jump all day long.
One day, Tom and Sue wanted to play a game. They wanted to separate into two teams. Tom said, "Spot, you go with Sue. I will play alone." Spot wagged his tail and went to Sue's side.
Sue said, "Let's play tag!" They all ran around the yard, laughing and having fun. Spot's red collar jingled as he ran. Tom tried to catch Spot and Sue but they were too fast.
At the end of the day, they were all tired but happy. Spot, Tom, and Sue sat under a big tree. They talked about their fun day and how much they loved to play together. Spot's red collar shined in the sun as they all went home.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play outside. One day, they find a big bridge over a river. They want to cross the bridge and see what is on the other side.
"Let's go, Anna!" Ben says. "Maybe we can find some flowers or animals."
"OK, Ben, but be careful. The bridge is old and dirty. We need to watch our steps." Anna says.
They hold hands and walk on the bridge. They see some rocks and sticks on the bridge. They also see some water dripping from the bridge.
"Look, Anna, the water is making a rainbow!" Ben says. He points to the colorful light in the air.
"Wow, that's pretty, Ben. Do you know how the water makes a rainbow?" Anna asks.
Ben thinks for a moment. He is very creative. He makes up a story.
"I think the water is magic. It can wash the bridge and make it new and shiny. And it can also wash the sky and make it happy and bright. That's why it makes a rainbow." Ben says.
Anna likes Ben's story. She thinks he is very smart.
"That's a nice story, Ben. I wish the water can wash us too and make us happy and bright." Anna says.
They smile at each other and continue to walk on the bridge. They are happy and curious. They wonder what they will find on the other side.

Once upon a time, in an ordinary town, there was a boy named Tom. He loved to play with his ball. One day, he saw a big game happening in the park. Many people were there to watch the game.
Tom went to the park and asked a man, "Can I play too?" The man said, "Yes, but first you must provide a score." Tom was confused but he wanted to play, so he went to find a score.
He found a piece of paper and a pen. He wrote the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 on the paper. He took the paper back to the man and said, "Here is my score!" The man smiled and said, "Good job, Tom! Now you can play."
Tom played in the game and had lots of fun. He even scored a point for his team! At the end of the game, everyone cheered for Tom. He was so happy that he found a score and got to play in the big game.

Once upon a time, there was a colorful bird named Blue. Blue loved to read. He read books all day long.
One day, Blue saw a big sign. It said, "Win a prize! Read ten books!" Blue was very excited. He wanted to win the prize.
Blue read and read. He read ten books. Blue won the prize! It was a big, shiny star. Blue was very happy. He loved to read and win prizes.

Once upon a time, there was a mail dog named Spot. Spot was very alert. He loved to provide mail to all the houses in the town. Every day, he would go to the mail house, pick up the mail, and take it to the people.
One sunny day, Spot met a little girl named Lily. She was waiting for a very special letter from her grandma. "Spot, will you bring my mail today?" asked Lily. "Yes, Lily, I will provide your mail," said Spot, wagging his tail.
Spot was very alert as he looked for Lily's letter. He found it and took it to her house. When Lily saw the letter, she was so happy. She thanked Spot and gave him a big hug. From that day on, Spot and Lily were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play outside. One day, it rained a lot. Tim went out to play and got very wet. His clothes were all soaked.
At school, Tim's teacher saw his soaked clothes. The teacher told the other pupils to help Tim. The pupils got towels and helped Tim dry off. Tim felt embarrassed because he was wet, but the pupils were kind.
The pupils learned that helping friends is good. Tim learned to not be embarrassed when he needs help. They all played together and had fun. The moral of the story is to always help others and not be shy to ask for help.

Once upon a time, there was a nice farm. On the farm, there was a big red barn. Inside the barn, there were many animals. A little girl named Sally lived on the farm with her mom and dad.
One day, Sally and her mom went to the barn. Sally's mom said, "Sally, look at the cow. She is going to have a baby soon." Sally was very excited. She could not wait for the baby cow to be born.
A few days later, Sally went to the barn again. She saw the baby cow with its mom. The baby cow was very cute. Sally's mom said, "Sally, remember to be kind to the animals. They are our friends." Sally learned that being kind is very important. From that day on, Sally was always nice to the animals on the farm.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went for a walk in the park. She saw a big tree with a small, shiny object high up in the branches. Lily wanted the object, but she did not dare to climb the big tree.
Lily asked her friend, a small bird, to help her get the object. The bird flew up to the tree and picked up the object in its beak. It brought the object down to Lily, who was very happy.
Inside the object was a delicious treat. Lily and the bird shared the treat and enjoyed it very much. They were both very happy and played together for the rest of the day.

One day, a careful cat named Jazz was polishing his shiny toy car. He liked to make it look very clean and bright. Jazz loved his toy car and played with it every day. He would push it around the house and make fun car sounds.
One sunny day, Jazz was outside with his toy car. He was very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew his toy car away! Jazz was very sad and did not know what to do. He looked everywhere for his toy car but could not find it.
Just when Jazz was about to give up, he saw a little girl playing with a shiny toy car that looked just like his. Jazz walked up to the girl and saw that it was his toy car! The girl had found it and was taking good care of it. She was polishing it just like Jazz did. Jazz was very happy to see his toy car again, and he made a new friend too. From that day on, Jazz and the little girl played with the toy car together, and they were very careful to not let it blow away again.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful bird. The bird was very pretty and could fly high in the sky. It loved to play with its friends all day long.
One day, the bird's mom told it to behave. She said, "You are one year older now. It is time to be a good bird and help others." The bird wanted to make its mom happy, so it tried to be good.
The bird started to help its friends. It shared its food and played nice games. The bird's mom was very happy with it. All the other birds loved the graceful bird, too. They all lived happily together.

One day, a gray elephant was taking a bath in a nearby pond. She was splashing the cool water around and having lots of fun! The harmless elephant enjoyed being clean and feeling the sun on her back.
After a while, the elephant noticed a little bird perched on the branch of a nearby tree. The bird was looking around curiously and chirping happily. The elephant thought it was so cute!
So, the elephant invited the bird to take a bath with her. The bird happily accepted and hopped into the water. The two friends splashed around together and had a great time!
When their bath was finished, the elephant and the bird were very clean and happy. They said goodbye to each other and each went on their way with a smile on their face.

Once upon a time, there was a big ancient tree. This tree was very old and wise. It lived in a busy city with lots of traffic. The tree had many friends, like the birds and squirrels that lived in its branches.
One day, a little girl named Lucy walked by the tree. She saw a big, red apple hanging from one of the branches. Lucy wanted to taste the apple, but it was too high for her to reach. She asked her friend, Tom, to help her get the apple.
Tom tried to climb the tree, but he was too small. He said, "Lucy, I can't get the apple. It's too high!" Lucy was sad, but she didn't give up. She looked around and saw a long stick. She used the stick to poke the apple until it fell down.
Lucy picked up the apple and took a big bite. It was the sweetest apple she had ever tasted. She shared the apple with Tom, and they both smiled. The ancient tree was happy that it could share its tasty treat with the children. From that day on, Lucy and Tom visited the tree every day, and they all became the best of friends.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to a food place with her mom. They sat at a table and looked at the menu. The menu had many yummy things like pizza, burgers, and ice cream. Lily wanted to eat them all!
Lily's mom said, "Lily, you can only pick one thing from the menu." Lily was impatient. She wanted to eat everything right now! She could not wait any longer. Lily knelt down on the floor and started to cry.
A nice waiter came to their table and said, "Don't cry, Lily. I will help you pick something yummy from the menu." Lily stopped crying and smiled. The waiter helped her pick a big slice of pizza. Lily was happy and ate her pizza with her mom.

Once upon a time, on a far away planet, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim felt helpless because he could not pour his own juice. Every day, he would ask his mom for help. "Mom, can you pour my juice, please?" he would say.
One day, a friendly alien named Zog came to visit the planet. Zog saw Tim feeling sad and asked, "Why are you sad, little boy?" Tim told Zog about his problem. "I can't pour my own juice and I feel helpless," he said.
Zog wanted to help Tim, so they practiced pouring juice together. With Zog's help, Tim learned how to pour his juice without spilling it. Tim felt so happy and thanked Zog for helping him. From that day on, Tim was no longer helpless and could pour his own juice.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max was a good dog. He liked to run and play with his friends. One day, Max saw a big tree. He wanted to see what was on the other side of the tree.
Max walked around the tree and saw a small cat. The cat was shivering because it was cold outside. Max felt sad for the cat. He said, "Hello, cat. Why are you shivering?" The cat replied, "I am cold. I have been outside for a week."
Max wanted to help the cat. He said, "Come with me. I will take you to my warm house." The cat was happy and followed Max. They became good friends and played together every day. The cat never shivered again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to jog every day. One sunny day, while Tim was taking his jog, he saw a big, red fire. The fire was so hot, it could burn things.
Tim saw a generous man named Mr. Brown near the fire. Mr. Brown was trying to put out the fire with water. Tim wanted to help Mr. Brown. He asked, "Can I help you?" Mr. Brown said, "Yes, please! Get more water!"
Tim ran to the river and filled a bucket with water. He jogged back to Mr. Brown and threw the water on the fire. They worked together, and soon the fire was gone. Mr. Brown thanked Tim for his help. They both felt happy that the fire was out and that they had become friends.

Jack was walking through the park when he came upon a big tree. Under the tree was a shiny chest. Jack was curious, so he opened the chest and inside was a big book. On the cover was a big word - Choose.
Jack opened the book and saw four different pictures. The first was a picture of sky. The second was a picture of a sea. The third was a picture of a forest. The fourth was a picture of the city.
Jack looked more carefully at each picture and realized that these were places he could go. He decided it was time to choose his life.
Jack said to himself, "Which one of these lives will I choose?"
Suddenly a voice said, "All of them are available to you, Jack".
Jack looked around but couldn't see anyone. He looked back at the four pictures and said, "I choose all of them! I want to experience all of them in my life!"
Jack closed the book and smiled. He knew that every day he would have plenty of choices, and he was excited to explore them all.

Once upon a time, there was a brown dog named Spot. Spot loved to play in the park. Every day, he would run and jump with his friends.
One day, while Spot was playing, he saw a big ball. Spot wanted to play with the big ball, so he ran to it. But then, he had to pause. Spot heard a little girl crying.
Spot looked around and saw the little girl sitting on a bench. She was sad because she lost her toy. Spot wanted to help, so he went to the girl and licked her hand.
The little girl smiled and hugged Spot. Together, they looked for her toy and found it under a tree. The little girl was happy, and they played in the park until the sun went down.

One day, a little bunny named Bob was playing in the forest. He was hopping around and having fun. Soon, he saw a big black hole in the ground. Bob was curious and wanted to see what was inside the hole.
As Bob got closer to the hole, he started to panic. He was scared of the dark and didn't know what was inside. He took a deep breath and decided to be brave. He hopped closer and closer to the black hole.
When Bob looked inside the hole, he saw a small, friendly mouse. The mouse was not scary at all. They became friends and played together. Bob learned that sometimes, things that seem scary are not so bad after all.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Sunday. Sunday had a rough coat of fur, but he was very friendly. He lived in a small house with a big yard. Sunday loved to play outside and run around in the grass.
One day, Sunday saw a new animal in the yard. It was a tiny kitten. The kitten looked scared and lost. Sunday wanted to help, so he went up to the kitten and said, "Welcome to my yard, little friend. Don't be scared, I will help you." The kitten felt better and started to play with Sunday.
Sunday and the kitten became good friends. They played in the yard every day, and soon the kitten wasn't scared anymore. They had lots of fun together, and everyone loved to watch them play. And that is how Sunday the rough dog made a new friend and welcomed the kitten into his home.

One day, a girl named Lucy was very enthusiastic. She wanted to go on a subway ride with her mom. They put on their coats and went outside.
Lucy and her mom rushed to the subway station. They saw a big train coming. Lucy was very happy. They got on the train and sat down.
The subway train went fast. Lucy looked out the window and saw many things. She saw trees, cars, and a big park. At the end, they got off the train and went home. Lucy loved her subway ride.

Once there was a little boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved to explore. One day Jack wanted to go for a march outside. He told his parents and they agreed, but his mom said that he had to sign a piece of paper first.
Jack asked why, but his mom said he had to do it just in case something happened. Jack was confused, but still signed the piece of paper.
Outside, it was mild and the perfect day for a march. He followed a path through the woods and found a string on the ground. He picked it up and kept marching until he saw a high fence ahead.
The fence was too tall to climb, so Jack tried to find a way in. All of a sudden, Jack heard voices coming from the other side. He stopped and listened.
A voice said, "We won't let him get any closer!"
Terrified, Jack quickly ran away and back home. He knew he wasn't supposed to go beyond the fence, so he didn't tell anyone what he found.
Back at home, Jack put down his string and thought about his march. He was glad he was safe, but sad he was unable to finish it.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a toy jet. It was red and very fast. Tim was so happy to play with his new jet. But Tim was sometimes naughty. He would not always listen to his mom when she would tell him what to do.
One day, Tim's mom told him, "Tim, do not play with your jet near the big road. It is not safe." Tim said, "Okay, Mom," but he did not really listen. He went to play with his jet near the big road anyway.
While playing, the jet flew too close to the big road. Tim ran after it, but he was not fast enough. A nice man saw Tim and stopped his car. The man picked up the jet and gave it back to Tim. He said, "You should listen to your mom. She is trying to keep you safe." Tim felt bad for being naughty and promised to listen to his mom from now on.

It was a hot day and the sun was shining brightly.
Tommy was outside, in the garden, surrounded by trees. He had found a branch. It was long and was a creamy white colour.
He picked it up and it felt dry and tough. He put it to his mouth and chewed. It was hard, so he decided to look for a softer branch.
"Mommy," he said, walking back into the house. "Where can I find some softer branches?"
"Look over there," said his mother, pointing towards a tree that was shaded by a big umbrella. "Those branches should be softer since they are not in the sun."
Tommy dashed over to the tree and found a green branch. He picked it up and took a big bite. It was much softer than the first one he had found. He kept chewing, feeling the texture of the wood in his mouth.
It was delicious! He found a few more branches and chewed them too. He was having such a great time.
Eventually, Tommy had enough of his branch-eating adventure. He put his last branch down and ran back inside for a cool drink.

Once upon a time there was a very brave man. One day he decided to take a step up high in the sky. He climbed until he got to the moon!
The man looked down and saw the world he had left behind. In amazement he said "It's incredible! Never have I seen anything so beautiful!"
As he gazed in wonder, a voice said "What are you doing here?"
He looked around and saw a friendly little rabbit.
The rabbit jumped in the man's lap and said "Let's go explore the moon together!"
The man smiled and said "That sounds like an incredible idea!"
The man and the rabbit stepped around the moon and found all sorts of amazing things. They had a wonderful time and made many incredible discoveries.
When they had finished exploring, the man said goodbye to his new friend and stepped back to the ground. His adventure on the moon was something he would never forget.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a comb that was very special. It was the only comb like it. Sue loved to mind her comb and keep it safe.
One day, Sue went to the park. She took her comb with her. She saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. Sue put her comb on the ground and started to climb the tree. She was very happy.
But then, something unexpected happened! A dog came and took Sue's comb in its mouth. Sue saw the dog and climbed down the tree very fast. She asked the dog to give her comb back. The dog was nice and gave the comb back to Sue. Sue was so happy to have her comb back. From that day, Sue always minded her comb and never let it out of her sight.

One day, a graceful cat named Lily was walking in the park. She saw a basket under a big tree. She wanted to relax, so she went to the basket. Lily looked inside the basket and saw a lot of toys. She was very happy.
A little boy named Tim saw Lily by the basket. He said, "Hi, cat! Do you like my toys?" Lily looked at Tim and said, "Meow!" Tim wanted to play with Lily, so he picked up a toy and threw it. Lily ran after the toy and brought it back to Tim. They played for a long time.
But then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came running to the park. The dog saw Lily and Tim playing and wanted to play too. The dog ran to the basket and took all the toys. Tim and Lily were very sad. The big dog did not want to share the toys, and they could not play anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She was getting ready for a big day next week. Lily was so excited. She wanted to thank her mom for helping her get ready.
One day, Lily found a big box. She did not know what was inside. She opened the box and saw a funny hat. Lily put the hat on her head. She felt very funny. She started to dance and sing.
Lily showed her mom the funny hat. Her mom started to laugh. She told Lily that the hat was for the big day next week. Lily was so happy. She thanked her mom for the funny hat. They danced and sang together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mary. She had a cup that she loved very much. The cup was red and had a picture of a cute cat on it. Mary took her cup everywhere she went. She liked to drink milk from her cup.
One day, Mary was very tired. She wanted to relax and have a nap. She put her cup on the table and lay down on her bed. But her little brother, Tim, saw the cup and wanted to play with it. He took the cup and ran outside.
Tim played with the cup in the mud. The cup got very dirty and spoiled. Mary woke up from her nap and saw that her cup was gone. She looked everywhere and finally found it outside. She saw that her cup was spoiled and felt very sad.
Mary's mom saw her sad face and helped her clean the cup. They washed the cup until it was clean and shiny again. Mary learned to keep her cup safe from Tim, and she was happy to have her clean cup back. From then on, Mary and her cup were never apart, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Ben and Bobby. They liked to have picnics together in the park.
One day, Bobby found a very important thing in the park, and he wanted to show it to Ben. So he took Ben to where he had found it--it was a small box with a big red button in the middle.
Ben excitedly told Bobby to press the button. Bobby was scared, but Ben said it was ok. So Bobby pressed the button, and a loud noise happened! Everyone in the park clapped and cheered for Bobby.
Ben and Bobby were so happy and excited, and they applauded each other for being brave and making something important happen.
The moral of the story is that if we take the time to do something important, we can get rewarded in the end. It's ok to take risks even if we are scared sometimes, and we might be surprised by the results!

Once upon a time there were two friends, Tilly and Eli. They both had collars that looked the same, except Tilly's was yellow and Eli's was blue.
One day, they were out in the garden playing. Tilly was so excited that she shouted at the top of her voice. But Eli was quieter, because he didn't want to wake up the neighbours.
When Tilly realised that she had shouted too loudly, she said in a gentle voice, "I'm sorry, Eli". Eli nodded and smiled at his friend.
But then, out of nowhere, a big white dog started barking and jumping around the garden. Eli was scared and he shouted at the top of his voice.
Tilly took hold of his hand and said: "It's okay, Eli, don't be scared. Come on, let's go and speak to the dog together".
So the two friends walked over to the friendly dog and petted it for a while. Before long, all three of them were friends.
Tilly and Eli looked at each other and smiled. Then they said sorry to each other and hugged.
The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside in the sand. He would build big castles and make fun shapes with his toys. One day, Tim found a pretty shell in the sand. He was very happy and showed it to his mom.
Tim's mom was grateful for the pretty shell. She wanted to keep it safe, so she put it on a high shelf. But one day, when Tim was playing, he accidentally hit the shelf with his ball. The shell fell down and break into pieces. Tim was very sad.
Tim's mom saw how sad he was and gave him a big hug. She told him they could find a new shell together. They went to the sand and found an even prettier shell. Tim was grateful and promised to be careful. They all lived happily ever after.

Lily and Tom were at the park with their mom. They saw a big tent with many colors. Mom said it was a circus. They wanted to go inside and see the animals and the clowns.
Mom bought them tickets and they went in. They saw a lion, a monkey, a horse and a big elephant. They also saw a clown with a red nose and a funny hat. He made them laugh with his jokes and tricks.
But then, a bad man came. He had a gun and a mask. He wanted to take all the money from the circus. He said he was very poor and he needed to be rich. He pointed the gun at the clown and said, "Give me your money or I will shoot you!"
The clown was scared. He said, "Please, don't hurt me. I don't have much money. I only have this hat and this nose." He took off his hat and his nose and gave them to the bad man.
But the bad man was not happy. He said, "That's not enough. I want more. I want your clothes and your shoes and your bike." He grabbed the clown's clothes and shoes and tried to take his bike.
But Lily and Tom were brave. They saw a rope near the elephant. They took the rope and threw it at the bad man. The rope wrapped around his legs and made him fall. The clown ran to his bike and rode away. He shouted, "Thank you, Lily and Tom. You rescued me. You are my heroes."
Lily and Tom smiled. They were happy. They had helped the clown. The police came and took the bad man away. The circus people cheered and clapped. They gave Lily and Tom free popcorn and candy. They said, "You are very kind and smart. You can come to the circus anytime you want."
Lily and Tom hugged their mom. They said, "We love the circus. We love the clown. We love you, mom." Mom said, "I love you too, Lily and Tom. You are my stars." They all went home happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big ship. The ship was part of the navy. On the ship, there was a boy named Tom. He had a job to do. He had to bring food to the men on the ship. They were far from home. Tom hoped they would like the food.
One day, the ship found a small island. The men were very hungry. They saw a tree with fruit. The fruit looked good, but it was sour. The men did not like the sour fruit. They were sad and mad. Tom tried to find better food on the island, but there was none.
The men on the ship had to eat the sour fruit. They were not happy. The ship could not find more food. The men stayed hungry and sad. They hoped for better food, but it did not come. The ship sailed on, but the men were too weak to work. In the end, the ship was lost.

Once upon a time there was a dependable birdcage that sat in a quiet corner of the house. It was home to a family of chirping birds. Every morning and every evening, the birds would sing together as a family, and their happy sounds filled the room.
One morning, a little boy named John was passing by the birdcage. He stopped and looked in at the birds, and he noticed that some of them were missing. He opened the door of the birdcage, and the birds that were still inside flew out and up into the sky.
John watched as the birds flew away, and he felt a little bit sad. But then he hopped up and sat down in an empty spot in the middle of the birdcage.
John watched the birds in the sky and sang along with them as they flew. He was happy again, and he felt very safe in the dependable birdcage.

One day, a skeleton appeared by the river. It was slow, like it was tired. A little girl saw it and wanted to find out why it was there. She walked cautiously up to it, wondering what it was.
The little girl waved at the skeleton, but it didn't move. She noticed that it was very still, and she could see how some of its bones had fallen off. She wondered what this odd creature was!
Suddenly, the skeleton moved! It stood up very slowly and waved back at the little girl. She was so surprised! The skeleton moved very slowly and seemed quite friendly.
The little girl smiled and waved goodbye before running back to her home. From then on, she would look out for the skeleton every day, just to see if it was still there. It was her new friend.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a jolly man. The man had a figure that he liked a lot. He would play with the figure every day. It was his favorite toy.
One day, the jolly man lost his figure. He was very sad. He looked for his figure everywhere, but he could not find it. He asked his friends to help him look for it, but they could not find it either.
Then, something unexpected happened. A little bird found the figure and brought it back to the jolly man. The man was so happy! He thanked the bird and gave it a big hug. The bird helped restore the jolly man's happiness. And from that day on, the jolly man and the bird became best friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim had a fake pet. He named it Fluffy. Fluffy was a toy cat. Tim loved Fluffy very much. He would put Fluffy on his bed every night.
One day, Tim's friend, Sam, came to play. Sam saw Fluffy and said, "That's a fake pet! It's not real!" Tim felt sad. He wanted a real pet, not a fake one.
Later, Tim's mom saw him crying. She asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim told her about Fluffy and how Sam said it was fake. His mom hugged him and said, "It's okay. Fluffy makes you happy, and that's what matters."
The next day, Sam came over again. Tim's mom had an idea. She gave Sam a fake pet too. Sam was so happy! He said, "Thank you! I love my fake pet!" Tim and Sam played with their fake pets all day. They learned that it's okay to have fake pets, as long as they make you happy.

Once upon a time there was a little rabbit named Jenny. In the garden where she lived there was a beautiful patch of grass and flowers. One day, when Jenny was hopping around, she noticed something strange in the patch. It was a small, sweet smelling patch of carrots.
Jenny was so excited to see it - she tried to nibble a carrot. But when she tried, she discovered the patch was not hers! Someone else was growing the carrots.
"That's not fair!" said Jenny.
An old rabbit hopped up to Jenny. "I know what you're thinking," he said. "But the other rabbit has a right to grow his own food. He planted the carrots first."
Jenny sadly hopped away. Later that night, she made her own patch of carrots on the other side of the garden. It wasn't as big or as sweet as the other patch, but Jenny was proud to have made it. She enjoyed the carrots every day.
Jenny never forgot the lesson she learned in the garden - it's important to share and be kind to others, even if it can be hard.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Ben. Ben loved honey more than anything else. One day, he went to the woods to find some honey.
In the woods, Ben found a hidden tree with a beehive. He was very happy and said, "Yummy, I found honey!" But the bees did not want to share their honey. Ben asked the bees, "Can I have some honey, please?"
The bees did not answer at first. Then, one brave bee said, "You can have some honey if you help us. Our friend is lost in the woods. Can you find her?" Ben agreed to help the bees find their lost friend.
Ben searched the woods and found the lost bee. She was very happy to see Ben and the other bees. They all went back to the hidden tree. The bees shared their honey with Ben as a thank you for his help. Ben and the bees became good friends and shared honey together from that day on.

One day, a little girl named Sue found a bottle of perfume in her mom's room. She thought it was pretty and smelled nice. Sue wanted to take the perfume and show it to her friend, Tim.
Sue went to Tim's house and said, "Look what I have! It's my mom's perfume. It smells good." Tim smelled the perfume and agreed, "Yes, it does smell good."
Sue and Tim decided to make a game. They took turns spraying the perfume on flowers to make them smell even better. They were successful and had lots of fun. When it was time to go home, Sue said, "Let's play with the perfume again soon!" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, let's do it again!"

Once, there was a little boy named Tom. He was eager to play with his toy cars. He set them all up in a long line. Then, he made them go fast on the floor.
One day, Tom's foot felt pain. He could not play with his cars. His mom said, "Rest, Tom. Your foot will be better soon." Tom was sad, but he listened to his mom.
After a few days, the pain was gone. Tom was happy and eager to play again. He set up his cars and played all day. His mom was happy to see him having fun.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a big bubble wand. He wanted to make big bubbles. He got a bowl of soapy water and dipped the wand in it. He waved the wand, and a big bubble came out. It was so big, it could fit him inside!
Tim tried to get close to the bubble, but it started to float away. He ran after it and jumped to catch it. To his surprise, he landed inside the bubble! He was so happy, but he didn't know how to get out.
Then, a kind bird saw Tim and wanted to help him. The bird flew close to the bubble and used its wing to gently wipe the bubble. The bubble popped, and Tim was free! Tim thanked the bird, and they became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a tidy little forest, there lived a small squirrel named Sam. Sam loved to find nuts and keep them in his cozy home. One day, he found the biggest nut he had ever seen. It was so big that it could feed him for a whole week. Sam was very happy.
Sam took the big nut back to his home. He put it in the corner of his room, so it would be safe. He went outside to play with his friends. They played hide and seek, and Sam was very good at hiding.
When it was time to go home, Sam went back to his room to look at his big nut. But it was gone! The nut had vanished! Sam was very sad. He looked everywhere for his nut, but he could not find it. He asked his friends if they had seen it, but they had not.
Just then, a kind little bird came to Sam. She had seen where the nut had gone. The bird told Sam that a strong wind had blown the nut out of his room and into the river. Sam and the bird went to the river, and there they found the big nut floating on the water.
Sam was very happy to have his big nut back. He thanked the kind bird for helping him. From that day on, Sam always made sure to keep his home tidy and his nuts safe. And he and the bird became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big crane. The crane lived near a school. Every day, the crane would watch kids go to school. The crane wanted to study like the kids.
One day, the crane felt excited. It was a sunny day, and the crane walked into the school. The kids saw the crane and smiled. The crane sat with the kids and listened to the teacher. The teacher taught them about colors and shapes.
After school, the kids played with the crane. They ran and jumped and laughed. The crane was happy it could study and play with the kids. From that day on, the crane went to school every day and learned many new things.

Once upon a time, in a big desert, there was a fat cactus. The fat cactus was very happy because it was time to prepare for a party. All the cactus friends were coming to play and have fun.
The fat cactus worked all day to prepare the party. It blew up balloons, made yummy food, and put up decorations. The fat cactus was very excited for its friends to come and see what it had done.
Finally, the party started, and all the cactus friends came. They played games, ate the yummy food, and had lots of fun. The fat cactus was so happy that it had prepared the best party ever. All the cactus friends said thank you and went home. The fat cactus smiled and went to sleep, dreaming about the next party it would prepare.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree. Many birds lived in the tree. They all spoke different languages. One day, the birds had a big meeting. They wanted to decide on one language for all the birds. They thought it was fair to talk the same way.
The birds talked and talked. They could not pick one language. Then, a little bird had an idea. "Let's have a race!" said the little bird. "The winner will choose the language for all of us." All the birds agreed, and they got ready for the race.
The race began, and the birds flew as fast as they could. But then, something unexpected happened. A strong wind blew all the birds back to the tree. No one won the race. The birds learned that it was okay to speak different languages. They became friends and learned from each other. The moral of the story is that it's good to be different and learn from each other.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Mary. Mary was very excited because today was Snack Day.
Mary asked her mom, “Can I have my snack now?”
Her mom said, “Yes, you can have your snack. Let me get it for you.”
So, her mom went to the kitchen and got a gray snack. She brought it to Mary and said, “Here's your snack. Enjoy!"
Mary opened the snack and said, “Yummy! Thank you mommy!”
Mary sat down and enjoyed her snack. After she was finished, she smiled and said, “Let’s do this again tomorrow.”
Her mom smiled and said, “Of course. I love when you are happy.”
Mary smiled back and said, “Me too!"
And they all lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time there lived a bee. His name was Buzz. He lived in a big hive with other bees.
Buzz was very honest. He was always doing good deeds.
One day, Buzz heard a loud noise coming from outside the hive. He decided to go and check what the noise was.
When Buzz flew outside he saw some animals picking flowers from outside the hive. Buzz shouted at them: “Stop! You must listen. This is our hive!”
But the animals kept picking the flowers. They didn’t listen to Buzz.
All the other bees in the hive also heard the noise. They all flew out of the hive and helped Buzz to protect their home.
The animals were so scared that they ran away.
Buzz was very happy. Everybody in the hive was proud of him. They all praised him for being so honest.
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She loved to play outside in the sun. Today, Sue went to the park with her mom. The park was peaceful and quiet. Sue liked the park a lot.
Sue saw a butterfly. It was pretty and colorful. She wanted to see the butterfly up close. So, she followed the butterfly as it flew around. The butterfly landed on a flower. Sue saw it and smiled.
Sue's mom called her to go home. They said goodbye to the park and the butterfly. Sue was happy she got to see the pretty butterfly today. She couldn't wait to come back to the peaceful park again.

Once upon a time, there was a baby named Tim. Tim was going on a trip with his mom and dad. They needed to pack their bags for the trip. Tim wanted to help, but he was too small. He looked around to see what was available for him to do.
Tim saw his toy box and had an idea. He could pack his favorite toys for the trip! Tim picked up his toys and put them in a small bag. When his mom and dad saw what he had done, they were very happy. They told Tim he had done a great job.
The trip was fun, and Tim played with his toys the whole time. He learned that even if he was small, he could still help his family. The moral of the story is that everyone can be helpful, no matter how small they are.

One day, a boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went to play outside. They saw a big and colorful tent. Tim said, "Wow, look at that tent! Let's go in." Spot barked and wagged his tail.
Inside the tent, they saw a man with a big hat. The man said, "Hi, I am Mr. Hat. What do you want to do?" Tim thought for a moment and said, "I want to play a game." Mr. Hat smiled and said, "Okay, let's play hide and seek."
Tim and Spot started to hide, but then they heard a loud sound. It was a big elephant! The elephant said, "I want to play too!" Tim, Spot, and the elephant played hide and seek together. They had so much fun in the colorful tent.

Once upon a time, in a lovely little town, there was a girl named Lucy. She had a pretty bow in her hair. Lucy liked to play outside with her friends.
One day, Lucy went to the park. She saw her friend Tom. Tom was happy to see Lucy. He gave her a big wave with his hand. Lucy waved back with a big smile.
They played together all day. Lucy and Tom took turns wearing the pretty bow. They waved to all their friends in the park. At the end of the day, they went home tired but happy. And they couldn't wait to play together again.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a thief. The thief was eager to take things that did not belong to him. He liked to perform tricks to take things from people.
One day, the thief saw a little girl with a pretty doll. He wanted the doll for himself. So, he performed a trick and took the doll from the little girl when she was not looking.
The little girl was very sad and cried a lot. Her mom and dad were upset too. They told the town people about the thief. The town people were angry and wanted to find the thief.
The thief heard the town people coming. He tried to run away, but he fell into a deep hole. He could not get out. The town people found the doll and gave it back to the little girl. But the thief was stuck in the hole, and no one helped him. That was the bad ending for the thief.

Anissa was walking outside with her mom while the rain was falling. Suddenly, Anissa stepped on a slippery puddle and fell right onto the floor. Anissa started to cry.
Her mom ran to her and said, “Anissa, why were you so careless? You should have been more careful and looked where you were going.” Anissa said nothing and seemed to understand. Her mom hugged her and said, “Let’s go inside and get you dry.”
The next day, the rain had stopped, and Anissa and her mom went for a walk again. This time, Anissa was much more aware of her surroundings and was very careful to avoid puddles.
The moral of the story is that it’s important to be careful, even in the rain. It’s easy to get careless and have an accident, so it’s important to always be aware of your surroundings.

Lily was a little girl who liked to explore. She liked to discover new things in her garden, like flowers, bugs and rocks. One day, she saw something shiny under a big leaf. She lifted the leaf and found a small earring. It was round and pink and had a tiny heart on it.
"Wow, what a charming earring!" Lily said. "I wonder who it belongs to."
She put the earring in her ear and ran to show her mom. But on the way, she met her friend Max. Max was a little boy who lived next door. He liked to play with Lily and share his toys.
"Hi, Lily!" Max said. "What do you have in your ear?"
Lily smiled and showed him the earring. "I found it in the garden. It is so pretty, don't you think?"
Max looked at the earring and frowned. "That's my mom's earring!" he said. "She lost it yesterday and was very sad. She looked everywhere for it."
Lily felt sorry for Max's mom. She did not want to make her sad. She took the earring out of her ear and gave it to Max.
