In the garden, they found a magic light. It was very bright and shiny. "Wow!" said Tim. "We found the light!" Kitty and Tim were so happy. They played in the garden with the magic light and the pretty butterfly all day long.

One day, a big lion named Leo went for a walk. He was on a leash. His friend, a little girl named Lily, held the leash. They were very organized and walked in a straight line.
"Roar!" said Leo the lion. Lily laughed. They walked and talked together. They were very happy.
Suddenly, a big wind came and blew Lily's hat away. Leo roared and jumped. He caught the hat with his big paw. "Thank you, Leo!" said Lily. They smiled and walked back home.

Once upon a time, there was a peaceful park. In this park, there were many trees, flowers, and animals. The sun was shining and the birds were singing.
One day, a little boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went to the park. They wanted to test how fast they could run. Tim said, "Spot, let's see who can run faster!" Spot barked happily and wagged his tail.
Tim and Spot started to run. They ran and ran, laughing and barking. The park was so peaceful that they could hear their own footsteps. At the end of the race, they were both tired but happy. They sat down under a big tree and rested. The peaceful park was the perfect place for Tim and Spot to have fun and test their speed.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a room full of toys and junk. He loved to play with his toys, but he did not like to clean up. His mom told him that he needed to take care of his fragile toys, or they would break.
One day, Tim's mom gave him a big box. She said, "Tim, you need to fill this box with all the junk in your room." Tim did not want to, but he knew his mom was right. So, he started to pick up his toys and put them in the box. He was careful with his fragile toys, so they would not break.
As Tim filled the box, he found toys he had not seen in a long time. He realized that when he took care of his things, he could enjoy them more. He also learned that it was important to clean up his room and not let junk pile up. Tim felt proud of himself for filling the box and keeping his fragile toys safe. The moral of the story is to take care of your things and keep your space clean, so you can enjoy what you have.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat with a heavy anchor. One day, the boat went on a trip. The boat felt dizzy because the water was very wavy. The boat wanted to stop and rest.
The boat saw a fish and asked, "Can you help me find a place to stop?" The fish answered, "Yes, I can help you. Follow me to a quiet place." The boat followed the fish to a quiet place where the water was calm.
The boat dropped its anchor and said, "Thank you, fish." The fish said, "You're welcome, boat. Now you can rest." The boat felt better and was not dizzy anymore. They both became good friends and played together in the calm water.

One day, a little boy named Tim had a big worry. He lost his rare toy, a red car. Tim was very sad and didn't know what to do. He thought he would suffer without his red car.
Tim's friend, Sally, saw him looking sad. She asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim said, "I lost my rare red car. I am full of worry." Sally wanted to help Tim find his red car.
They looked and looked for the red car. Suddenly, they found a big box. They opened the box and found many red cars inside! Tim's rare red car was not lost after all. He had many red cars now. Tim and Sally were very happy and played with the red cars together.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball all day. He had many friends in the park.
One day, Max saw a big cake on a table. He thought, "I want that cake!" Max jumped up and ate the cake. He did not know that the cake was for a party. Max felt regret for eating the cake.
Max wanted to make it right. He went to find a new cake. On the way, he found a lost toy. Max gave the toy back to the little girl who lost it. The girl was so happy. She gave Max a reward - a big, new cake! Max brought the cake to the party. Everyone was happy and learned that saying sorry and fixing our mistakes can make things better.

John and Sam were best friends. John had a rope and he wanted to show it to Sam. John was very proud and thought it was impressive. He wanted to show Sam his rope and show off his rope tricks.
John and Sam went to the park. John started doing some rope tricks and Sam was very impressed. Sam asked John to teach him the rope tricks. And so they started to practice.
But then they got very hungry. John ate all the food they had brought and Sam had nothing to eat. John thought it was funny and suggested that Sam should eat the rope.
Sam did not think it was funny and became very mad at John. Sam said he would never talk to John again and left the park.
John was left alone with his rope and felt sad. He had made an impressive display with his rope, but he had also lost a good friend. This was an unfortunate and bad ending to what was supposed to be an enjoyable day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a toy sword that he liked to play with. He would run around and pretend to be a knight. One day, he saw a big rock in the yard.
Tim wanted to use his sword to break the rock. He tried and tried, but the rock was too hard. Tim felt frustrated. He wanted to be a strong knight, but he could not break the rock.
Tim's mom saw him and said, "Why don't you kneel down and say a wish?" Tim did what his mom said. He knelt down, closed his eyes, and wished to be a strong knight. When he opened his eyes, he saw a small crack in the rock. Tim was happy and knew that he was a brave knight with his sword.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit who was very brave. She liked to explore and she loved to run.
One day, while exploring, the little rabbit came across a bright yellow strip. She was curious, so she decided to follow it.
The strip got longer and longer, and soon the little rabbit noticed it was leading her to the edge of the forest. "This looks fun", she thought.
But then, suddenly, the little rabbit got scared. She felt a bit worried. She knew she was getting close to the edge of the forest, and she was not sure what might be on the other side.
The little rabbit stopped and looked around. She saw a big, friendly-looking bear. The bear said, "Why don't you come and explore on this side with me? We can run together, and I'll make sure nothing bad happens".
The little rabbit felt much better after hearing the bear's kind words and soon they were running together following the yellow strip. They ended up having lots of fun!

Lily and Ben were playing in the backyard. They had a big cardboard box that they used as a house. They drew windows and a door on it with crayons. They also had some fake flowers and a fake cake that they pretended to give to each other.
"Hello, Ben," Lily said. "Welcome to my house. Do you want some cake?"
"Thank you, Lily," Ben said. "Your cake looks yummy. What kind is it?"
"It is chocolate cake with pink frosting," Lily said. "I made it myself. I recommend you try it. It is very good."
Ben took a bite of the fake cake. He made a funny face. "This cake is not good, Lily. It is hard and dry. It does not taste like chocolate or pink."
Lily laughed. "That is because it is not real cake, Ben. It is fake cake. It is only for pretending. Did you forget?"
Ben laughed too. "Oh, yes. I forgot. It is fake cake. But it is still fun to play with. Can I have some flowers instead?"
"Sure, Ben. Here you are. These are fake flowers. They are pretty and colorful. But they do not smell like anything."
Ben smelled the fake flowers. He nodded. "You are right, Lily. They do not smell like anything. But they are still nice to look at. Can I give you some too?"
"Of course, Ben. Thank you. You are a good friend. I like playing with you and your cardboard house."
"I like playing with you too, Lily. You are a good friend. Your cardboard house is awesome. Can we play some more?"
"Yes, Ben. Let's play some more. We can pretend anything we want with our cardboard and our fake things."

One day, a cat named Tom went for a walk. He saw a big window. The window was open. Tom was very curious. He wanted to see what was inside.
Tom jumped through the window. Inside, he found a wild party. There were many animals. They were all having fun. Tom saw a big cake. He wanted a piece.
Tom ate some cake. Then, he started to feel tired. He let out a big yawn. The other animals saw Tom yawn. They all began to yawn, too. Soon, everyone was tired.
The animals all went to sleep. Tom went back through the window. He went home to his cozy bed. Tom had a fun day at the wild party.

One day a little boy looked up at the sky. It was a bright blue color with not a cloud in sight. He couldn’t help but wonder what it would be like to fly up there.
He asked his mom “Can I fly up to the sky?” His mom smiled at him and nodded.
The little boy cheered and ran around in circles. “Yay! I am going to the blue sky!”
His mom laughed and said “Not right now sweetheart, but someday you will.”
The little boy nodded and continued to twirl and dance around in excitement. He was so happy to be able to go to the blue sky one day. He couldn’t wait!

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little cat. The cat liked to play in the park. One day, it saw a big red ball. The cat wanted to grab the ball and play with it.
The cat ran to the ball and grabbed it with its paws. It was so happy to play with the ball. The cat jumped and rolled with the ball in the park. The cat had lots of fun.
But then, the ball went close to the road. The cat did not see a big truck coming. The truck gave the cat a shock. The cat got scared and ran away fast. But the big red ball was gone. The cat was sad because it lost its new toy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a polite boy named Tim. He liked to watch big things. One day, he went with his mom to a temple. The temple was very big and pretty. Tim was very happy to see it.
Tim and his mom went inside the temple. They saw many people. They were all very quiet and polite. Tim wanted to be polite too, so he did not make any loud sounds. He just watched everything with big eyes.
After they left the temple, Tim told his mom all about what he saw. He liked the big temple and the polite people. His mom was happy that Tim had a fun day. They went home and Tim told his dad all about the temple too.

Once upon a time, in a charming land, there lived two friends, a cat and a dog. They played together every day. They liked to run, jump, and have fun.
One day, the cat found a big toy. The dog saw it too. The cat said, "Let's share the toy!" The dog agreed. They played with the toy and had lots of fun.
After playing, they sat under a tree. They talked about how nice it was to share. They promised to always be kind and share with each other. And they lived happily in the charming land.

One day, a small boy named Tim saw a comet in the sky. He wanted to touch it. He asked his friend, Sam, "How can I touch the comet?" Sam said, "We can have a race to see who can touch it first. The winner will be the one who touches the comet."
Tim and Sam started the race. They ran and ran, but the comet was very high in the sky. They tried to jump, but they could not reach it. It was a tough race. They both felt tired. They stopped and said, "We cannot win this race."
Just then, a big bird came and said, "I can help you touch the comet." The bird took Tim and Sam on its back and flew up to the comet. They touched the comet and felt very happy. They thanked the bird and went back home.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had a long tail. One day, he found some paint. Spot had a fun idea. He wanted to paint his tail.
Spot asked his friend, Cat, "Can you help me paint my tail?" Cat was very serious. She said, "Yes, I will help you, Spot." So, they found a big brush and started to paint Spot's tail.
They painted Spot's tail many colors. It was red, blue, and yellow. Spot was very happy. He wagged his tail and the paint splashed everywhere. Cat laughed and said, "Now, we are both colorful!"
Spot and Cat played all day with their painted tails. They were the best of friends. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. He lived near a big pond. One day, he went to the pond to play with clay. He liked to make things with clay. He made a clay boat and put it in the water.
A frog saw Tom and said, "What are you doing?" Tom said, "I am playing with clay. I made a boat." The frog said, "Can I play too?" Tom said, "Yes, let's play together."
They both played with the clay and made more boats. They had a race with the boats. They laughed and had fun. Then, something unexpected happened. A big fish jumped out of the water and splashed them. The fish said, "I want to play too!" They all laughed and played together, making more clay boats and splashing in the water.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park with her mom. They sat on the grass and had a yummy lunch. Lucy loved her sandwich with cheese and her apple juice. After lunch, Lucy's mom gave her a short lecture about not talking to strangers.
As they sat, Lucy began to gaze at the big, red ball that was near a tree. She wanted to play with it. Suddenly, a big, friendly dog came and took the ball in its mouth. "Woof!" said the dog. "Hi doggy, can I play with you?" asked Lucy. The dog wagged its tail and dropped the ball for Lucy to throw.
Lucy's mom watched as Lucy and the dog played together. She was happy to see her little girl having fun, but she didn't know who the dog belonged to. Then, the dog's owner, an old lady, came over and said, "I'm sorry, my dog ran away from me. I hope he didn't bother you." Lucy's mom smiled and said, "No, he's been a good friend to Lucy today." And they all became friends, playing with the ball and laughing together in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly man named Mr. Happy. He liked to teach kids how to play with a big round shield. The shield was red and blue, and all the kids loved it.
One sunny day, Mr. Happy went to the park with the shield. He saw a little girl named Sally. Sally was sad because she did not know how to play with the shield. Mr. Happy wanted to help her.
He showed Sally how to hold the shield and how to play with it. Sally was very happy and thankful. They played together all day long. From that day on, Sally and Mr. Happy became good friends, and they played with the shield every day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl called Polly. She had twelve toys but didn't know how to organize them. So one day, she asked her father for help.
Father said, "Let's make a farm with your toys."
Polly was very happy and she got to work organizing the toys. She lined them up in a line, created a black path and put a toy cow in the middle.
When she had finished organizing the farm, her father said, "Polly, how about we put food and water dishes around the farm for the cow?"
Polly quickly placed the dishes around the farm and the cow could now eat and drink. She was very pleased.
The next day, her father surprised her with a black puppy and said, "Let's see if the puppy can play in your farm." Polly was very excited and she organized the farm again, adding some sticks and a toy dog to the farm.
She was happy that she had managed to organize the farm and it looked even better. The farm was ready and the puppy ran around the farm with the other puppies. Polly was happy that she had successfully organized her farm.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue lived in a cute house with her adorable dog, Zigzag. One sunny day, Sue and Zigzag went outside to play in the park.
In the park, they saw many friends. Sue and Zigzag gathered with their friends to play a game of catch. They laughed and had fun as they threw the ball back and forth. Zigzag ran in zigzags to catch the ball, making everyone giggle.
Sue's friend Tim said, "Zigzag is so funny when he runs!" Sue replied, "Yes, he loves to run in zigzags!" They all continued to play and have fun until it was time to go home. Sue and Zigzag waved goodbye to their friends and walked back to their cute house, ready for a good night's sleep.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom loved to play with his friends. One day, Tom saw a big red boot in the park. He thought it was a toy and wanted to play with it.
Tom decided to steal the red boot to play at home. He took it and ran away very fast. But, soon, a sad boy named Tim came to the park. He was looking for his red boot. Tom saw Tim and felt bad for taking the boot.
Tom knew it was wrong to steal. He wanted to make things right. So, Tom carried the red boot back to the park and gave it to Tim. Tim was so happy to have his boot back. They both learned that stealing is wrong and being kind is important. From that day on, Tom and Tim became best friends and played together every day.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big flag that could rise up and down. Tim wanted to play with the flag, but he didn't know how.
Tim saw a man named Bob. Bob said, "To make the flag rise, you pull this rope." Tim pulled the rope, but the flag didn't move. Tim felt stupid. He tried again, but still, the flag didn't rise.
Then, a little dog came and started to pull the rope too. With the dog's help, the flag began to rise! Tim was happy and said, "Thank you, dog! I didn't know a dog could help me!" The dog wagged its tail, and they played together all day.

One day, a lazy cat named Tom went to play in the backyard. He saw his friend, a dog named Max. Max was very happy to see Tom. They liked to play together.
"Let's play!" said Max. Tom agreed and they started to run around. They played hide and seek, and tag. After playing for a long time, they got tired. Max said, "I want a hug, Tom." Tom gave Max a big hug. They were very happy.
Suddenly, a big bird came down from the sky. The bird picked up Max and flew away! Tom was very sad. He wanted to help Max, but he didn't know how. The bird took Max far away, and Tom never saw his friend again.

Sara and Ben are friends who like to play in the park. One day, they see a big melon on a table near the swings. The melon is green and round and looks yummy.
"Can we have some melon?" Sara asks Ben.
"I don't know. Maybe the melon belongs to someone else," Ben says.
They look around and see no one near the table. The melon is alone and quiet.
"Maybe they forgot the melon. Maybe they don't want it anymore," Sara says.
She walks to the table and picks up the melon. It is heavy and cold in her hands.
"Let's go and find a hidden place to eat the melon," she says to Ben.
She runs to the slide and climbs up. Ben follows her with a smile.
They sit on the top of the slide and break the melon with their hands. The melon is juicy and sweet. They eat and eat and make a mess.
They are happy and full.
But then they hear a voice.
"Hey, where is my melon?" the voice says.
It is a man with a hat and a bag. He is looking for his melon.
He sees Sara and Ben on the slide with the melon.
"Hey, you two! That is my melon! Why did you take it?" he says.
He is angry and loud.
Sara and Ben are scared and sorry.
They did not know the melon was his. They did not mean to make him mad.
They slide down and give him the melon.
"We are sorry, mister. We thought the melon was free. We were hungry and wanted some melon," Sara says.
"Yeah, we are sorry. We did not ask if we could have some melon. We did not permit ourselves to take it," Ben says.
The man looks at them and sees their faces. They are sad and honest.
He sighs and smiles.
"It's okay, kids. I understand. You can have some melon. But next time, please ask before you take something that is not yours," he says.
He cuts the melon and gives them each a slice.
They say thank you and eat the melon.
They are happy and full again.
They learn a lesson and make a friend.

One day, a clumsy sheep named Bob lived on a farm. Bob had a lot of wool. He wanted to play with his friends, but his wool was too big and heavy. It made it hard for him to run and jump.
One day, a girl named Sue came to the farm. Sue saw that Bob was sad. She wanted to help him. Sue thought that if she cut some of Bob's wool, he could play with his friends. But the other sheep did not want Bob to lose his wool. They liked how big and fluffy he was.
Sue talked to the other sheep. She told them that Bob would be happier if he could play with them. The other sheep understood and agreed. So, Sue cut some of Bob's wool. Now, Bob could run and jump with his friends. Everyone was happy, and they all played together on the farm.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man. He was so wealthy, he had lots of money! One day, he was walking down a path and he saw a bubble. He wanted to catch it, so he ran after it. But the bubble was too quick and it kept moving away.
The man was so desperate to catch the bubble, he did not see a hole in the path. He fell down the hole and it was very deep! He was frightened, but then he saw lots of bubbles at the bottom. He had fallen into a bubble pond!
The man was so happy he had found the bubbles. He laughed and laughed until he could laugh no more. Then, the bubble flew away into the sky and the man was very sad. But he was still wealthy so it was ok.

It was Tom's birthday and he was very happy. He had a big cake with four candles and many presents. His friends came to his house to celebrate with him. They played games, sang songs and ate cake. Tom felt very lucky and smiled a lot.
But there was one thing that made Tom uncomfortable. He had to wear a new shirt that his grandma gave him. It was very wide and itchy. It was too big for him and he did not like it. He wanted to take it off, but he did not want to make his grandma sad. She said it was a special shirt for his birthday.
Tom tried to ignore the shirt and have fun with his friends. But he could not. The shirt bothered him a lot. He scratched his neck and pulled his sleeves. He felt hot and unhappy. He wished he could wear his old shirt that was soft and cozy.
When the party was over, Tom said goodbye to his friends and thanked them for coming. He hugged his grandma and said he liked the shirt. But he did not mean it. He ran to his room and took off the shirt. He threw it on the floor and put on his old shirt. He felt much better. He looked at his presents and his cake and felt happy again. He decided to celebrate his birthday in his old shirt. He thought it was the best shirt ever.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a bird on a tree. The bird is weird. It has blue and green feathers and a long tail.
"Look, a weird bird!" Tom says.
"Wow, it is pretty!" Mia says.
They want to see the bird better. They go closer to the tree. The bird sees them. It makes a loud noise.
"Shoo, shoo, go away!" the bird says.
Tom and Mia are surprised. The bird can talk!
"Did you hear that?" Tom says.
"Yes, I did!" Mia says.
They think the bird is funny. They laugh.
"Ha, ha, ha, you are a silly bird!" Tom says.
"Ha, ha, ha, you are a funny bird!" Mia says.
The bird does not like to be laughed at. It feels angry. It wants to tease Tom and Mia.
"Ha, ha, ha, you are silly kids!" the bird says.
"Ha, ha, ha, you are funny kids!" the bird says.
Tom and Mia are confused. The bird is copying them!
"Stop it, stop it, don't copy us!" Tom says.
"Stop it, stop it, don't copy us!" the bird says.
Tom and Mia are annoyed. The bird is teasing them!
"Go away, go away, leave us alone!" Mia says.
"Go away, go away, leave us alone!" the bird says.
Tom and Mia are mad. The bird is mean!
They run away from the tree. They find another place to play. They don't want to see the weird bird again. The bird is alone. It feels sad. It wishes it had friends.

It was a sunny day in the park. The trees were tall and the grass was green.
Roger was playing on the swings. He wanted to go higher and higher. He was having lots of fun.
Suddenly, he noticed a smelly old box by a tree. He decided to go and take a look. He walked over and grabbed it.
He could feel something moving inside. He quickly opened the box. Surprise! A little puppy jumped out.
Roger was so happy. He gave the puppy a big hug. It licked his face!
Roger whispered, "Let's play together." The puppy barked and they went on the swings. Roger had never seen a smelly open box have such a happy ending.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl and she wanted an expensive gift for her birthday. She asked her mom for it, but the mom said she couldn’t afford it. The little girl was very sad.
The mom wanted to make her daughter feel happy, so she thought of a special plan. She went to the store and bought a piece of paper. She folded the paper carefully and put it inside a box. She said to her daughter, “This is a very special gift for you. It’s very expensive.”
The little girl smiled and hugged her mom. She carefully opened the box and when she saw the folded paper, she was very disappointed. The mom had lied to her.
The little girl felt very angry and sad. She threw the box away and ran away from the house. She never came back.
The mom was very sad and felt bad for what she did. She had folded the paper, but she couldn't fold the broken relationship with her daughter.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Buddy. Buddy was very enthusiastic. He loved to play outside in the sunny weather. One day, Buddy went outside to play with his friends.
Buddy and his friends played in the park. They ran and jumped all day. They had so much fun! But soon, they got tired and thirsty. They found a big puddle of water to drink from. They drank and drank until their tummies were full.
Then, they laid down in the sun to dry off. They felt warm and happy. The sun made them dry and they got ready to play again. Buddy and his friends played in the sunny weather until it was time to go home. They were very happy and couldn't wait to play together again.

One day, a boy named Tim found a hat. It was a big, red hat. Tim liked the hat a lot. He put the hat on his head and went to play with his friend, Sam.
Sam saw the hat and wanted it too. They both wanted the hat and did not want to share. So, they decided to split the hat in half. They took the hat off and pulled it apart. But the hat was very strong and did not split.
Then, they saw a big, disgusting bug on the hat. The bug was very yucky. Tim and Sam did not want the hat anymore. They threw the hat away and played together without it. The hat was not important anymore. They were just happy to play together.

Once upon a time, there was a big brown dog named Max. Max had a toy made of leather. He loved to poke and play with it all day. Max was very happy with his toy.
One day, a little cat named Fluffy came to visit Max. Fluffy saw Max's leather toy and felt jealous. Fluffy wanted to poke and play with the toy too. So, Fluffy tried to take the toy away from Max.
Max did not like this. He got very mad and started to fight with Fluffy. They both tried to poke each other. In the end, Max and Fluffy got hurt. They both lost their friend and the leather toy. Max and Fluffy were very sad.

One day, Tom was walking in the park when he saw a soccer player. He was very tall and wore a loud uniform. Tom was curious and asked, "What are you doing?" The soccer player smiled and said, "I'm playing soccer. Would you like to join us?" Tom wanted to try and quickly followed the soccer player to the field.
When Tom arrived, everyone looked at him. He was feeling shy but the soccer player said, "Don't worry, everyone's very friendly here!" Tom gave a small smile and nervously stepped onto the field.
The soccer player taught Tom how to kick the ball. Tom was very excited but he could not kick it very far. Everyone cheered and said, "Keep practicing and you'll get better!"
Tom smiled and said, "Thank you, I'll practice every day!" He was so excited to learn something new. With a loud cheer, the soccer game began!

Once upon a time, there was a big, fearful bear named Bobo. He lived in a luxury cave with lots of soft things to sleep on. Bobo loved to eat sweet honey from the bees. One day, he went for a walk to find more honey.
As Bobo walked, he saw a little girl named Lily. She was crying under a tree. Bobo went to her and asked, "Why are you crying, little girl?" Lily looked up and said, "I was climbing the tree to get my toy, but I fall down and now I can't find it."
Bobo wanted to help Lily. He looked around and saw the toy stuck high up in the tree. Bobo was scared of climbing trees, but he wanted to make Lily happy. So he took a deep breath and climbed up the tree. When he reached the top, he grabbed the toy and started to climb back down.
As Bobo was climbing down, a big wind blew and he began to fall. But instead of hitting the ground, he landed on a big, soft pile of leaves. Lily clapped and laughed, "You found my toy and a fun new game!"
From that day on, Bobo and Lily became best friends. They played together every day, and Bobo was no longer a fearful bear.

Once upon a time, in a big valley, there lived a nosy cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to know what everyone was doing. One day, she saw a sack near her friend Doggy's house. She wanted to know what was in the sack.
Kitty went to Doggy and asked, "Doggy, what is in the sack?" Doggy said, "I don't know, Kitty. I found it by the tree." They both decided to open the sack together. They pulled and pulled, and the sack opened. Out came lots of toys!
Kitty and Doggy were very happy. They played with the toys all day long. But then, their friend Birdy came by. She was sad because the toys were hers, and she lost them. Kitty and Doggy felt bad. They gave the toys back to Birdy and said sorry. Birdy was happy again.
The three friends learned that it is not good to be nosy and take things that are not yours. They promised to always ask before taking something and to always help each other. And they lived happily ever after in the big valley.

Once upon a time there was a small village in an ancient land. In the village there was a festival held every year. When the festival came around everybody in the village got excited.
Rou was a three year old girl living in the village. She asked her parents what the festival was about. "It is to celebrate our ancient culture," her parents replied.
On the day of the festival everybody wore their traditional outfits. People danced and sang while they celebrated. Rou got caught up in the festival and started to dance around with the other villagers.
Eventually, the festival ended but Rou will always remember the excitement she got when it started.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to write poems. One day, she wrote a poem about a dangerous lion. The lion was big and strong, but he was also very nice.
Lily promised her friend, Tim, that she would share her poem with him. Tim was very excited to hear the poem. He knew that Lily wrote the best poems in their class. But, Tim was also a little scared because the lion in the poem was dangerous.
When Lily read her poem to Tim, he was very happy. The dangerous lion in the poem was not so scary after all. The lion just wanted to be friends with everyone. Tim and Lily both smiled and promised to write more poems together.

Once there was a brown painter who had to do an important job. She had to fit the pieces of a big painting together to make it look beautiful. But the pieces didn't seem to fit and it was making her feel very frustrated. She tried many different ways to get them to fit, but nothing worked.
Finally, the painter decided to ask for help. She called her best friend and he came to her house with a toolbox. He asked the painter what the problem was and he listened carefully. Then he found the right tool and showed the painter how to use it to fit the pieces of the painting together.
The painter was very relieved, she thanked her friend and watched as he worked. Soon enough, the pieces fit perfectly and the painting was beautiful. The painter was so happy to finally have it finished. She thanked her friend again and hugged him. The painter was sure she couldn't have done it with out his help. The painter was proud of how the brown painting turned out and there was no more pain from trying to fit it together.

Once upon a time, in a fine summer, a little girl named Lily and her dog, Max, went to play in the park. They liked to run, jump, and play all day long. The sun was up high, and the sky was very blue.
One day, while they were playing, Max found a big, round ball. Max barked and said, "Lily, look! A ball!" Lily looked at the ball and smiled. She said, "Let's play with it, Max!" They took turns throwing and catching the ball. They were very happy.
After playing for a long time, Max was tired. He lay down on the soft grass. Lily sat down next to him and began to rub his soft fur. Max wagged his tail and said, "Thank you, Lily. That feels nice." They enjoyed the rest of their fine summer day together, feeling the warm sun on their faces.

Once upon a time there lived a rich man. He had a lot of money, but he was not happy. He decided to make a record of his life and take it wherever he went. He bought a new tap and decided to use it to record his life.
One day he was walking through the forest and he heard a loud noise coming from a tree. He tapped the tree with his new tap and he heard a voice coming from inside. The voice said, "If you stop recording your life, I will give you lots of riches and make you the happiest man in the world!"
The rich man was tempted, but he knew that his life was too important to record. He ran away and continued recording his life. The voice kept calling out to him and promised him many riches, but the man would not stop recording.
The rich man went on recording his life and soon, he found true happiness without the need of any riches. He was happy he had made the right choice, and he kept recording his life until the very end.

One day, a little girl named Amy went to school. She was very excited because today, her teach was going to show her how to clap. Amy loved to clap her hands and make noise. She couldn't wait to learn more about it.
When Amy got to school, she saw a boy named Tom. Tom was a rude boy. He liked to make fun of others and laugh at them. When Amy told Tom that she was going to learn how to clap, he laughed at her. He said that clapping was easy and that she was silly for not knowing how to do it.
Amy felt sad, but she didn't let Tom's rude words stop her. She went to her teach and asked for help. The teach showed Amy how to clap her hands together and make a fun sound. Amy practiced and practiced until she could clap really well. Then, she went back to Tom and showed him what she had learned. Tom was surprised and stopped being rude. He even asked Amy to teach him how to clap better. And from that day on, Amy and Tom clapped together and became friends.

One warm day, a little alligator named Al went for a walk. He liked to whistle a happy song. Al walked near the river and saw a big tree. Under the tree, he found a small bird who could not fly.
"Hi, bird," said Al. "Why can't you fly?"
"My wing hurts," said the bird. "I fell from the tree."
Al wanted to help the bird. He whistled a soft song to make the bird feel better. The bird smiled and thanked Al.
With a big smile, Al carried the bird back to its nest in the tree. The bird was happy and safe. Al felt good for helping his new friend. He walked back to the river and whistled his happy song.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his ball and drink water from the faucet. Every day, Spot would run around the yard and have lots of fun.
One day, while Spot was playing, he saw a big, round thing on the ground. He thought it was his ball, but it looked different. It was brown and soft. Spot said, "What is this? It's not my ball!" He tried to play with it, but it was not fun at all. It started to rot and smell bad.
Suddenly, the brown thing opened, and a tiny fairy came out! The fairy said, "Thank you, Spot, for finding my home! I was stuck inside, and I couldn't get out. Because you are so loyal and kind, I will give you a new ball to play with!" Spot was so happy, and he played with his new ball all day long.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a young boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys all day. One day, Tim got a new toy, a big ball with a label on it. The label had a picture of a happy face.
Tim went outside to play with his new ball. He saw his friend, Sam, playing alone. Tim asked, "Sam, do you want to play with my new ball?" Sam smiled and said, "Yes, Tim! I would love to play with you and your new ball."
Tim and Sam played with the ball all day long. They laughed and had a lot of fun. When it was time to go home, Tim gave Sam the ball's label as a gift. Sam was very happy and said, "Thank you, Tim! You are a very kind friend."
The moral of the story is to always share and play with others. When you share, you make others happy and you can have more fun together.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to slide on the big slide. The slide was smooth and fast. They laughed and had fun.
"Let's go again!" Tom said.
"OK!" Lily said.
They ran to the slide. But Tom was too fast. He did not look where he was going. He slipped on a wet leaf. He fell down and hit his head. He cried out loud.
Lily ran to him. She was scared. She saw blood on his head. She called for help.
"Tom, are you OK?" she asked.
"No, it hurts!" Tom said.
A lady came to help. She had a phone. She called an ambulance. She said Tom needed to go to the hospital. She said he had a big cut on his head. She said he might need stitches.
Lily felt sorry for Tom. She wished she could make him feel better. She wished they had been more careful. She learned a lesson. She learned to watch out for slippery things. She learned to be safe when playing.

There was a little boy, Tommy, that was three years old. He was a happy boy that loved to play games.
One day, Tommy wanted to play a game, so he asked his mom, "Can we play a game, Mom?"
His mom was busy making dinner, so she said, "I'm sorry, Tommy, we can't play right now. I'm too busy."
Tommy thought for a moment and then declared, "Let's play a game with clapping!"
His mom was surprised and asked, "What kind of game can you play with clapping?"
Tommy beamed and said, "We can play clap and jump! I'll clap my hands and you jump!"
His mom laughed, and they both clapped their hands and jumped. When they finished, Tommy applauded and said, "That was so much fun!"
His mom smiled and said, "It was a lot of fun! We should play this game again."
Tommy agreed, and they both clapped and cheered.

Once upon a time, there was a big, clear oven. The oven was in a small kitchen. It was friends with a pot and a pan. They all lived together in the kitchen.
One day, the pot and the pan started to fight. The pot said, "I am the best for cooking!" The pan said, "No, I am the best!" They were very loud and angry.
The oven did not like the fight. It said, "Please stop fighting. We are all good for cooking. Let's be friends and cook together." The pot and the pan stopped fighting. They all cooked a yummy meal and were happy together.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big storm called Hurricane. People were scared because the wind was very strong. They needed to tie things down so they would not fly away.
In this town, there was a deaf dog named Spot. Spot could not hear the wind, but he could feel it. He saw his friends tying things down, so he wanted to help too. Spot found a rope and started to tie things down with his mouth.
As Spot was tying things, something unexpected happened. He tied the rope to a big tree and the wind stopped. The Hurricane was gone! It turned out that the tree was magic and it made the storm go away. Spot became a hero and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom liked to eat a lot. He lived in a small house with a little girl named Sue. Sue loved Tom very much. They played together every day.
One day, Sue wanted to make a yummy snack for Tom. She went to the kitchen and used a pan. She put some food in the pan and cooked it. The smell was very good. Tom came running to see what Sue was making.
Sue gave Tom the snack from the pan. Tom ate it all up. He was very happy. Sue and Tom played together all day. They were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. He had a loud roar. One day, he found a shiny crystal in the forest. The lion liked the crystal very much. He picked it up and played with it.
The lion had a friend, a small bird. The bird was weak, but she was very smart. She saw the lion playing with the crystal. She told him to be careful, because the crystal was very special.
The lion listened to the bird. He put the crystal in a safe place. They both took turns watching it. They were very happy. The lion's roar was even louder now. And the weak bird felt stronger because she had a good friend. They lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to go to the theater with his mom and dad. They would watch plays in an ancient building that looked very old.
One day, while they were at the theater, Tim saw a talking cat. The cat said, "Hello, Tim! I am lost. Can you help me return home?" Tim was surprised but wanted to help the cat. So, Tim asked his mom and dad if they could help the cat find its way home.
As they walked together, they found a secret door in the theater. They opened it and saw a magical world inside. The cat said, "Thank you, Tim, for helping me return home!" And just like that, the cat and the magical world disappeared. Tim, his mom, and dad were amazed by what they had just seen. They knew it was a special day they would never forget.

Once upon a time, in a lively forest, there lived a little rabbit named Remy. Remy loved to slide down the hills with his friends. They would play and slide all day long. The sun was always shining, and the birds were singing.
One day, Remy's mom called him home for dinner. Remy was having so much fun sliding that he didn't want to stop. He thought, "I can play a little more and eat dinner later." So, Remy kept playing and sliding with his friends.
Soon, it was dark, and Remy was very hungry. He went home, but there was no dinner left. His mom said, "Remy, you should have come home when I called you." Remy felt sad and hungry. He learned that it is important to listen to his mom and come home for dinner when she calls. From that day on, Remy always made sure to go home for dinner on time, and his mom was very happy.

Once upon a time, there were two friends who loved to play together every day. They were brother and sister, named Max and Rachel.
Max wanted a nice, fancy gift for his friend, so he looked around until he saw the perfect thing. It was a bright, blue ball.
He offered it to Rachel, and she smiled. But then she asked, “What if I want something else?”
Max scowled. “Why would you want something else? This is the best!”
Rachel was not sure what to say. She replied, “Let’s not quarrel, okay?”
Max said, “Okay…”
Rachel thanked him for the nice gift. “Wait until you see what I have for you!” she said.
Max raised an eyebrow. “What is it?”
Rachel smiled and said, “You’ll see!”
The next day, Rachel gave Max a fancy toy fire truck. Max’s eyes lit up and he shouted, “This is so much better than a blue ball!”
Rachel had been right, after all.

John wanted to stay at the store. Every day he went to the store, and it was always the same - lots of things to look at and many people.
Every day John saw the store manager. He was a regular at the store. He always said hello to John.
John liked to stay at the store and look at all the things he wanted to buy. He would touch and feel the different objects.
One day, John asked his parents if they could stay at the store a little longer. His parents agreed and John got to stay even longer. He looked at more things and waved goodbye to the manager.
John was excited that his parents let him stay at the store. From then on, he visited the store every single day!

Once upon a time, there was a green frog named Bob. He lived by a big lake. Bob loved to jump, swim, and play with his friends. Every day, they would speak to each other and have fun.
One sunny day, while Bob was playing by the lake, he saw something in the water. It was big and shiny. He called his friends to come and see. They all looked at the big shiny thing and wondered what it was.
Suddenly, the big shiny thing started to speak! It said, "Hello, I am a magic fish! I can grant each of you one wish." Bob and his friends were so surprised. They thought about their wishes and told the magic fish. The magic fish granted their wishes, and they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a messy boy named Tim went to play outside. He liked to jump in mud and make a big mess. His mom always told him to clean up, but he did not listen. Tim had a big smile on his face while playing in the mud.
Tim's mom needed help to find her phone. She could not call her friend. Tim wanted to help, so he stopped playing in the mud. He looked all around the house for the phone. It was hard to find because everything in the house was messy.
Tim asked his friends to unite and help find the phone. All the kids came together and looked for the phone. They found it under a pile of toys. Tim's mom was happy and thanked all the kids. Tim learned that when friends unite, they can do anything.

Once upon a time there were two friends who were walking in the hot heat of the sun. The path was long and they were getting a bit tired and thirsty.
Suddenly one of them started to cry. The other one was very brave and told her, "Why are you crying? Let's not be upset and we will find a way to get out of this heat."
The friend who was crying stopped and asked, "How?"
The brave one answered, "Let's just keep walking and see what happens. Trust me, we can do it together."
So they started walking again. After a while, they had some luck because they saw a tree with lots of leaves and shadows in front of them. Both friends were very happy and refreshed in the cool shadows of the tree.
After that, they never gave up no matter how big the challenge and they worked together to find solutions.
The moral of the story is that sometimes we just have to be brave and never give up, because together we can find solutions even in the toughest of situations.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a man with a big mustache. He was very gifted. He could do many things. People would say, "Wow, he is so good at that!"
One day, he saw a little girl crying. She lost her toy. The man with the mustache wanted to help. He looked and looked, but he could not find the toy. The little girl was still sad. The man with the mustache had an idea. He went home and made a new toy for the girl. When he gave the toy to the girl, she was very happy. She said, "Thank you for the toy!"
The people in the town saw what the man with the mustache did. They learned that being gifted is not just about doing things well. It is also about helping others and being kind. The man with the mustache showed them that it is good to use your gifts to make others happy. And from that day on, the people in the town tried their best to help each other and be kind.

Lily liked to play deliver with her toys. She had a big box that she pretended was a truck. She put her dolls and animals inside and drove them around the room. She made noises like beep beep and vroom vroom. She stopped at different places and gave them to her friends. She was very happy.
But Max, her brother, did not like her game. He wanted to play police with his cars and guns. He said deliver was boring and silly. He was very bossy. He told Lily to stop and give him her box. He said he needed it for his police station. He grabbed it from her and pushed her away. She was very sad.
Lily cried and ran to her mom. She told her what Max did. Mom was not happy. She said Max was not nice and he had to share. She went to his room and saw him playing with the box. She said he had to give it back to Lily. He said no. He said it was his now. He was very stubborn.
Mom said he had to listen or he would be in trouble. She said she had a surprise for Lily. She said she ordered a real deliver truck for her. She said it was coming soon. She said Max could not play with it. She said it was only for Lily. She said Lily was a good girl and she deserved it. She was very proud.
Max was very surprised. He did not know mom ordered a truck for Lily. He felt bad. He realized he was mean to her. He wanted to say sorry. He wanted to play with her. He wanted to see the truck. He gave the box back to Lily. He said he was sorry. He said he liked her game. He said he wanted to be her friend. He was very sorry.
Lily was very happy. She forgave Max. She said he could play with her. She said they could share the box. She said they could be deliver and police together. She said they could have fun. She was very kind.
They hugged and smiled. They played with the box until the real truck arrived. They were very excited. They thanked mom and ran to the door. They saw the truck and the driver. He said he had a special deliver for Lily. He gave her the truck and a big hug. He said he was happy to see her. He said he was her dad. He said he was a deliver man. He said he came home from work. He was very loving.

One day, a big van was driving down the road. The van was dark and had many toys inside. The driver, a nice man named Tom, was taking the toys to a playground for the kids to play with.
As Tom was driving, he saw a big tree on the side of the road. He felt tired, so he decided to stop and rest under the tree for a little while. While Tom was resting, a small dog came up to the van and smelled the toys inside.
The dog wanted to play with the toys too, so it pushed the van door open with its nose. All of a sudden, the van started to roll down the hill! The dog barked and ran after the van, trying to stop it. Tom woke up and saw the van rolling away. He ran as fast as he could to catch up with it.
Just when it looked like the van was going to crash into a big rock, the dog jumped in front of it and pushed with all its strength. The van stopped just in time! Tom was so happy and thanked the dog for saving the van and the toys. The dog wagged its tail and Tom knew it was the dog's way of saying, "You're welcome!"
From that day on, Tom and the dog became best friends. They drove around in the dark van, delivering toys to all the kids at the playgrounds. And whenever Tom needed to rest, the dog would watch over the van to make sure nothing unexpected happened again.

Anna and Ben love to dance. They dance in the morning, they dance in the afternoon, they dance at night. They dance with their toys, they dance with their pets, they dance with each other. They are very jolly when they dance.
One day, they hear a big sound outside. They look out the window and see a big truck. The truck has many boxes and bags. They wonder what is in the truck. They run to the door and ask their mom.
"Mom, what is in the truck?" they ask.
"Those are our things, my dears. We are moving to a new house today. We have to pack and go soon." Mom says.
Anna and Ben feel sad. They do not want to leave their house. They do not want to leave their friends. They do not want to stop dancing.
"Mom, can we dance one more time?" they ask.
"Of course, my dears. You can dance while I finish packing. But hurry up, we have to pass the keys to the new people soon." Mom says.
Anna and Ben smile. They run to their room and turn on the music. They dance with their toys, they dance with their pets, they dance with each other. They are very jolly when they dance.
They dance until they hear Mom call them.
"Come on, my dears. It is time to go. The truck is waiting for us." Mom says.
Anna and Ben turn off the music and grab their bags. They say goodbye to their room, their toys, their pets. They hug each other and walk to the door.
They see the new people waiting for them. They are a mom, a dad, and a little girl. The little girl has a big smile. She sees Anna and Ben and waves at them.
"Hi, I am Lily. I am going to live in your house. Do you like to dance?" she asks.
Anna and Ben look at each other and smile. They nod and say yes.
"Me too! I love to dance. Maybe we can dance together sometime. Do you want to be my friends?" Lily asks.
Anna and Ben nod and say yes.
They pass the keys to Lily's mom and dad. They hug Lily and say goodbye. They get in the truck with their mom and drive away.
They look out the window and see Lily waving at them. They wave back and smile. They are sad to leave, but happy to make a new friend. They hope to dance with her again. They are still jolly when they dance.

Once upon a time, there was a bird who loved to sing. The bird wanted to sing opera, but his voice was weird. He tried to sing louder, but it only made the other animals laugh.
One day, the bird met a frog. The frog said, "Why do you sing so weird?" The bird felt sad but replied, "I want to sing opera, but my voice is not good." The frog thought for a moment and said, "I have an idea! Let's have a singing contest. Maybe that will help you sing better."
The bird and the frog told all the animals about the contest. On the day of the contest, all the animals came to listen. The bird tried to sing opera, but his voice was still weird. The frog sang a simple song, and all the animals clapped.
In the end, the bird felt very sad. He knew he could not sing opera like he wanted to. The other animals felt bad for the bird, but they didn't know how to help. The bird flew away, still singing his weird opera, hoping one day he would find a way to sing better.

Ben was a boy who liked to play with his puppy, Spot. Spot was a nice puppy who liked to run, jump and lick Ben's face. Ben and Spot were best friends.
One day, Ben's mom said they had to go to the store. She said they had to buy some food and some supplies for the house. Ben asked if he could bring Spot with him. His mom said yes, but he had to hold Spot's leash and be careful.
Ben and Spot went to the store with Ben's mom. They saw many things in the store, like toys, books and clothes. Ben wanted to look at everything, but he also wanted to hold Spot's leash. He tried to do both, but it was hard.
Ben saw a big ball that he liked. He let go of Spot's leash and ran to the ball. He picked up the ball and threw it in the air. He laughed and caught the ball. He did not see that Spot ran away.
Ben's mom saw that Ben let go of Spot's leash. She was worried. She called Ben and asked him where Spot was. Ben looked around and did not see Spot. He felt scared and sad. He dropped the ball and ran to his mom. He said he was sorry and he wanted to find Spot.
Ben and his mom looked for Spot in the store. They asked the people if they saw a nice puppy. They looked in every aisle and every corner. They did not find Spot. Ben cried and said he missed Spot.
Then, they heard a bark. They followed the sound and saw Spot. Spot was in the pet section of the store. He was playing with some other puppies. He saw Ben and his mom and ran to them. He licked Ben's face and wagged his tail. Ben hugged Spot and said he was happy.
Ben's mom was happy too. She said she was glad they found Spot. She said Ben had to be more careful with Spot's leash. She said Spot was a nice puppy, but he could get lost or hurt if he ran away. She said Ben had to be a good friend to Spot and keep him safe.
Ben said he understood. He said he was sorry and he would not let go of Spot's leash again. He said he loved Spot and he wanted to be a good friend to him. He said he learned his lesson.
Ben and his mom bought some food and some supplies for the house. They also bought a new toy for Spot. They went home and played with Spot. Ben and Spot were happy. They were best friends.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a thin cat named Tim. Tim liked to play with his friend, a little girl named Ann. They had lots of fun together.
One day, Ann's mom mentioned a big park to the east. Ann and Tim decided to go on an adventure to find it. They walked and walked until they saw a big tree. They knew they were close.
Finally, they found the park. It was big and full of fun things to do. Ann and Tim played all day. They were so happy they went on their adventure to the east. And from that day on, they visited the park all the time.

Jimmy was a very enthusiastic three-year-old. Every day he would wake up full of energy, ready to start his day.
Today Jimmy's mommy had bought him some clay. It was a special clay just for him. It was a white and squishy.
Jimmy's eyes lit up when he saw the clay. He wanted to play with it right away! He grabbed the clay and started pushing it. He spent hours poking and squishing the clay. He made different shapes with it and before he knew it, the day was over.
Jimmy had had a lot of fun playing with the clay. His enthusiasm showed in every shape he made with it. He was very proud of all the things he had created and couldn't wait to show them to his mommy.

Once upon a time, there was a modest little girl named Lily. Lily had a big computer in her room. She loved to play games on it with her friends.
One day, Lily's friend, Sam, came over to play. They wanted to play on the computer. But first, Lily's mom asked them to promise to be careful. "Promise me you will not spill anything on the computer," she said. Lily and Sam both said, "We promise!"
They played on the computer all day long. They had so much fun. At the end of the day, they remembered their promise and cleaned up the room. Lily's mom was happy, and they all had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to act like a big, brave dog. He would bark and jump around with his friends in the park. Max's friends liked how he acted, and they all played together.
One day, Max and his friends went on a search for a lost ball. They walked and sniffed all around the park. Max acted like the leader and showed his friends where to look. They looked under trees and behind bushes, but they could not find the ball.
As the sun went down, Max and his friends started to feel tired. They wanted to go back home where it was safe and warm. Max acted like a big, brave dog one more time and led his friends back home. They all felt safe and happy, even though they did not find the lost ball.

Once upon a time, there was a zoo. In this zoo, there were many animals who lived and played together. One day, a new animal came to the zoo. His name was Tom. Tom was a big, strong elephant who liked to work.
"Hi, I am Tom! I like to work!" said Tom to the other animals. But Tom was also a selfish elephant. He wanted to work alone and not share his work with the other animals. This made the other animals sad.
One day, the zookeeper needed help moving a big rock. Tom tried to move the rock by himself, but it was too heavy. The other animals saw Tom having a hard time. They decided to help Tom, even though he was selfish.
"Let's help Tom move the rock!" said the kind giraffe. All the animals worked together and moved the big rock easily. Tom learned that working together is better than being selfish. From that day on, Tom shared his work with his friends and they all lived happily in the zoo.

Once upon a time there lived three best friends; a cat, a duck and a mouse. They were always together, and they were very happy. One day, the cat did something that made the duck very mad. The duck was so mad that it would not talk to the cat.
The mouse wanted to help them to be friends again. The mouse had a plan. It brought some pasta to the duck and the cat. It said, "Let's all eat this tasty pasta together. Let's forgive each other and be friends again."
The duck and the cat agreed. They had the pasta. It was very good. Then the mouse said, "Let's clean up the space. We can make it nice and tidy." So the friends cleaned together. The space was very tidy.
The duck and the cat were happy again. They all enjoyed the tasty pasta, and they had fun cleaning together. They knew the importance of forgiving and being friends again.

Once upon a time, there was an ugly frog who lived by a big tree. The ugly frog liked to play with a big barrel. One day, a happy bird came to the ugly frog and said, "Let's play together!"
The ugly frog and the happy bird played with the big barrel. They rolled it, and they jumped on it. They had a lot of fun. The ugly frog was so happy that he started to clap his hands.
But then, the big barrel rolled too fast and fell into a deep hole. The ugly frog and the happy bird could not play with the big barrel anymore. They were very sad. The ugly frog learned that he should be more careful when playing with things.
The moral of the story is to always be careful when playing, so that you don't lose your toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a toy named Print. Print was a small, round ball with a happy face. Sue would play with Print all day long.
One day, Sue saw a boy named Tom playing with a toy car. Tom was being rude. He would not share his toy car with Sue. Sue felt sad and went back to play with Print.
Sue knew she needed to teach Tom to be nice. She took Print and rolled it over to Tom. Tom saw Print's happy face and started to play with it too. Soon, Tom and Sue were both playing with Print and having fun. Tom learned not to be rude and they all became good friends.

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play with paper and crayons. They make prints of their hands, their feet, and their faces. They have fun and laugh.
One day, Tom has a new idea. He says, "Let's make prints of our toys!" He takes his toy car and presses it on the paper. He makes a print of the car. He likes it. He says, "Look, Anna, this is my car print!"
Anna thinks it is a good idea. She takes her toy doll and presses it on the paper. She makes a print of the doll. She likes it. She says, "Look, Tom, this is my doll print!"
Tom and Anna make more prints of their toys. They fill the paper with prints. They are happy.
Then, they hear a knock on the door. It is their friend Ben. He comes in and sees their prints. He says, "Wow, these are cool prints! Can I have one?"
Tom and Anna look at each other. They have only one paper left. They both want to make more prints. They don't want to give their paper to Ben.
But then, they remember that Ben is their friend. They remember that sharing is good. They remember that being generous is nice.
They smile and say, "Sure, Ben, you can have our paper. You can make prints of your toys, too. We can all play together."
Ben is happy. He says, "Thank you, Tom and Anna. You are very generous. You are very good friends."
Tom and Anna are happy, too. They give their paper to Ben. They help him make prints of his toys. They have more fun and laugh.
The moral of the story is: Sharing is caring. Being generous makes everyone happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a small, harmless bug. The bug had an itch. Tim saw the bug wiggle and try to scratch the itch with its tiny legs. Tim wanted to help the bug, so he gently scratched the itch for it. The bug was happy and stopped wiggling.
"Thank you for helping me," said the bug. "I was so itchy, and you saved me from my itch. Can we be friends?"
"Yes, we can be friends!" Tim said with a big smile. They played together all day, running and laughing in the sun. They had so much fun being friends.
At the end of the day, Tim had to go home. He said goodbye to his new bug friend. They promised to play together again soon. Tim went home, feeling happy that he saved his new friend from the itch and made a new, harmless friend.

Once upon a time, there was a kind little girl called Daisy. She was only three years old and she loved having toast for breakfast.
One morning, her mum set a plate of toast down on the table for her. Daisy grabbed a slice, but it didn't fit into her mouth. She started crying and said "Mum, why isn't my toast fitting?"
Mum smiled and said: "Maybe we can find you a toast that fits!" Daisy quickly stopped crying and looked up, her little eyes full of hope.
Mum searched through the cupboard, but sadly, none of the toast seemed to fit. Daisy thought she was going to have to go hungry, when her mum had an idea! She cut Daisy's toast into small pieces and they fit perfectly.
Daisy was so happy and said, "Mummy, you’re so kind!"
Mum stayed with Daisy and they shared the toast together.
Afterwards, Daisy felt so full and happy, she knew that with kindness, and a little help, anything can fit!

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there was a little mosquito named Momo. Momo was an incredible mosquito who liked to speak with all his friends. He had many friends, like the big tree, the pretty flowers, and the happy birds.
One day, Momo saw a little boy crying in the garden. The boy was sad because he lost his toy. Momo wanted to help the boy, so he spoke to his friends. The big tree, the pretty flowers, and the happy birds all helped Momo to find the toy.
Momo found the toy and gave it back to the little boy. The boy was so happy and thanked Momo and his friends. Momo felt good for helping the boy, and all his friends were proud of him. The moral of the story is: when we help others, we feel happy and make our friends proud.

Once there was a little girl. She was three years old. She lived in a small village near a forest.
Every day, the little girl would take a big stick and explore the forest. One morning, the little girl was walking around the forest when she saw another little girl who looked exactly like her! The little girl was very jealous.
The other little girl noticed the stick in the first girl's hand and pointed to it. "Can I have it?" asked the other little girl. The first girl didn't want to give away her stick, so she started to cry and ran away.
The other little girl was sad that her new friend didn't want to share. She too started to cry when she realised that the first girl had gone.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play in the yard. They have a swing, a slide and a ball. They also like to watch the mail truck. The mail truck comes every day and brings letters and packages. Sometimes the mail truck stops at their house and the mail lady gives them something.
One day, Lily and Ben see a different mail truck. It is bigger and has a different color. They run to the fence and watch. The mail truck stops at their house and the mail man gets out. He has a big package for them.
"Hello, Lily and Ben," the mail man says. "I have a special delivery for you. Do you know what it is?"
Lily and Ben shake their heads. They are curious and excited.
"It is a present from your grandma and grandpa. They live far away and they miss you. They sent you this package to make you happy. Do you want to open it?"
Lily and Ben nod. They say thank you to the mail man and take the package. They run to the porch and open it. Inside, they find two teddy bears, one pink and one blue. They also find a book, a puzzle and some candy.
Lily and Ben hug the teddy bears and smile. They love their grandma and grandpa. They love the mail truck too. They wave to the mail man as he drives away. They can't wait to read the book, do the puzzle and eat the candy. They are very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big red truck. The truck liked to help people. One sunny day, the truck saw a little pale cat stuck in a tree.
The truck said, "Don't worry, cat! I will rescue you!" The truck reached up with its long ladder. The cat climbed down the ladder and was safe on the ground.
The cat said, "Thank you, truck!" The truck was happy to help. They became good friends and played together every day. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a big fridge in her house. Sue was glad because the fridge had yummy food inside. One day, Sue saw a pretty frog near the fridge. She thought it was a magic frog, like in the stories. Sue wanted to see if the frog would turn into a prince. So, she gave the frog a kiss.
The frog did not turn into a prince. Instead, it jumped away. Sue was sad. She went to the fridge to get some ice cream to feel better. But when she opened the fridge, all the yummy food was gone! The frog had eaten it all when Sue was not looking.
Sue learned that not all frogs are magic. She was not glad anymore. She wished she never kissed the frog. From that day on, Sue never kissed a frog again. And she always kept an eye on the fridge, just in case.

Jill and Ben are twins. They like to play in the park with their dog, Spot. Spot is big and friendly. He likes to run and chase balls.
One day, Jill and Ben ask their mom if they can go to the park. Mom says yes, but they have to hold Spot's leash. Spot is strong and sometimes pulls them. Mom says they have to be careful and not let go.
Jill and Ben are happy. They put on their shoes and coats and grab Spot's leash. They walk to the park with mom. Spot is excited. He sees other dogs and birds and squirrels. He barks and jumps and tries to run.
"Spot, stop!" Jill says. "You are making me dizzy!"
"Me too!" Ben says. "You have to heel, Spot!"
But Spot does not listen. He sees a big red ball. He wants to play with it. He pulls harder and harder. Jill and Ben lose their balance. They fall to the ground. Spot runs to the ball.
"Spot, come back!" Jill and Ben shout. "Mom, help!"
Mom runs after Spot. She catches him and takes the ball. She scolds him. "Bad dog, Spot! You are not allowed to run away from Jill and Ben! You could get hurt or lost!"
She brings Spot back to Jill and Ben. They are sad and scared. They hug Spot and mom. Mom hugs them back. She says she is sorry. She says they can still play in the park, but they have to use a shorter leash. She says she will teach Spot to heel better.
Jill and Ben nod. They say they love Spot and mom. They say they will be more careful. They say they still want to play with the ball.
Mom smiles. She says they can play with the ball, but only if they share it with Spot. She says Spot is a good dog, but he needs to learn some rules.
Jill and Ben agree. They say they will teach Spot some rules. They say they will have fun in the park.
They walk to the grass. They throw the ball. Spot runs and catches it. He brings it back. He heels. He waits for the next throw.
Jill and Ben laugh. They are not dizzy anymore. They are happy. They play with Spot and mom. They have a good day.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved to play outside. One day, he went to the park to play with his best friend, Sarah. They ran and laughed together.
After a few hours, Sarah said she had to go. Jack was sad to see her go, but he said goodbye.
When he came back home, he remembered that he had left his blanket at the park. He was worried because his blanket was special; it was blue and had a picture of his favorite dinosaur on it.
He decided to go back to the park and look for it. It wasn't easy to find, but he searched for a very long time.
Finally, he found it! He was so happy. He hugged it and ran back home. When his parents saw him, they were amazed.
"You found your blanket! That's amazing!" his mom said.
"It sure is," Jack said with a big smile. And from that day on, he never forgot to return his blanket to his house.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He loved to climb high up in the trees. One day, he found a magic ring. The magic ring could make him shrink. Tim thought it was fun to be small.
Tim used the ring to shrink and play with the bugs in the grass. He learned that the bugs worked together to find food and take care of each other. Tim saw that the bugs were kind and helpful. He wanted to be like them.
Soon, Tim started to help his friends and family. He shared his toys and helped his mom clean the house. Everyone was happy because Tim was being kind and helpful. Tim learned that being kind and helpful made him feel big, even when he was small. The moral of the story is that being kind and helpful makes you a big person inside.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very independent boy who loved to play outside. One sunny day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He took his favorite toy, a big red bucket.
At the park, Tim met a new friend, a girl named Sue. Sue asked Tim, "What do you have there?" Tim said, "This is my big red bucket. I like to pretend it's a hat!" Sue laughed and said, "Can I try?" Tim let Sue wear the bucket on her head, and they both laughed.
Tim and Sue played all day with the big red bucket. They pretended it was a hat, a boat, and even a house for their toys. They had so much fun together, and Tim was happy to have a new friend to play with. When it was time to go home, Tim and Sue said goodbye, and Tim promised to bring his big red bucket the next time they played.

Ben liked to climb. He climbed on chairs, on tables, on beds, on trees. He liked to see how high he could go. One day, he saw a big book on a shelf. He wanted to look at it. He climbed on a chair, then on a table, then on another chair. He reached for the book.
The book was heavy. It had many pages. It had many words. Ben could not read the words. He only knew some letters. He opened the book. He saw a picture. It was a picture of a furry cat. The cat had a hat. The hat had a star. The star had a word. The word was "spell".
Ben liked the cat. He liked the hat. He liked the star. He wanted to say the word. He sounded out the letters. S-P-E-L-L. Spell. He said it out loud. "Spell!"
Suddenly, the book glowed. The cat jumped out of the page. The hat flew off the cat. The star twinkled in the air. The cat meowed. The hat landed on Ben's head. The star touched Ben's nose. Ben felt a tickle. He laughed.
The cat was friendly. It rubbed against Ben's leg. It purred. Ben petted the cat. He liked the cat. He said, "Hello, cat. You are furry. You are magic. You are my friend." The cat nodded. It said, "Hello, Ben. You are brave. You are smart. You are my friend." Ben smiled. He hugged the cat. He said, "Thank you, spell. You are fun. You are a surprise. You are my gift." The spell smiled. It said, "You are welcome, Ben. You are kind. You are curious. You are my wish."

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sophie. Sophie went out one day to search for some rice. She made sure she was very careful when searching as she did not want to get lost!
On her search, Sophie came across an old man. He was sitting on a bench under a giant oak tree. "Excuse me sir, can you help me?" Sophie asked. The old man smiled and replied, "What are you looking for, young one?"
Sophie explained she was searching for rice. The old man smiled and invited her to come with him. He said he knew where to find some rice. Sophie was very excited. The old man took Sophie through the forest and to the edge of a lake.
When they arrived, the old man warned Sophie to be very careful. He explained the lake was full of crocodiles and they could be very dangerous. He warned her to not get too close. But Sophie was so excited she paid no attention.
The old man had to act quickly! He ran into the lake and distracted the crocodiles as Sophie ran away with the rice. Sophie was so happy and thankful for the old man's help. From then on, she was extra careful when searching for anything in the future.

Once upon a time there was a bird. The bird wanted to go up high in the sky, so one day it decided to soar. It flapped its wings and up it went!
The bird kept soaring and soon it found a club in the sky. The club was very comfortable, with green chairs and lots of soft pillows. The bird sat in one of the chairs and relaxed.
The bird stayed in the club all day. It enjoyed watching the sun come up and then the stars come out at night. It was so comfortable, the bird almost didn't want to leave.
But eventually it did. With one flap of its wings, the bird said goodbye and started to soar once again. It had had a wonderful time and could not wait to come back soon.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a smart cat named Tom. Tom loved to jump and reach for things. One day, he saw a red ball up high on a shelf. Tom wanted to play with the ball, so he tried to reach it.
"Meow," said Tom, as he jumped and tried to reach the ball. But the ball was too high for Tom. He tried and tried, but he could not reach it. Then, a little girl named Amy saw Tom. She wanted to help him reach the ball.
"Here you go, Tom!" said Amy, as she reached up and got the ball for him. Tom was very happy, and they started to play together. But something unexpected happened. When Tom touched the ball, it was hot!
"Ouch!" said Tom, as he quickly let go of the hot ball. Amy and Tom looked at the ball, and it started to change. The hot ball turned into a beautiful bird! The bird flew around the room and then out of the window.
Amy and Tom were surprised, but they laughed and clapped their hands. They knew they had just seen something very special. From that day on, they became best friends and always looked for new adventures together.

Tom and Anna liked to play in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. They also liked to look at the birds and the bugs. One day, they saw a big fly. It was black and shiny and had big eyes.
"Look, a fly!" Tom said. He ran after it. He wanted to catch it and see it better.
"Wait for me!" Anna said. She ran after Tom. She also wanted to see the fly.
But the fly was fast and smart. It flew away from Tom and Anna. It flew over the grass and the flowers and the trees. It flew so high that Tom and Anna could not see it.
"Where did it go?" Tom asked. He looked around. He could not find the fly.
"It disappeared!" Anna said. She was sad. She wanted to see the fly.
"Maybe it went to sleep," Tom said. He was also sad. He wanted to catch the fly.
"Maybe it was lazy," Anna said. She smiled. She had an idea.
"Let's play hide and seek," she said. "Maybe we can find the fly."
"OK," Tom said. He smiled too. He liked to play hide and seek.
They took turns hiding and seeking. They had fun. They forgot about the fly. They did not know that the fly was watching them from a leaf. It was not lazy. It was clever. It liked to play too.

One day, a little girl named Mia found a big mirror in her room. Mia looked in the mirror and saw a smelly cat. She said, "Why is there a smelly cat in my mirror?"
Mia's friend, Tim, came over to play. Tim saw the smelly cat in the mirror too. He said, "I guess we need to find the smelly cat and help it." Mia and Tim looked everywhere for the smelly cat, but they could not find it.
Mia and Tim were sad because they could not find the smelly cat. Then, Mia's mom came in the room. She said, "I guess I know where the smelly cat is." Mia's mom took them outside and showed them the smelly cat in the yard. Mia and Tim were happy to find the smelly cat. They gave it a bath, and it was not smelly anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little red bird. The bird loved to carry things in its beak. It liked to help others. One day, on a Wednesday, the bird found a red ball.
The bird wanted to carry the ball to its friend, a small dog. The dog loved to play with balls. So, the little red bird picked up the ball in its beak and flew to find the dog.
