When the dog saw the bird and the red ball, it was very happy. They played together all day long. The bird would carry the ball and drop it for the dog to catch. They had lots of fun on that Wednesday.

Once upon a time there was a girl who lived in a big city. She was a very young girl, but today she was feeling old. She wanted to do something exciting.
Suddenly an idea popped into her head. She ran outside and found a big old truck. She ran up to it and with one big kick, sent it rolling down the street.
The girl squealed with delight as she watched the truck bounce down the street. As it got further away, she could hear someone shouting behind her. She turned around to see an old man was running after the truck. He looked very surprised!
The old man shouted to the girl, "What did you do?" The girl smiled and said, "I kicked it!" The man laughed and said, "You must be a mighty strong girl to kick an old truck like that!" The girl just smiled and ran away.
The girl had a great time that day, and from then on she always remembered the day she kicked the old truck.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a good boy, but sometimes he made mistakes. One day, Tim went to a big building with his mom. They needed to go up, so they took the elevator.
Inside the elevator, Tim saw a small button. He wanted to touch it, but his mom said, "No, Tim! Don't touch the button or you will be punished." Tim listened to his mom and did not touch the button.
When they got to the top, Tim and his mom did their work. Then, they went back to the elevator. Tim remembered what his mom said, so he did not touch the button. His mom was happy and said, "Good job, Tim! You listened, and you won't be punished." They went home and had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a silly seal named Sam. Sam loved to play all day long. He would spend hours and hours splashing in the water with his friends.
One day, Sam and his friends were playing a game. They would jump high out of the water and make a big splash. Sam wanted to jump the highest, but he was a little scared.
Sam's friends cheered him on. They said, "You can do it, Sam!" So, Sam took a deep breath and jumped as high as he could. He made the biggest splash of all! Sam was so happy, he laughed and played with his friends all day long. And from that day on, Sam was never scared to jump high again.

Once upon a time, there was a kind, old cow named Bessie. Bessie lived on a big farm with many other animals. Bessie was a happy cow, and she liked to make new friends.
One day, Bessie had a big idea. She wanted to create something special for her friends. She thought and thought about what she could make. Then, Bessie remembered that her friends loved to eat beef. So, Bessie decided to create a big beef dinner for everyone.
Bessie worked hard to make the beef dinner. She asked her friends, the chickens and the pigs, to help her. They were all very excited. When the big day came, Bessie and her friends shared the yummy beef dinner. Everyone was happy, and they all thanked Bessie for her hard work. Bessie felt proud and knew that her old friends loved her very much.

Once upon a time, there was a tall tree. The tree had many pretty leaves. The tree loved to show off its leaves in a nice fashion. All the little animals would come and look at the tree.
One day, a little bird came to the tree and said, "Why are you so tall? Can you help me increase my height too?" The tree thought for a moment and said, "I will help you, little bird. Just sit on my branch and I will try to lift you up."
The little bird did as the tree said. The tree tried and tried, but the bird did not get taller. The bird was sad, but the tree said, "Don't be sad. You can fly high in the sky. That's even better than being tall." The bird realized the tree was right and flew away, happy.
The other animals saw this and learned that everyone has their own special thing. They all became happy with what they had. And the tall tree, with its pretty leaves in a nice fashion, continued to make everyone smile.
The moral of the story is to be happy with what you have and to appreciate the special things that make you unique.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom liked to sleep all day under a big tree. He never wanted to play with the other cats. Tom only wanted to eat and sleep.
One day, a little bird saw Tom sleeping. The bird flew down and sat on the tree. The bird opened its mouth and called out, "Wake up, lazy cat! Let's play!" But Tom just yawned and went back to sleep.
The bird called again, "Wake up, lazy cat! Come play with me!" This time, Tom opened his eyes and looked at the bird. Tom thought, "Maybe I can play just a little." So Tom and the bird played together all day. They had so much fun! From that day on, Tom was not a lazy cat anymore. He loved to play with his new friend, the little bird.

One day, a little girl named Lucy wanted to find something exciting. She looked around for a long time, but she couldn't find anything.
Then she heard a sound. It was coming from behind a bush. Lucy went to see what it was.
When she looked, she was so envious! It was a puppy! The puppy was so small and cuddly. She wanted to keep it, so she took it home with her.
At home, Lucy named the puppy Doggy. Now Lucy and Doggy are best friends. They do everything together and Lucy loves playing with Doggy everyday.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved picking up things. One day, she was out in her backyard, picking up some leaves and twigs. She found a sparkly box and opened it. Inside the box was a bunch of makeup! She was so excited and ran back into the house to show her mom.
"Mom! Look what I picked up!" The little girl said, holding up the box of makeup.
Her mom chuckled. "Oh my! That sure is silly. Let's try out the makeup and we can see how it looks on you."
They began trying on different shades of blush and eyeshadow. They ended up with a silly but pretty made up look. The little girl was grinning from ear to ear. She had had so much fun picking up the box and playing with the makeup.
The little girl realized that sometimes, silly things can bring so much joy.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to paint. He would paint pretty pictures of the sun, trees, and animals. But one day, Tim made an ugly painting. He did not like it, and it made him sad.
Tim's friend, Sam, came to play. Sam saw the ugly painting and laughed. Tim felt bad and shouted at Sam, "Don't laugh at my painting!" Sam stopped laughing and looked sad too. Tim knew he should not have shouted at his friend.
Tim said sorry to Sam for shouting. They talked about the ugly painting and decided to make it pretty together. They added more colors and shapes, and soon it was a beautiful painting. They were both happy and learned that working together and being kind is better than shouting and making fun of each other.

Once upon a time, in a small green garden, there lived a shy lizard. The lizard had a friend, a kind little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with the lizard every day.
One sunny day, Tim said to the lizard, "Let's play hide and seek!" The shy lizard nodded and started to count. Tim ran to hide behind a big tree. The lizard looked and looked, but he could not find Tim. Then, Tim jumped out and said, "Here I am!"
The lizard laughed and said, "Now, it's my turn to hide!" The shy lizard ran and hid under a small rock. Tim looked and looked, but he could not find the lizard. Then, the lizard peeked out and said, "Here I am!"
Tim and the shy lizard played and laughed all day. They had so much fun together. And from that day on, they were the best of friends.

One day, a girl named Mia got an invitation. It was a pretty card with a picture of a cake on it. The invitation was for a birthday party. Mia was very happy and excited.
Mia asked her mom, "Can I go to the party?" Her mom said, "Yes, you can go. Let's see if a pretty dress is available for you to wear." They looked in Mia's closet and found a pink dress with flowers on it.
On the day of the party, Mia's mom let her wear the pretty dress. Mia went to the party and had lots of fun. She played games, ate cake, and made new friends. Mia was very happy she got the invitation.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to pretend she was a popular horse. She would run around the yard and neigh like a horse. All her friends liked to play with her.
One day, a new boy named Tom came to play. He said, "I want to be a popular horse too!" But Lily did not want to share. She wanted to be the only popular horse. So, they both pretended to be horses, but they did not play together.
Lily's mom saw them and said, "Why don't you both be popular horses and play together?" Lily thought about it and decided to give it a try. She and Tom pretended to be horses together and had so much fun. They became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse. He was playing in the garden, looking for something fun.
Suddenly, he saw a stack of things that looked like they were made of wood. He was curious, so he walked up to it. He looked at them and said, “What are these?”
Just then, an old frog jumped out from behind the stack. The mouse was startled, but the frog said, “Don't be scared, little mouse. These are blocks. You can turn them and make different shapes.”
The mouse was excited and asked, “Can I try?” The frog nodded, so the mouse started to turn the blocks. He made different shapes, houses and towers. He was having a lot of fun.
The frog watched the mouse turn the little blocks and smiled. He knew the mouse was learning something new. The little mouse was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He had a cool bottle that he loved very much. He took the bottle with him everywhere he went. One day, while playing in the park, Tim lost his cool bottle. He was very sad.
Tim's mom saw him crying and asked what was wrong. Tim told her about his lost bottle. His mom wanted to help, so she said, "Let's replace it with a new one!" Tim was happy, and they went to the store to find a new cool bottle.
At the store, Tim found a new cool bottle that he liked. He did not think about his old bottle anymore. But when they got home, Tim's mom saw that he had taken the new bottle without paying for it. She was very upset and told Tim that it was wrong to take things without paying. The moral of the story is that you should not replace something you lost by taking things that don't belong to you.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jack. He loved animals, so one day he went for a walk. He saw a cow in a nearby field. Jack wanted to play with it, so he asked his mom if he could go and say hello to the cow.
Mom said, "Yes, you can go and talk to the cow, but be very careful."
Jack excitedly ran to the field, and the cow was so happy to see him! He asked the cow, "What's your name?"
The cow mentioned that her name was Moo. Jack thought it was a funny name, so they played together in the field.
Suddenly, Jack heard a loud noise and he felt very hurt. He saw that a branch had fallen and it had hit him! Jack cried, and the cow quickly came over to soothe him. Jack was happy because the cow helped to make him feel better.
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong sheep. The sheep had lots of soft wool. The sheep lived on a farm with a little girl named Lily. Lily loved her sheep very much. She would call the sheep every day to play with her. They would run and jump in the sun.
One day, while they were playing, the wind blew very hard. The strong sheep's wool flew off! Lily was very sad. She did not know what to do. She called the sheep to come to her. The sheep came, but it did not look like her sheep. It was now a small, thin sheep.
Lily was sad, but she still loved her sheep. She knew that it was still her sheep, even without the wool. They played together every day, just like before. And soon, the sheep's wool grew back. It was soft and warm again. Lily and her sheep lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a dependable dog named Spot. Spot loved to help his friends. One day, a little bird named Tweetie needed help. Tweetie had to carry a big stick to her nest, but it was too heavy.
Spot saw Tweetie trying very hard. He wanted to help her. So, Spot picked up the big stick with his mouth and started to carry it. Together, they walked in silence, working as a team. They did not give up, even when it was hard.
Finally, they reached Tweetie's nest and put the big stick in its place. Tweetie was so happy and thanked Spot for his help. From that day on, they became best friends. The moral of the story is that when we help each other, we can do big things.

Once upon a time, there was a creative little fish named Fin. Fin loved to swim in the big blue sea. He would swim all day and all night with his fish friends.
One day, a big shark came to Fin and his friends. The shark was hungry and demanded that Fin and his friends give him some food. Fin and his friends were scared but they had an idea.
Fin and his friends tried to be creative and make a big cake out of seaweed for the shark. They hoped the shark would like it and leave them alone. But the shark did not like the cake at all. The shark was very mad and ate Fin and his friends. It was a very bad ending for the creative little fish.

John was a wealthy boy who lived on a farm. Every day he would look for something new and exciting to do.
One day at twilight, John had an idea: he was going to explore the dark woods. He got dressed and set out. As he entered the woods he saw a lot of animals, large and small. He included birds, a rabbit and even a deer.
He looked around the dark woods with fascination until he heard a voice: "Where are you going?" He turned around and saw an old lady. "I'm going exploring," he said.
The old lady smiled. She said: "I can tell you some secrets of the woods if you want." John nodded. The old lady said: "If you go deeper into the woods you will see a house as wealthy as your own. You must come see me again."
John thanked the old lady and went off deep into the woods. He kept walking until he saw the house. It was huge, just like his own. He was excited to explore it and see the secrets.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very organized boy. He always kept his toys in the right place. One day, Tim found a big black rock in his backyard. He didn't know what it was, so he asked his mom.
"Mom, what is this?" Tim said. His mom looked at the rock and said, "That is coal, Tim."
Tim wanted to keep the coal in his room. But his mom insisted, "No, Tim. Coal is dirty. It will make your room messy."
Tim was sad, but he listened to his mom. He put the coal outside in a special place. Every day, Tim would visit the coal and say hello. And his room stayed clean and organized.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful pony. He was a gentle giant and every morning he would frolic in the field with his best friend, a little girl. She loved to pat his soft mane and hug him. Every time, the pony would feel so happy.
One morning, the little girl told the pony about an upcoming pony show. She said she wanted to enter him so people could see how graceful he was. The pony was both flattered and worried. He wasn't sure if he wanted to go to a big show and be the center of attention.
The little girl promised him it would be fun. She said that if he felt nervous, she would be there to cheer him on. So, the pony decided to go and he put in the very best effort.
At the show, the pony pranced around the ring. He even won first prize! As he trotted back to his little friend, the pony felt so proud. He realized that he could be graceful and brave at the same time. He and the little girl hugged for a long time and he knew that no matter what happened, she would always be there for him.

Once upon a time, there was a small white bunny called Meadow. Meadow was very scared, so her mum comforted her and told her a story about history.
"In the past," said mum, "bunnies used to live in the forest and have lots of fun together".
Meadow was very interested, so she asked, "What did they do?".
Mum explained, "They would eat yummy food, play games and sit together to talk and share stories. It was so special."
Meadow smiled and felt nice and warm inside because she knew her mum was comforting her. The mum snuggled in close and they both stayed there until Meadow fell asleep.
The end.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big opera. Many people came to see it. One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the opera with her mom. Lucy was very scared because she had never been to an opera before.
At the opera, Lucy met a boy named Tom. Tom said, "Hi, my name is Tom. Are you scared too?" Lucy said, "Yes, my name is Lucy. I am scared." Tom said, "Let's be brave together!" Lucy felt better with Tom by her side.
During the opera, something unexpected happened. A funny clown came on the stage and made everyone laugh. Lucy and Tom were not scared anymore. They laughed and had a great time. The moral of the story is that when you face your fears with a friend, you can be brave and have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim was excited to visit his friend, Sam. Sam had a pet parrot. Tim loved the parrot because it could talk.
When Tim went to Sam's house, they played with the parrot. The parrot said "hello" and they laughed. They had a lot of fun. But then, they saw a big dog. The dog wanted to play too, but they were scared.
Sam's mom told them to be kind to the dog. They let the dog play with them and the parrot. They all had fun together. The dog was nice and did not hurt the parrot.
In the end, Tim and Sam learned that it is good to be kind to others, even if they look scary. They were happy they let the dog play with them, and they had a great day with their new friend.

One day, a big book and a little book were on a table. The big book said, "I have more pages than you. I am better." The little book felt sad but did not say anything.
Then, a girl came and picked up the big book. She started to read it. But suddenly, the big book's cover fell off. The girl was surprised. She said, "Oh no! The big book is broken. I will read the little book instead."
The little book felt happy. The big book felt bad. The little book said, "We should not be competitive. We can both be good books." The big book agreed, and they became friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to play and run in the big open space near his home. One day, Max saw a big dry tree in the space. Max thought it would be fun to play with the tree.
Max ran up to the tree and started to bite it. The tree didn't like being bitten, so it shook its branches to tell Max to stop. Max didn't understand and kept biting the tree.
The tree got very upset and started to shake more. Max got scared and ran away from the tree. Max learned that it's not nice to bite things that don't want to be bitten. From that day on, Max played nicely in the big open space and never bit anything again.

Amy was a three year old girl who lived with her mom and dad. One day she wanted to help her mom and dad with their work in the garden, so she offered to look after the hedge. Her parents said okay, and showed her what to do.
They gave her a pair of scissors and Amy got to work. She started snipping away at the hedge and was so proud of herself.
When Amy was done, she was feeling very sleepy. She went to her mom and dad and told them she was done and ready to go to bed.
Her mom said, “Sweetie, are you sure? That hedge looks nice and neat. You did a great job.”
Amy smiled and nodded her head. Then she said good night, gave her parents a big hug and trotted off to bed, feeling very proud of her hard work.

Tom and Sam love to play baseball. They have a bat, a ball and a glove. They go to the park with their mom and dad. They find a big field with grass and dirt.
"Can we play baseball now?" Tom asks.
"Yes, you can. But be careful and have fun," mom says.
Tom and Sam run to the field. They take turns hitting and catching the ball. They laugh and shout. They do not see the sun go down. The sky gets dark and the stars come out.
"Boys, it is time to go home. It is too dark to play baseball," dad calls.
"But we want to play more!" Sam says.
"Sorry, but it is not safe to play in the dark. You might get hurt or lost. We can play again tomorrow," dad says.
Tom and Sam are sad. They love baseball. They do not want to stop. But they listen to dad. They pick up their bat, ball and glove. They say goodbye to the field. They walk to the car with mom and dad.
"Did you have fun playing baseball?" mom asks.
"Yes, we did. It was fun," Tom says.
"Me too. It was fun," Sam says.
They smile and hug mom and dad. They are happy. They love baseball. They love mom and dad. They go home and sleep. They dream of playing baseball again.

Once upon a time, there was a loud dog named Max. Max liked to play and run all day. He had a lot of fun with his friends.
One day, Max wanted to improve his running. He asked his friends to help him. They ran together every day for a whole year.
After the year, Max got better at running. He was very happy. His friends were happy too. They all had a big party to celebrate Max's improvement.

Once upon a time, two brothers were playing in the garden. The day was cheerful and sunny. The older brother wanted to have some fun. He grabbed a yellow ball and said to the younger brother, "Let's bounce the ball together!"
The younger brother happily agreed. He loved to play with his brother. The ball went back and forth between the two brothers, quickly bouncing from one to the other.
The older brother couldn't help but laugh. He was so cheerful watching his brother have fun. He said, "Come on, let's bounce the ball higher!"
The younger brother smiled and crowded the ball with all his might. The ball flew high into the air. Both brothers jumped and cheered with excitement. They had so much fun bouncing the ball around the garden.

One day, a boy named Tim found a message in a bottle. The message said, "Find the big, red ice cream truck to get a surprise." Tim was excited and went to look for the truck.
Tim saw the big, red ice cream truck and asked the ice cream man, "Can I have my surprise?" The ice cream man gave Tim a big, colorful ice cream cone. Tim said, "Thank you!" and started to eat it. But it was a very hot day, and the ice cream started to melt. Tim was sad.
Just then, a girl named Sue came by. She saw Tim's melting ice cream and said, "Don't be sad. I can help!" Sue took out a fan and waved it at the ice cream. The ice cream stopped melting! Tim was happy, and they both ate their ice cream together. They didn't know that the message was from a dangerous person who wanted to make them sad, but they were too smart and happy to let that happen.

Timmy was having a difficult day. His mom told him to put on his pants before they went to the park, but even with help, getting them on was hard work. He struggled and tugged, but finally he was ready to go.
At the park, Timmy told his mom he wanted to play on the big slide. His mom warned him it was difficult, but Timmy didn't believe her. He ran up the stairs, determined to make it to the top.
When he reached the peak of the slide, he realized how wrong he was. It was very steep, and the way down looked very scary. His mom called out from the bottom, "I told you it was difficult, Timmy. Are you sure you want to go?"
"Yes," Timmy said, keeping his eyes on the path ahead. With his pants scrunched up in his fists, Timmy took a deep breath and slid down the hill.
At the bottom, Timmy was proud of himself. He had conquered the big slide and realized that difficult things can be overcome. After several more trips up and down, they packed up and went home.

Tim and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to pretend they were cowboys and robbers. Tim had a fancy hat and a pistol that made a loud noise. Ben had a scarf and a stick.
"Hands up, robber!" Tim shouted, pointing his pistol at Ben. "Give me all your money or I'll shoot!"
Ben laughed and waved his stick. "No way, cowboy! You can't catch me!" He ran away, dodging behind a slide.
Tim chased him, making his pistol noise. He was having fun. He saw Ben hiding behind a bench. He sneaked up behind him and grabbed his scarf.
"Got you, robber!" Tim said, pulling Ben out. "Now give me your money!"
Ben frowned and tried to get free. He didn't like Tim's game anymore. He saw a lady sitting on the bench. She had a big bag and a shiny necklace.
"Help, help!" Ben yelled. "This cowboy is trying to rob me!"
The lady looked at Tim and Ben. She saw Tim's pistol and got scared. She thought it was real. She screamed and ran away, leaving her bag and necklace.
Tim and Ben stopped playing. They saw the lady's things. They felt curious.
"Wow, look at all this stuff!" Tim said, dropping his pistol and scarf. He opened the bag and saw a lot of money and cards.
"Maybe we should take it," Ben said, picking up the necklace. He liked how it sparkled.
Tim nodded. He thought it was a good idea. He put some money and cards in his pocket. He saw a phone in the bag. He wanted to play with it.
"Let's go," Ben said, putting the necklace around his neck. He saw a man coming. He looked angry.
"Hey, you kids!" the man shouted. "That's my wife's bag and necklace! Give them back!"
Tim and Ben got scared. They tried to run away, but the man was faster. He caught them and grabbed their things. He saw Tim's pistol and got mad.
"What's this?" he said, holding the pistol. "You have a gun? Are you trying to rob my wife?"
Tim shook his head. He tried to explain. "No, no, it's just a toy. We were just playing. We're sorry."
The man didn't listen. He thought Tim was lying. He pulled the trigger, thinking it was a toy. He wanted to scare Tim.
But the pistol was not a toy. It was real. It made a loud noise and a flash. It hurt Tim very much. He fell down and didn't move.
Ben screamed. He saw Tim's blood. He felt very sad and scared. He wished they never played with the lady's things.
The man was shocked. He didn't mean to hurt Tim. He dropped the pistol and called for help.
But it was too late. Tim was gone. Ben was alone. They had a very bad ending.

One day, Emma was playing in the park. She wanted to join a club, so she went looking for one. Emma saw a lot of people playing a game. She went closer to take a look and heard someone say, "We need one more for this game. Do you want to join us?"
Emma was excited and said, "Yes please!". The club showed her how to play the game. Emma was very smart, and she caught on very quickly.
At the end of the game, someone said, "Let's cover the game pieces." Everyone smiled and helped to cover the pieces back in the box.
Emma was very happy. She had made a lot of new friends, and had joined a club. She ran home, smiling all the way.

One day, a girl named Mia went to the store with her mom. Mia saw a long, big pie. She asked her mom, "Can we buy the pie, please?" Her mom said yes, and Mia was very happy. She could not wait to eat the pie.
When they got home, Mia wanted to hold the pie. Her mom said, "Be careful, Mia. It is a very big pie." Mia held the pie with both hands, but then something unexpected happened. The pie fell on the floor! Mia was sad, and her mom was surprised.
Mia's mom had an idea. She said, "Let's make a new pie together!" Mia and her mom made a new pie, and it was even better than the first one. They had a great time, and Mia learned that even when things go wrong, you can still have fun.

Lily loved to sing. She sang all the time. She sang in the morning, she sang at lunch, she sang before bed. She sang to her toys, she sang to her mom, she sang to her dad. She sang happy songs, she sang sad songs, she sang silly songs.
One day, Lily went to visit her grandma. Her grandma was old and lived in a big house. Lily liked her grandma, but she was a little scared of her. Her grandma had white hair, wrinkled skin, and a loud voice. She always told Lily to be quiet, to sit still, and to eat her vegetables.
Lily wanted to sing for her grandma, but she was afraid. She thought her grandma would not like her songs. She thought her grandma would yell at her or send her to her room. She wished her grandma was more like her mom, who always smiled and clapped when Lily sang.
But Lily did not know that her grandma was smart. Her grandma knew that Lily loved to sing, and she wanted to hear her. Her grandma had a secret plan. She had a special gift for Lily, hidden in a closet. It was a big, shiny, red guitar. Her grandma had learned to play the guitar when she was young, and she wanted to teach Lily.
When Lily finished her lunch, her grandma said, "Lily, I have something for you. Come with me." She took Lily by the hand and led her to the closet. She opened the door and pulled out the guitar. She handed it to Lily and said, "This is for you, my dear. I want you to sing for me. I want you to sing with me."
Lily's eyes widened. She could not believe it. She hugged her grandma and said, "Thank you, thank you, thank you!" She felt the guitar in her arms and strummed the strings. She felt a warm, happy feeling in her chest. She looked at her grandma and saw a smile on her face. She opened her mouth and began to sing. Her grandma joined her, and they sang together. They sang happy songs, they sang sad songs, they sang silly songs. They sang and sang and sang.

Once upon a time, there was a small cat named Kitty. Kitty was very happy because today was her birthday. She knew she would get a gift from her best friend, Doggy.
Doggy came to Kitty's house with a gift. "Happy birthday, Kitty!" said Doggy. "I have a gift for you!" Kitty was excited and took the gift. But when she opened it, she found a small toy mouse. Kitty did not like mice, even toy ones. This made Kitty sad.
Kitty did not want to disturb Doggy's feelings. So, she said, "Thank you, Doggy. But I am scared of mice, even toy ones." Doggy felt bad and said, "I am sorry, Kitty. I will find a better gift for you." And off Doggy went to find a new gift that would make Kitty happy.

Once upon a time, there was a man who was a lawyer. He was different from other people. He liked to help people with their problems.
One day, the lawyer met a boy. The boy had a big problem. The lawyer wanted to help the boy. He tried to remind the boy about the good things in life. The boy began to feel better.
But then, something bad happened. The lawyer and the boy were walking when they saw a big hole. The lawyer tried to save the boy, but he fell into the hole. The boy was very sad. The lawyer could not help the boy anymore. The end.

Once upon a time, in a gray house, there lived a little girl named Amy. Amy loved to play outside with her dog, Max. One day, while they were playing, Max saw a tiny spirit.
"Hello, spirit," Max said with a yawn. The spirit looked at Max and smiled. "Hello, Max. I have a fun game for us to play."
The spirit, Max, and Amy played a game of hide and seek. Max and Amy looked and looked, but they could not find the spirit. Suddenly, the spirit appeared right in front of them! "Boo!" it said, and Max and Amy laughed.
The spirit told Max and Amy that it was a magic spirit. It could make wishes come true. Max and Amy were very surprised. They wished for a big, colorful playground to play on. The spirit waved its hands, and a beautiful playground appeared. Max, Amy, and the spirit played and laughed all day long.

One day, a bright sun shone in the sky. It made the day feel warm and happy. A little girl named Lily went outside to play. She loved to draw with her pastel chalks on the sidewalk. She made pretty pictures of flowers, trees, and animals.
A big wind came and made Lily shiver. She was sad because her pastel chalks blew away. Lily looked around and saw her friend, Tom. He was playing with a bright red ball. Lily asked Tom to help her find her pastel chalks.
Tom and Lily looked everywhere. They found the pastel chalks under a tree. Lily was so happy! She and Tom drew more pictures with the chalks. The bright sun kept them warm, and they did not shiver anymore. They played and drew until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a team of animals. They lived in a big forest. The team had a big bear, a little rabbit, and a funny monkey. They were very good friends.
One day, the team saw their forest was very dirty. They wanted to make it clean and pretty again. So, they worked together to pick up trash and put it in a big bag.
The big bear was strong and could carry the heavy things. The little rabbit was fast and could find the small trash. The funny monkey could climb trees to get the trash stuck in the branches. The team worked hard, and soon the forest was clean and good again. The animals were happy and proud of their teamwork.

Lily liked to stir her soup with a big spoon. She liked to make bubbles and swirls in the bowl. She also liked to write in her diary every day. She had a pink diary with a lock and a key. She wrote about her friends, her toys, and her dreams.
One day, Lily came home from school and saw her brother Tom in her room. He was holding her diary and reading it. Lily was very angry. She ran to him and snatched her diary away.
"Tom, that is mine! You are not allowed to read it!" she shouted.
Tom laughed and said, "But Lily, your diary is so funny. You write about silly things, like being a princess or a fairy. And you have a crush on Ben from your class. How rare!"
Lily felt embarrassed and hurt. She did not like Tom making fun of her. She said, "Tom, you are mean. You do not understand. My diary is special to me. It is where I keep my secrets and my feelings. You should not read it without my permission. How would you like it if I read your comics or your cards?"
Tom shrugged and said, "I don't care. They are just comics and cards. They are not important."
Lily said, "They are important to you, just like my diary is important to me. Everyone has something that they love and cherish. You should respect that and not tease or bother them. That is what Mom and Dad taught us. That is what being kind and fair means."
Tom thought for a moment. He realized that Lily was right. He had been rude and nosy. He said, "I'm sorry, Lily. You are right. I should not have read your diary. It was wrong of me. I will not do it again. Can you forgive me?"
Lily smiled and said, "Yes, I forgive you. But you have to promise me that you will not touch my diary again. And you have to say sorry to Ben too. He is a nice boy and he does not deserve to be laughed at."
Tom nodded and said, "I promise. And I will say sorry to Ben. Thank you, Lily. You are a good sister."
Lily hugged Tom and said, "You are welcome. You are a good brother too. Sometimes."
They both laughed and went downstairs to have some soup. Lily stirred her soup with a big spoon and Tom stirred his soup with a small spoon. They both enjoyed their soup and their conversation. They learned to respect each other's things and feelings. They learned to be kind and fair.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jilly and Steve. They both loved to play.
One day, they were out in the park, playing hide-and-seek. Steve saw an aeroplane flying in the sky. He thought it would be so much fun to fly an aeroplane.
Jilly said, "No Steve! You can't fly an aeroplane. It's naughty to fly an aeroplane."
Steve thought about it and realised that Jilly was right. He shouldn't fly an aeroplane because it wasn't the right thing to do.
Jilly said, "Let's play swing instead. It's much more fun that flying an aeroplane!"
So Steve and Jilly went off to play on the swings. They had a great time and laughed and smiled the whole time.
The moral of the story is to always listen to your friend and be careful not to do naughty things. There are better ways to have fun than doing something naughty!

Once upon a time, a graceful cat named Lucy lived in a nice home. Lucy loved to play with her ball and jump around the house. One day, Lucy saw a big open door and went outside to play.
While playing outside, Lucy met a dog named Max. Max said, "Hi, Lucy! Do you want to play with me?" Lucy was scared at first, but then she said, "Okay, let's play!" They played all day long, running and jumping in the sun.
After playing, Lucy started to feel tired. She said, "Max, I need to go home now." But Lucy couldn't remember how to get back to her home. Max said, "Don't worry, Lucy! I will help you find your home." They looked and looked, but they couldn't find Lucy's home. Just when they were about to give up, they found a big open door. Lucy went inside and saw her ball. She was so happy to be home! Lucy and Max hugged, and they became best friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a warm and sunny day. A little boy named Tim went to play in the park. He saw many fun things to play with. He saw swings, slides, and a sandbox. Tim was very happy.
In the sandbox, Tim found some equipment. There was a shovel and a bucket. He started to dig in the sand. He wanted to make a big sandcastle. While digging, he saw something shiny and sharp. Tim thought it could help him with his sandcastle.
Tim picked up the shiny, sharp thing. It was a key! He looked around and saw a small treasure chest. Tim was excited. He used the key to open the chest. Inside, he found many colorful toys! He knew the sharp key was special. Tim played with his new toys all day and had the best time ever.

One day, a pale frog named Tim hopped near a pond. He liked to mix mud and water to make fun shapes. Tim had many friends who played with him at the pond.
One day, while Tim was mixing mud, he found a big, shiny rock. He showed it to his friends, and they all thought it was special. They played with the shiny rock, and it made their games more fun.
But then, something unexpected happened. The shiny rock started to wiggle and shake! It wasn't a rock at all - it was an egg! A little bird came out of the egg, and the bird became their new friend. They all played together at the pond, mixing mud and having fun.

Once upon a time, there was a blue cat named Bob. Bob was a lawyer. He liked to help others with their problems. One day, Bob met a little girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her toy.
"Hi Sue, I am Bob the lawyer. Why are you sad?" asked Bob. Sue told him about her lost toy. Bob wanted to help her find it.
Bob and Sue walked around, looking for the toy. They saw a big tree. Sue said, "I think my toy is in the tree." Bob climbed the tree and found the toy. He rubbed the toy with his paw to clean it. Then, he gave it back to Sue.
Sue was happy to have her toy back. She thanked Bob the blue lawyer cat. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly goat. The goat had a big red ball. He liked to play with the ball in the sun. One day, the goat was playing with the ball near a tree. He was very happy.
But then, the ball went up and got stuck in the tree. The goat was sad. He wanted his ball back. He tried to jump high to get the ball, but he could not reach it. The goat did not know what to do.
A kind bird saw the sad goat. The bird had an idea. The bird flew up and split a branch to get the ball. The ball fell down, and the goat got his ball back. The goat was very happy again. The goat and the bird played together in the sun.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a tube. He did not know what the tube was for. He thought it was important. So, he took the tube to his friend, Sue. Sue was good at finding out what things do.
Sue looked at the tube and said, "I think I know what this tube does! Let's go to the park and try it out." Tim and Sue went to the park with the tube. They tried to use the tube to do many things. They tried to use it as a telescope, a horn, and a hat. But, none of these things were what the tube did.
Then, a big wind came and blew the tube away. Tim and Sue were sad. They thought they lost the important tube. But, the wind blew the tube into the pond. And something unexpected happened. The tube floated on the water like a boat. Tim and Sue were so happy to find out what the tube did. They played with the tube boat in the pond all day long.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went for a walk. She saw a lady with a long, dull dress. The lady was marching down the street, holding a big sign. Lucy was curious and wanted to know what the sign said.
Lucy walked up to the lady and asked, "What does your sign say?" The lady smiled and said, "It says 'I love cats!'" Lucy laughed and said, "I love cats too!"
Lucy and the lady marched together, holding the sign high. They had a fun day, talking about cats and making new friends. And from that day on, Lucy and the lady became best friends who loved cats and marched together.

One day, a little girl named Lucy found a fragile piece of paper in her room. On the paper, there was a poem. Lucy liked the poem. She wanted to show it to her friend, Tim.
Lucy went to Tim's house and showed him the poem. Tim liked the poem too. He said, "Let's read it together." So they read the poem together and had fun.
After they read the poem, Lucy said, "Let's write our own poem." Tim liked the idea. They sat down and thought about what to write. Lucy suggested, "How about a poem about the sun and the moon?" Tim agreed, and they wrote a beautiful poem together. They were very happy with their new poem.

Anna loved to visit her elderly grandma, who lived in a big house with a garden. Grandma always had stories to tell, cookies to share, and a hug to give. Anna liked to look at the photos on the wall, and ask grandma about them.
One day, Anna saw a photo of grandma wearing a funny hat. It was round and red, with a feather on the side. Anna pointed at it and said, "What is that?"
Grandma smiled and said, "That is my hat. I wore it when I was young and went to a party. It was a special hat, and I felt very happy."
Anna asked, "Can I see your hat? Can I wear it?"
Grandma nodded and said, "Of course, my dear. Come with me, I will show you where I keep it." She took Anna by the hand and led her to a closet. She opened it and took out a box. Inside the box was the hat, just like in the photo.
Grandma put the hat on Anna's head and said, "You look lovely, Anna. Just like I did when I was your age. Do you like it?"
Anna looked in the mirror and giggled. She liked the hat very much. It was soft and warm, and the feather tickled her cheek. She said, "Thank you, grandma. I love your hat. Can I keep it?"
Grandma hugged her and said, "You can keep it, Anna. It is a gift from me to you. I want you to remember me, and the stories I tell you. You are my precious granddaughter, and I love you very much."
Anna hugged her back and said, "I love you too, grandma. I will always remember you, and your hat."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a friend named Ben. They liked to play together every day. Ben was a popular boy and had many friends.
One day, they found a big box on the playground. They wanted to see what was inside. Mia tried to remove the lid, but it was too heavy. Ben helped her, and together they removed the lid.
Inside the box, they found lots of toys and games. Mia and Ben shared the toys with all their friends. Everyone was happy and had lots of fun. Mia and Ben became even more popular because they shared the toys. And they all played together every day.

One day, a little girl named Amy went to the park with her mom. They wanted to gather pine cones. Amy loved to play with the cones and make fun crafts with them.
Amy saw a big and foolish squirrel. The squirrel was holding a pine cone in its hands. "Hi, squirrel!" said Amy. "Can I have that cone, please?" The squirrel looked at her and gave her the cone. "Thank you, squirrel!" Amy said with a big smile.
Amy and her mom gathered many cones. They put them in a big bag. When they got home, they made pretty things with the cones. Amy was so happy and couldn't wait to go back to the park to gather more cones and see her squirrel friend again.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy family. They had a lovely house with a big garden.
One day, the mom and dad were playing with their three year old son outside in their garden. Suddenly, the sun began to set and it got dark.
The mom and dad said, “It’s getting dark. Let’s go inside.”
The three year old son asked, “What’s inside? Can’t I stay outside?”
The mom and dad smiled and said, “Yes, you can stay outside, but you must come inside to reveal the surprise.”
The three year old was very excited. He asked, “What surprise? What is it?”
But the mom and dad just smiled and said, “Come inside to find out.”
The three year old ran inside and when he opened the door, he saw a big pile of toys! He was so excited he jumped around and said, “Wooohooooo! Toys!”
The wealthy family had revealed a wonderful surprise for the three year old.

Lily likes to dress up. She has many clothes in her closet. She has dresses, skirts, pants, shirts, hats, and shoes. She likes to mix and match them and make new outfits.
One day, she wants to dress like a fairy. She finds a pink dress with sparkles, a pair of wings, and a wand. She puts them on and looks in the mirror. She smiles and twirls.
She goes to the garden to play. She sees a butterfly and tries to catch it with her wand. She follows it to a flower. She bends down to look at it. She sees something shiny on the flower. It is a ring. It is very small, only an inch big.
Lily picks up the ring and puts it on her finger. It fits perfectly. She thinks it is a magic ring. She makes a wish. She wishes she could fly like a butterfly. She waves her wand and says, "Abracadabra!"
She feels a tickle on her back. She looks over her shoulder and sees her wings. They are moving. She flaps them and lifts off the ground. She is flying! She is so happy. She flies around the garden, feeling the wind and the sun. She sees the butterfly again and flies with it. She thinks the ring is very useful. She thanks the flower for giving it to her. She has a lot of fun. She is a fairy.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the beach with his mom. He wore a big hat to keep the sun away. The sand on the beach was warm and soft under his feet. He loved to play in the sand and build castles.
Tim saw another boy named Sam. Sam looked sad and bored. Tim asked, "Why are you bored?" Sam said, "I lost my toy in the sand, and I can't find it." Tim wanted to help Sam, so they both started to look for the toy.
As they looked, Tim remembered he had a special tool to find things in the sand. He ran to his mom and got the tool. Tim and Sam used the tool and found the toy. Sam was happy, and they played together all day. The beach was not boring anymore.

Once there was a little girl who loved to race. Everywhere she went, she would run faster and faster. One day, she saw something pink and shiny. It was a symbol and it made the little girl so excited. She had to touch it and race around the symbol.
The little girl ran faster and faster, until she was out of breath. She kept running around the symbol and then suddenly she tripped and fell. She cried out in pain and the symbol turned into dust.
The little girl was so sad. She had wanted to keep the symbol forever, but now it was gone. She had been too eager and she learnt her lesson never to race too fast.

Once upon a time, there was a slow sausage. The slow sausage lived in a small house. The slow sausage had a friend, a fast cat. They liked to play together.
One day, the slow sausage said to the fast cat, "Let's race to the big tree." The fast cat said, "Ok!" They started to run. The slow sausage was very slow, but the fast cat was very fast. The fast cat got to the big tree first.
The slow sausage was sad. The fast cat said, "Don't be sad. You tried your best." The slow sausage smiled. They played more games and had fun. The slow sausage and the fast cat were happy friends.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Mia went to visit her grandma. When she got there, she saw many boxes in her grandma's room. Mia asked, "Grandma, what are these?" Her grandma said, "These are my unique things from my past. Let's unpack them together."
As they unpacked the boxes, Mia found a big mirror. She took a look at herself and smiled. She saw her grandma looking at her and they both laughed. Mia asked, "Grandma, why do I look different from you?" Her grandma said, "We are all unique, my dear. That is what makes us special."
After they finished unpacking, Mia and her grandma sat down to rest. They talked about all the unique things they found. Grandma told Mia stories about her past and the things she did when she was young. Mia learned that being unique is a good thing and that everyone has their own special look and story.

Once upon a time, there was a lively sunflower named Sunny. Sunny lived in a big garden with many other flowers. Every day, the sun would come up and all the flowers would wake up.
One day, Sunny decided to do something fun. Sunny wanted to dance! So, Sunny started to wiggle and jiggle in the wind. The other flowers saw Sunny and they wanted to dance too. Soon, all the flowers in the garden were dancing.
The people who walked by the garden saw the dancing flowers and smiled. They clapped and laughed as the flowers danced in the wind. Sunny and the other flowers were so happy to make people smile. They danced all day until the sun went down. And from that day on, the garden was known as the dancing sunflower garden.

Once upon a time, in a big, big house, there was an enormous cat. The cat had a big fluffy tail and liked to play all day. One day, the cat saw a tiny mouse. The mouse was very fast and had a little, little house.
The enormous cat wanted to play with the mouse, so it tried to enter the little house. But the cat was too big and could not fit! The cat was sad and sat down.
Then, the tiny mouse came out of its house and gave the cat a little wink. The cat was happy, and they played together all day long. The enormous cat and tiny mouse became best friends, and they lived happily ever after.

One day, a big dog and a small cat were playing in the park. The big dog wanted to play with a ball, but the small cat did not. The big dog felt guilty because the small cat was sad.
The big dog said, "Please play with me and the ball." But the small cat refused. The big dog put the ball on the small cat's shoulder to make her happy. The small cat looked at the ball, but still did not want to play.
As they were talking, a big wind came and took the ball away. The big dog and the small cat ran after the ball, but they could not catch it. The ball went up, up, up into the sky and was gone. The big dog and the small cat were both sad that the ball was gone, and they went home with heavy hearts.

One day, a little girl named Amy went to help her mom with the laundry. They had a big basket full of dirty clothes. Amy liked to help her mom because it made her feel big and strong.
As they were doing the laundry, Amy saw a hairy dog outside. The dog was staring at them through the window. Amy said, "Mom, look at the hairy dog! He is staring at us!" Her mom looked up and saw the dog too. She smiled and said, "Yes, he is a very hairy dog."
Amy and her mom finished the laundry and went outside to play. The hairy dog was still there, staring at them. Amy asked her mom, "Can we play with the dog?" Her mom said, "Yes, but be gentle." So, Amy and the hairy dog played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Kitty. Kitty had big eyes and lived in a cool house with her best friend, a dog named Doggy. They played and had fun all day long.
One day, Kitty saw a big cake on the table. She wanted to eat it, but she knew it was not hers. Kitty thought and thought, and then she took a bite. The cake was sweet and yummy, but Kitty started to feel bad. She knew she made a mistake and felt regret.
Doggy saw Kitty was sad and asked her what was wrong. Kitty told Doggy about the cake. Doggy said, "It's okay, Kitty. We all make mistakes. But we must say sorry and learn from them." Kitty said sorry to her family for eating the cake. They forgave her, and Kitty learned to always do the right thing.

One day, a big, honest dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a small cat with a pretty tie. The cat was sad. The tie was stuck in a tree. Max wanted to help the cat.
Max said, "Don't worry, little cat. I will help you get your tie back." The cat blinked her eyes and said, "Thank you, Max." Max jumped high and tried to get the tie from the tree. But he could not reach it.
Just then, a bird came by. The bird saw Max and the cat. The bird wanted to help too. The bird flew up and got the tie from the tree. The cat was very happy. Max and the cat did not know that the bird could help. It was a big surprise. They all became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a big, harmless dog named Spot. They were best friends and loved to play together. One day, Tim and Spot went to the park to play.
Tim had a big bag with him. He would use the bag to carry his toys. He took out a ball from the bag and threw it for Spot to catch. Spot ran fast and caught the ball in his mouth. They played catch for a long time.
After they were done playing, Tim put the ball back in the bag. He and Spot sat under a tree to rest. They were very happy and had a fun day at the park. Tim and Spot went home and couldn't wait to play again.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Softy. Softy had soft fur and loved to play. One day, Softy found a big ball. Softy liked the ball a lot and wanted to play with it.
Softy tried to raise the ball with his mouth, but it was too big. Then, Softy tried to push the ball with his nose, but it was too heavy. Softy did not give up. He had an idea. He would try to move the ball with his heel.
Softy pushed the ball with his heel. It started to move! Softy was happy. But then, the ball rolled down a big hill. Softy tried to stop the ball, but it was too fast. The ball hit a tree and broke. Softy was sad. He could not play with the ball anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a rubber ball that he loved to play with. He liked to throw it, bounce it, and roll it. One day, Tim met a new friend named Sam. Sam was very intelligent and could think of fun games to play with the rubber ball.
"Let's play a game," said Sam. "I think we can take turns throwing the ball and see who can throw it the farthest." Tim liked the idea and they started to play. They threw the ball back and forth, laughing and having fun.
As they played, a little girl named Sue came to join them. She wanted to play too. "Can I play with you?" asked Sue. Tim and Sam said yes, and they all played together. They took turns throwing the rubber ball and had a great time. They were happy to have made new friends and to play with the rubber ball together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He loved to play ball with his friends. They would all run, kick, and send the ball flying in the air. Tim was very good at this game. He would always get a high score.
One day, a new kid named Sam came to play. Sam was very generous. He would always share his toys with everyone. Tim and his friends liked Sam a lot. They all wanted to play ball with him. But Sam had a secret.
They all played ball together. Tim sent the ball to Sam. Sam kicked the ball very hard. The ball went up, up, up in the sky. Everyone was so happy. They thought Sam would get the highest score.
But then, something unexpected happened. The ball did not come back down. It went up, up, up and disappeared. All the kids were sad. They could not play ball anymore. Sam was very sorry. He did not know his secret would make the ball go away forever. And that was the end of their fun game.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her mom's makeup. One day, when her mom was not home, Lily saw the wide box of makeup on the table. She wanted to play with it.
Lily opened the wide box and saw many colors. She picked up a brush and started to put the makeup on her face. She put red on her lips, blue on her eyes, and pink on her cheeks. Lily looked in the mirror and laughed. She thought she looked funny.
Then, her mom came home and saw Lily with the makeup on her face. Her mom said, "Lily, you look so funny! But, we should not play with makeup when mom is not here. I miss you when I am gone, and I want to be here to help you." Lily said, "I am sorry, mom. I will wait for you next time." They both smiled and cleaned Lily's face together.

Lila and Ben were twins who loved to visit their grandpa on his farm. He had many animals, but their favorite was Molly the mule. Molly was jolly and liked to play with the twins. She would let them ride on her back, pull them in a cart, and nibble on their hats.
One day, grandpa had to go to town for some work. He told the twins to stay near the house and not to bother Molly. He said Molly was tired and needed to rest. He made them promise to be good and listen to grandma. Lila and Ben nodded and said they would.
But after grandpa left, the twins got bored. They wanted to see Molly and have some fun. They thought Molly would not mind if they played with her for a little while. They sneaked out of the house and ran to the barn where Molly was sleeping.
They woke her up and asked her to play with them. Molly was not jolly. She was grumpy and wanted to sleep. She shook her head and tried to ignore them. But the twins did not listen. They climbed on her back, pulled her ears, and tickled her nose.
Molly had enough. She gave a loud bray and kicked her legs. She threw the twins off her back and ran out of the barn. She galloped across the field and did not stop until she reached the fence. She was angry and scared.
The twins were sad and sorry. They had broken their promise and hurt Molly. They ran after her and called her name. They said they were sorry and asked her to come back. They said they loved her and would not bother her again.
Molly heard them and looked back. She saw their tears and heard their words. She felt sorry for them too. She walked back to them and let them hug her. She licked their faces and nuzzled their hair. She was jolly again.
The twins were happy and grateful. They thanked Molly and said they would keep their promise. They said they would be good and listen to grandma. They walked back to the house with Molly and gave her some carrots. They said they would see her again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, in a warm and sunny land, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, she found a pretty veil while she was hiding. The veil was soft and light, like a cloud.
Lily showed the veil to her friend, Tom. "Look what I found!" she said. "It's so pretty! Let's play with it." Tom agreed and they decided to use the veil to make their hide and seek game more fun.
Lily and Tom took turns wearing the veil while they hid. The veil made it harder for their friends to find them. They laughed and played all day long. At the end of the day, Lily and Tom were happy and tired. They knew they had the best day ever with their new veil.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little spider. The spider was independent and liked to do things on its own. It made a big cobweb in the corner of the room.
One day, a child came to the house. The child saw the cobweb and did not like it. The child wanted the cobweb gone. The spider did not want the cobweb to be gone. The spider liked its cobweb.
The child asked the spider to accept a new place to live. The spider did not want to move, but it thought about it. The spider decided to accept the new place. The child helped the spider find a new home outside. Now, the child and the spider were both happy.

One day, a boy named Tim went to play outside. He wanted to find something fun to do. As he walked, he saw something on the ground. It was a marble! But this was an unusual marble. It was big and had many colors.
Tim picked up the marble and showed it to his friend, Sam. "Look what I found!" said Tim. Sam looked at the marble and said, "Wow, that's a cool marble! Let's play with it." So, they played with the marble and had lots of fun.
But then, something unexpected happened. The unusual marble started to grow bigger and bigger! Tim and Sam were very surprised. They didn't know what to do. The marble grew so big that it turned into a giant ball! Tim and Sam climbed on top of it and went on a fun ride around the park. They laughed and had the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a fierce lion. The lion had a big, loud roar. Everyone was scared of the lion. The lion lived in a cage at the zoo. The zookeeper took care of the lion.
One day, the zookeeper set a big bowl of food in the lion's cage. The lion was very hungry. It ate all the food very fast. The zookeeper was happy that the lion liked the food.
Soon, it was time for the lion to go to sleep. The lion lay down in its cage and closed its eyes. The zookeeper said goodnight to the lion. The lion slept all night and had sweet dreams. The next day, the lion woke up and was not fierce anymore. It was a happy lion.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little cat named Kitty. She loved to play with her friend, a small mouse named Mimi. One day, they found a big clock in the house. The clock was very pretty and went "tick-tock, tick-tock."
Kitty said to Mimi, "I bet I can fit inside the clock!" Mimi said, "No, Kitty, you are too big!" But Kitty didn't listen. She tried to fit inside the clock, but she got stuck. Mimi tried to help her, but she couldn't.
Just then, Mommy came into the room. She saw Kitty stuck in the clock and said, "Oh no! Kitty, you should have listened to Mimi!" Mommy helped Kitty get out of the clock. Kitty was sorry for not listening to her friend.
The moral of the story is to listen to your friends when they give you good advice.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mom and dad. Lily liked to play with her toys and listen to her mom's stories.
One day, Lily found a bottle in the kitchen. The bottle had a word on it: "poison". Her mom told her that poison is bad and can make people very sick. Lily knew she should not touch the bottle, so she put it back and played with her toys.
Later, Lily's mom made cookies for her. The cookies were hard, but they tasted good. Lily was happy she listened to her mom and did not touch the poison. She enjoyed her cookies and felt safe with her mom and dad.

Once upon a time, there was a little caterpillar named Catty. Catty lived in a wide, green garden with many flowers. Catty had many friends, but her best friend was a tiny ant named Andy.
One day, Catty and Andy saw a big, red ball stuck in a tree. They wanted to play with the ball, but it was too high. They tried to think of a way to get the ball down.
Catty had an idea. She would climb the tree and push the ball down. Catty started to climb, but it was not easy. She did not give up. Andy cheered for Catty from the ground. At last, Catty managed to reach the ball and push it down. Andy and Catty were very happy. They played with the ball all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn navy boat. It sailed across the sea and had lots of adventures.
One day, the boat hit a storm. The waves were big and wild and the wind was blowing hard. The boat started to split in two.
The crew tried to fix the boat, but they couldn't. It was too broken. So they called for help.
An even bigger navy boat came and took the crew to shore. The stubborn navy boat was left alone to sail away, forever.

One evening, a hungry cat went out to find food. She saw a big house with a door open. The cat went inside the house. In the house, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue saw the cat and said, "Hello, cat! Are you hungry?"
The cat looked at Sue and meowed. Sue knew the cat was hungry. She gave the cat some food. The cat ate the food and was very happy. Sue and the cat became good friends.
One day, a big dog came to the house. The dog was not nice. The dog wanted to own the house. The dog said, "This is my house now!" Sue was scared. But then, the cat did something unexpected. The cat jumped on the dog and made the dog run away. Sue was so happy and said, "Thank you, cat! You saved us!" The cat and Sue stayed friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a messy little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play outside in the grass. One sunny day, Spot was running and jumping in the grass when he saw a big red ball.
Spot wanted to play with the big red ball, but his mom said, "Wait, Spot! We have to delay our playtime. We need to clean up your messy room first." Spot was sad, but he knew he had to listen to his mom. So, he went inside and started to clean up his room.
As Spot was cleaning, he found a secret door under his bed. He opened the door and saw a big room filled with grass and lots of big red balls! Spot was so happy! Now he could clean his room and play in the secret grass room at the same time. And that's how Spot found the best surprise ever while doing his chores.

One day, a boy and girl went to the beach. They saw an island far away. The boy said, "Let's watch the island."
As they watched, they saw something thick in the water. It was a big, thick rope. The girl said, "What is that thick thing?"
They pulled the thick rope and something big came out of the water. It was a treasure box! The boy and girl were very happy. They found a big surprise on the island.
The boy and girl opened the treasure box. Inside, they found a big cake. They laughed and shared the cake with their friends. The island had a fun surprise for everyone.

Tim and Sam are twins. They like to play with their aunt Jen. Aunt Jen is fun and kind. She has thick hair and big glasses.
One day, aunt Jen comes to visit. She brings a big box. Tim and Sam are curious. They want to know what is in the box.
"Can we open it, aunt Jen?" they ask.
"Not yet, my sweeties. You have to wait until after lunch. But you can shake it and guess what it is," aunt Jen says.
Tim and Sam take turns to shake the box. It makes a funny noise. It sounds like bells and rattles.
"It is a toy!" Tim says.
"Maybe it is a drum!" Sam says.
Aunt Jen smiles. She says, "You are both very smart. But you have to wait and see. Now, let's go and have some soup and bread."
Tim and Sam follow aunt Jen to the kitchen. They are hungry and excited. They wonder what is in the box. They hope it is something fun and nice. They love their aunt Jen and her surprises.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little dog named Spot. Spot had a funny mustache on his face. He loved to play with his ball in the park. One day, he saw a big red balloon in the sky. Spot wanted to play with the balloon too.
Spot's best friend, Tim, came to the park. Tim saw the big red balloon in the sky. He knew Spot wanted to play with it. Tim had a plan. He told Spot to wait and see. Spot was very excited.
Tim went home and came back with a long string. He tied the string to the balloon. Then, Tim told Spot to release the string. The balloon came down and Spot played with it. Spot was very happy. Tim's plan worked, and they both had a great day at the park.

Once there was a brave little girl named Eva. She loved her desk, which was made of glass.
Every day she watched out of the window. She could see a big farm with lots of animals.
One day Eva saw something strange in the field. A big black bear! Eva was so brave, she went outside to see what the bear was doing.
Eva yelled to the bear, "Hey bear, why are you here?"
The bear answered, "I'm just looking for something to eat!"
Eva was really brave. She told the bear, "There's no food here, but come inside and I will give you something to eat from my desk!"
The bear followed her inside and Eva gave him some apples from her desk. The bear was so happy and thanked Eva for her kindness.
The bear stayed for a while and played with Eva. When it was time for the bear to go, Eva hugged him and said goodbye.
The bear left, but Eva continued to watch out the window for him and was always brave when he returned.

Once there was a little girl named Amy. She liked to play games with her friends. They were very competitive. They wanted to win all the time.
One day, Amy and her friends found some junk in the park. They saw a big box. They thought it would be fun to play a game with the box. They decided to taste what was inside the box. They thought it would be candy.
But when they opened the box, they found a little kitten! They were so surprised. The kitten was very cute. They forgot about the game and played with the kitten instead. They all became friends and had a lot of fun together.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily found some shiny jewelry in her mom's room. She thought it was pretty and wanted to wear it. But her mom said, "No, Lily. That jewelry is not for you. It's for grown-ups."
One day, Lily saw a little cat outside her house. The cat had a shiny necklace around its neck, just like the jewelry she saw in her mom's room. She thought it was a little foolish, but she wanted to follow the cat and see where it went.
Lily followed the cat down the street and into the woods. They came across a small house made of candy. The cat went inside, and Lily followed. To her surprise, she saw many other cats inside, all wearing shiny jewelry like her mom's.
A kind old lady welcomed her and said, "Hello, dear. I see you followed my cat. I make jewelry for cats, and they love to wear it. Would you like to learn how to make some too?"
Lily was so happy to learn how to make jewelry for cats. She made a beautiful necklace for her new cat friend and went home to show her mom. Her mom was surprised and proud of Lily for learning something new. From that day on, Lily and her mom made jewelry together, not just for grown-ups, but for cats too.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play together. One day, Lily's mom says, "We are going to the park. Do you want to bring Tom?"
Lily is happy. She says, "Yes, please! Tom, do you want to come to the park with me?"
Tom is happy, too. He says, "Yes, I do! The park is nice. We can slide and swing and run."
Lily's mom says, "OK, let's go. But first, we need to bring some things. Lily, can you bring your hat and your water bottle? Tom, can you bring your ball and your snack?"
Lily and Tom say, "OK, we can bring them." They go to their rooms and get their things. Then they go to the car with Lily's mom.
At the park, Lily and Tom have fun. They slide and swing and run. They share their ball and their snack. They see some birds and some flowers. They say, "The park is nice. We like the park."
Lily's mom says, "It's time to go home. Did you have fun?"
Lily and Tom say, "Yes, we did. Thank you for bringing us to the park."
They hug and say goodbye. They go to their cars with their moms. They wave and smile. They are happy. They are friends.

Once, there was a young boy who noticed a fountain just outside his house. He wondered, "Why are fountains so special?" He asked his father, who firmly replied, "Fountains are special because they make us feel safe and calm." The boy thought about this for a moment, but still couldn't understand why a fountain made he and his friends feel so safe. His father knelt down and said, "When you are thirsty and need a drink, a fountain can give you the water you need. Its safe, clean water will keep you healthy and happy."
The boy thought about this and nodded. From then on, he and his friends made sure to stay safe near fountains and drink from them as much as possible.
Moral of the story: Fountains provide us with safety, clean water and an opportunity to stay healthy and happy. Therefore, it is important to take care when near fountains and to take advantage of their special qualities.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a dancer. The dancer loved to dance all day. She had a friend named Tom. Tom liked to watch her dance.
One hot day, the dancer said to Tom, "I feel like I will melt in this sun!" Tom laughed and said, "Let's go to the unknown park to dance in the shade." The dancer agreed, and they went to the park.
At the park, the dancer danced under a big tree. Tom clapped and cheered for her. They had a fun time. The dancer did not melt, and they played until the sun went down.

Tom and Lily were bored. They had no toys to play with. They looked around the room and saw a box of crayons on the table.
"Let's draw something with the crayons," Tom suggested.
"OK, what should we draw?" Lily asked.
Tom thought for a moment. He saw a small bird outside the window. He liked the bird's bright colors.
"How about a bird?" he said.
Lily nodded. She liked birds too. They took the crayons and some paper and started to draw.
Tom picked a blue crayon and drew a circle for the bird's body. Lily picked a yellow crayon and drew a triangle for the bird's beak. They added eyes, wings, feet and a tail. They were happy with their bird.
"Look, we made a bird!" Tom said.
"It's a pretty bird," Lily said.
They showed their bird to their mom. She smiled and praised them.
"What a lovely bird! You are very good at drawing," she said.
Tom and Lily felt proud. They hugged their mom and thanked her.
They decided to draw more animals with the crayons. They had fun and forgot their boredom.

One day, a happy cat named Tom went for a walk. He gazed at the wild flowers and the big trees. He loved to see all the colors and smell the fresh air.
Tom met a bird named Sue. Sue was blue and had a pretty song. "Hi, Sue," said Tom. "Do you want to play with me?" Sue said, "Yes, let's play together!"
They played all day. They ran and jumped and laughed. They were very happy. At the end of the day, they gazed at the sky and saw the sun go down. They knew they would be friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Ben. Ben loved to wear his red coat with many buttons. One day, he went for a walk in the woods.
As he walked, he met a small bird named Tina. Tina was very alert and noticed that one of Ben's buttons was missing. "Oh no, Ben!" said Tina. "You lost a button from your red coat!"
Ben was sad but he and Tina looked for the missing button together. They looked under the trees and near the pond. Suddenly, they found a shiny button, but it was not Ben's button. It was a magic button!
They pushed the magic button and, poof! Ben's red coat was fixed with all its buttons. Ben and Tina were so happy. From that day on, they became the best of friends and had many more adventures together.

One day, a chubby dog named Buddy found a toy. It was a red ball. Buddy liked to chew toys. He picked up the ball and started to chew it. He was very happy.
Buddy saw his friend, a cat named Whiskers. Whiskers was sitting under a tree. "Look at my new toy!" said Buddy. "I like to chew it!" Whiskers looked at the toy and said, "That's not a toy, that's an apple!"
Buddy was surprised. He did not know it was an apple. He took a big bite and it was sweet and juicy. Buddy and Whiskers laughed. Now, Buddy liked to chew apples too. They played with the apple and had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big billboard. The billboard had many colors and pictures. It was very organized. Every day, a little boy named Tim would walk by the billboard on his way to school. Tim liked to study the billboard and look at all the pictures. He always wondered what the billboard was trying to tell him.
One day, Tim saw a new picture on the billboard. It was a picture of a big red ball. Tim loved to play with balls, so he was very excited. He thought, "Maybe there will be a big red ball at the park today!" Tim couldn't wait to go to the park after school.
After school, Tim hurried to the park. And there it was, just like the billboard had shown him – a big red ball! Tim played with the ball all afternoon, having lots of fun. The organized billboard had given him a clue about the big red ball, and Tim was so happy he had studied it every day. From then on, Tim always paid attention to the pictures on the billboard, because he knew they might tell him about more fun surprises.

Lily and Tom went to the park with Mom. They saw many people and animals. They saw a big slide and a swing. They wanted to play.
"Can we play, Mom?" Lily asked.
"Yes, but first we need to seat on that bench and eat our lunch. You are hungry, right?" Mom said.
Lily and Tom nodded. They were hungry. They followed Mom to the bench. Mom gave them sandwiches and juice. They ate and drank.
Near the bench, there was a vendor. He had a cart with ice cream and candy. He smiled at Lily and Tom.
"Hello, little ones. Do you want some ice cream or candy? They are very yummy," he said.
Lily and Tom looked at the vendor. They liked ice cream and candy. They wanted some.
"Mom, can we have some ice cream or candy?" Tom asked.
Mom shook her head. "No, you just ate your lunch. You don't need more sugar. It is not good for your teeth and your tummy. Maybe later, if you are good."
Lily and Tom felt sad. They wanted some ice cream or candy. They looked at the vendor again. He winked at them.
"Come on, don't be shy. I have a special offer for you. You can have one ice cream or candy for free. Just come to my cart and take one. Your mom won't notice. She is busy with her phone," he said.
Lily and Tom felt tempted. They looked at Mom. She was busy with her phone. They looked at the vendor. He smiled at them. They looked at each other. They had a bad idea.
They got up from the bench. They walked to the cart. They reached for the ice cream and candy. They thought they were clever.
But Mom saw them. She was not busy with her phone. She was watching them. She was angry.
She got up from the bench. She walked to the cart. She grabbed Lily and Tom by their hands. She scolded them.
"What are you doing? How dare you take something without asking? How dare you listen to a stranger? He is not your friend. He is a bad man. He wants to trick you. He wants to hurt you. You should never talk to strangers. You should never take things from strangers. You should always listen to me. I love you. I want to protect you. Do you understand?" she said.
Lily and Tom felt ashamed. They felt sorry. They realized they made a mistake. They nodded.
"Yes, Mom. We understand. We are sorry. We love you. We will listen to you. We will never talk to strangers. We will never take things from strangers. We promise," they said.
Mom hugged them. She forgave them. She took them back to the bench. She threw away the ice cream and candy. She gave them water and fruit. They ate and drank.
They learned a lesson. They learned to be careful. They learned to be obedient. They learned to be grateful. They were happy.

Once upon a time there was a 3 year old boy named Tommy. Tommy loved modern things, which made him very excited. One day, Tommy asked his dad if he could borrow his hammer to build something.
Dad said, "Yes, you can have my hammer, but be careful!" Tommy was so excited and grabbed the hammer with a smile on his face.
Tommy used the hammer to put together a modern box. When he had finished, he asked his dad, "Do you like my box?"
Dad smiled and said, "Yes, it looks great. You did a wonderful job!" Tommy's face lit up with pride.
The end.
