"See, Anna, sugar is good," he says. "You should try some too."
Anna shakes her head. She does not want sugar. She wants to be a good girl. She hears Mommy's footsteps. She is coming to the kitchen.
"Ben, quick, put the jar back!" Anna says. "Mommy is here. She will see us."
But it is too late. Mommy walks in and sees Ben with sugar on his face and the jar on the floor. She is not happy.
"Ben, Anna, what are you doing?" Mommy says. "Did you take sugar from the jar?"
Ben looks down. He feels bad. He knows he did something wrong.
"I'm sorry, Mommy," he says. "I wanted some sugar. It was sweet and yummy."
Mommy sighs. She picks up the jar and the spoon. She wipes Ben's face with a napkin.
"Ben, sugar is not good for you," Mommy says. "It can make you sick and spoil your appetite. You should not take it without asking me. I have told you this many times. Why don't you listen?"
Ben does not know what to say. He feels sorry. He looks at Anna. She looks sad too.
"I'm sorry, Anna," he says. "I should have listened to you. You were right. Sugar is bad."
Anna nods. She hugs Ben. She forgives him.
"It's okay, Ben," she says. "We all make mistakes. But we have to learn from them. Next time, let's follow the rules. Mommy knows what is best for us."
Mommy smiles. She hugs them both.
"I love you, Ben and Anna," she says. "But please, no more sugar before dinner. Only fruits and water. Do you understand?"
"Yes, Mommy," Ben and Anna say. "We understand."
Mommy gives them each a fruit. They eat it happily. They think it is sweet and yummy too. They do not want sugar anymore. They want to be good. They want to make Mommy proud.

Once upon a time, a big crocodile lived in a pond. He was slow and liked to wander around the pond every day. He had no friends because he was a little scary.
One day, a small bird came to the pond. She saw the crocodile and thought he looked lonely. The bird wanted to be his friend. She flew down to say hello. The crocodile saw the bird and smiled.
But the crocodile was very hungry. He had not eaten for days. When the bird came close, the crocodile opened his mouth wide. The bird did not know the crocodile was hungry. The crocodile ate the bird quickly. The bird was gone, and the crocodile was still alone.

Once upon a time, there was a smart cat. The cat lived in a small house with a girl. The girl loved the cat very much. They played together every day.
One day, the girl wanted to show the cat a new game. She took the cat to the bathroom. The girl turned on the shower. The cat did not like the water. The cat ran away and hid under the bed.
The girl felt bad. She turned off the shower and found the cat. She said sorry to the cat. The girl learned not to make others do things they do not like. The cat forgave the girl. They played a different game and were happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion who lived in the jungle. The lion was very dangerous and all the animals were scared of him. One day, the lion decided he wanted peace in the jungle. He called all the animals for a big meeting.
At the meeting, the lion said, "I will not be dangerous anymore. I want peace and to be friends with all of you." The animals were very happy and they all began to applaud. They were excited to be friends with the lion and to have peace in the jungle.
But then, something unexpected happened. A tiny mouse stood up and said, "I don't believe the lion. He is still dangerous." The other animals were surprised by the mouse's words. They asked the mouse why he thought that. The mouse said, "I saw the lion eat another animal yesterday." The animals were sad and scared again. They knew the lion was still dangerous and there would be no peace in the jungle.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to make music. One day the girl went to a new place and heard the most beautiful music she had ever heard.
The girl followed the music to a big park. Standing in the middle of the park she saw a magical creature. It was a dragon!
The girl was scared but the dragon said, "Don't be afraid, I'm harmless."
The dragon then said, "Let's make music together!" The girl smiled and jumped up and down with excitement.
The dragon and the girl made music. Even the birds sang along. It was so much fun!
The girl returned home happy. She could still hear the music in her heart and smiled, remembering the time she made music with the harmless dragon.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big march. All the people and animals were going to walk together. They wanted to show how much they loved their town. The sun was shining, and it was a perfect day.
A little girl named Lily wanted to join the march. She put on her favorite dress and shoes. She was so excited! As she walked, she saw her friend, a small dog named Max. Max was excited too, but he was scared of stumbling. "Don't worry, Max," said Lily, "I will hold your paw, and we will walk together."
As they walked in the march, Max started to stumble. But Lily held his paw tight, and they kept walking. The people and animals in the march saw this and smiled. They all learned that helping each other makes everything better. And that was the best march ever.

Lily liked to draw in her notebook. She had many colors of crayons and stickers. She drew flowers, animals, and stars. She wanted to make a beautiful notebook for her mom.
One day, she finished her last page. She was very happy. She had completed her notebook. She put a big heart sticker on the cover and wrote "I love you, Mom" with her red crayon.
She ran to the kitchen, where her mom was making cookies. She said, "Mom, look what I made for you!" She gave her the notebook with a big smile.
Her mom hugged her and said, "Wow, Lily, this is a beautiful notebook! You are so creative and sweet. Thank you so much, my darling. I love you, too."
They sat down and looked at the notebook together. They admired Lily's drawings and talked about them. They ate some cookies and drank some milk. They were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Max. Max loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Max saw a little red ball in the grass. He ran up to the ball and picked it up with his mouth.
Max saw his friend, a small cat named Lily. Lily had a cut on her leg. Max went to Lily and said, "Oh no, you have a cut! Let me help you." Lily replied, "Thank you, Max. I was playing and got hurt."
Max found a big leaf and put it on Lily's cut. Then, he used his teeth to snap a small stick in half. Max put the stick on the leaf to hold it in place. Lily felt better and said, "Thank you, Max. You are a good friend." They played with the red ball together and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Annabelle. She was a very organized girl and she loved playing with drums. Every day she would bring her drum to the park and put on a show.
One day, a mean boy came to the park and saw Annabelle. He was very angry because he wanted to play with the drums too. He yelled at Annabelle and tried to take the drum away from her.
But Annabelle was too organized and she held on tight. The mean boy got madder and madder and eventually, he became so angry that he picked up the drum and threw it away. Annabelle was very sad and she ran home crying.
The mean boy had ruined Annabelle's special day. He had brought a bad ending to Annabelle's fun.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to play in the park. She saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. As she climbed, she heard a noisy sound. Mia looked around and saw a boy playing a flute.
"Hi!" said Mia. "I like your flute. It is noisy, but fun!"
"Thank you!" said the boy. "My name is Tim. Do you want to play with me?"
Mia and Tim played with the flute together. They made lots of noisy music. Suddenly, a big bird flew down from the tree. The bird took the flute in its beak and flew away.
"Oh no!" said Tim. "The bird took my flute!"
Mia had an idea. She climbed the tree again and found the bird's nest. There, she saw many shiny things and the flute. Mia took the flute and gave it back to Tim.
"Thank you, Mia!" said Tim. "Now we can play noisy music together again!"
And from that day on, Mia and Tim became best friends who loved to play noisy music in the park.

Tom and Lily are friends. They like to play with cars and dolls. One day, they want to make a book with their drawings. They have paper and crayons, but they need a printer.
They ask Lily's mom for help. She says, "I have a printer in my office. You can use it, but you have to be careful. The printer has a driver. The driver tells the printer what to do. If you press the wrong button, the driver will get angry and the printer will not work."
Tom and Lily follow Lily's mom to her office. They see the printer on a table. It is big and black. It has many buttons and lights. Lily's mom shows them how to print. She says, "First, you put your paper in this tray. Then, you choose your drawing on the computer. Next, you click on this icon. It looks like a printer. Finally, you wait for the printer to print your drawing. It will come out from this slot."
Tom and Lily take turns to print their drawings. They are very happy. They see their cars and dolls on the paper. They say, "Thank you, mom. You are very nice. The printer is very smart. The driver is very good."
Lily's mom smiles. She says, "You are welcome, kids. You are very clever. The printer is very fast. The driver is very friendly. Now, you can make your book. You can use this stapler to bind your pages. But be careful, it is sharp. Do not hurt your fingers."
Tom and Lily make their book. They use the stapler to join their pages. They write their names on the cover. They are very proud. They say, "Look, mom. We made a book. It is very beautiful. We are very happy."
Lily's mom hugs them. She says, "I am very proud of you, too. You made a wonderful book. You are very creative. You are very happy. Do you want to read your book with me? We can sit on the couch. It is very comfortable."
Tom and Lily nod. They say, "Yes, mom. We want to read our book with you. We love you. We love our book. We love the printer and the driver. They are very helpful."
They go to the couch. They sit with Lily's mom. They read their book. They laugh and smile. They are very comfortable. They have a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a gentle cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to play with her toys. Her favorite toy was a small ball that she could tear with her claws.
One day, Fluffy was playing near the chimney. She saw a bird sitting on the chimney. The bird looked at Fluffy and said, "Hello, gentle cat! Do you want to play with me?" Fluffy was happy and wanted to play with the bird.
Fluffy and the bird played all day long. They played with the ball, and Fluffy did not tear it. When the sun went down, the bird said, "Goodbye, gentle cat! I had fun playing with you." Fluffy was sad to see her new friend go, but she knew they would play again another day.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a small lion named Leo. Leo was not like other lions. He was not big and strong, but he was very smart and kind. He had many friends in the forest.
One day, Leo and his friends were playing a game. They were playing with a ball. Leo liked to shoot the ball very high into the air. His friends would catch the ball and then shoot it back to him. They were all having a fun time.
Then, a big bird saw them playing and wanted to join. The bird picked up the ball and flew high into the sky. It dropped the ball, and Leo had to shoot the ball back up to the bird. They all laughed and played together. And even though Leo was a small lion, he was very happy because he had many friends who loved him.

Once upon a time, there was a big clock in the middle of the town. Everyone liked the clock because it helped them know when to eat, play, and sleep. One day, a little boy named Tom went to see the clock. He wanted to be careful not to break it.
As Tom got close to the clock, he saw a tiny bug. The bug was wearing a bow on its head. The bug said, "Hello, I am Buggy. I live inside the clock and help it work. Can you help me fix it? It is not working right." Tom was surprised to hear the bug talk but wanted to help.
Tom and Buggy worked together to fix the clock. They were very careful not to break anything. Finally, the clock started working again. Tom and Buggy were very happy. The people in the town thanked them and said, "You both showed us that even the smallest person can make a big difference." From that day on, Tom and Buggy became best friends and always helped each other.

Billy was so excited to go outside. His mom told him he could pick some radishes from the garden. So he grabbed the basket and ran to the garden.
Billy was amazed by the beautiful radishes. He grabbed some and put them in the basket. He was so excited that he ran back to the house.
But when he got back, it started to rain. The rain was so hard and it made the radishes wet. Billy tried to dry them, but it was too late. The radishes were ruined.
Billy cried and cried and his tears increased. He was so sad he couldn't have the radishes to eat. Billy was never as excited to pick radishes again.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely bicycle. It was red and shiny, but no one played with it. The bicycle wanted a friend to ride and have fun with.
One day, a little girl named Lily saw the lonely bicycle. She thought it was pretty and wanted to play with it. Lily asked her mom if she could ride the bicycle. Her mom said yes and helped her get on the bicycle.
As Lily rode the bicycle, she felt happy. The bicycle was happy too, because it had a friend. They both realized that they were not lonely anymore. They played together every day and had lots of fun. And the bicycle was never lonely again.

Once upon a time, there was a white bird. The bird could fly high in the sky. One day, the bird saw a big tree. The tree was near a small river. The bird liked the tree and wanted to live there.
The bird wanted to wash in the river. So, it flew down to the water. The bird splashed and played. It was so happy. But then, something unexpected happened. The bird saw a big fish in the river.
The big fish said, "I can help you wash better!" The bird was scared, but the fish was nice. The fish and the bird played in the water. They washed and splashed together. They became best friends. From that day on, the white bird and the big fish lived happily in the tree by the river.

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there lived a grumpy fairy. She was always unhappy and did not like to play with the other fairies. One day, a little boy came to the garden to play. He saw the grumpy fairy sitting alone and felt sad for her.
The little boy had a big, red balloon. He thought that maybe the grumpy fairy would be happy if he gave her the balloon. So, he went to the fairy and said, "Here, take my balloon. I hope it makes you smile." The grumpy fairy looked at the balloon and then at the little boy. She felt happy for the first time in a long time.
The grumpy fairy decided to release the balloon into the sky. As the balloon floated up, she started to smile. The other fairies saw her smiling and came to play with her. From that day on, the grumpy fairy was not grumpy anymore. She played and laughed with her new friends, all thanks to the little boy and his big, red balloon.

Once upon a time, there was a sailor named Sam. Sam liked to design boats. One day, Sam felt anxious because he wanted to make a new boat, but he did not know how.
Sam went to his friend, the wise old fish. "Fish, I want to design a new boat, but I don't know how. Can you help me?" Sam asked. The fish thought and said, "Yes, Sam, I can help you. Just follow my lead."
Sam and the fish started to work on the boat. They were almost done when something unexpected happened. The fish jumped on the boat and turned into a big, beautiful bird! Sam was so surprised. The bird said, "Thank you, Sam, for helping me. I was a bird stuck in a fish body, but your new boat set me free. Now I can fly again!" Sam was happy he could help his friend, and they both smiled as they finished the boat together.

Lily and Ben were playing in the snow. They made a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They gave him a carrot nose and two buttons for eyes. They were very happy with their snowman.
"Hello, Mr. Snowman!" Lily said. "You are very nice and humble. You do not say bad things or show off."
"Yes, you are a good friend," Ben said. "You do not mind the cold or the wind. You just smile and freeze."
But then, the sun came out. It was very bright and hot. The snow started to melt. Lily and Ben saw their snowman getting smaller and smaller.
"Oh no!" Lily cried. "Mr. Snowman is going away! He will be gone soon!"
"Quick, let's save him!" Ben said. "We can put him in the freezer. Then he will not melt."
They ran to the house with their snowman. They asked their mom if they could put him in the freezer. Their mom was surprised, but she said yes. She helped them wrap their snowman in a blanket and put him in the freezer.
"There, Mr. Snowman," Lily said. "Now you are safe and cold. You can stay with us for a long time."
"Thank you, Lily and Ben," their mom said. "You are very kind and humble. You care about your snowman and his feelings."
They hugged their mom and their snowman. They were very happy. They hoped their snowman would be happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was very excited because his uncle was coming to visit. Tim wanted to show his uncle all his toys and play with him all day.
The day before his uncle arrived, Tim's mom asked him to pack a bag full of toys to play with. Tim was happy to do it. He put his favorite cars, dolls, and blocks in the bag. He could not wait to show his uncle everything.
When his uncle came, they started to play. But Tim was embarrassed because he forgot to pack his favorite toy, a big red ball. His uncle saw Tim's sad face and said, "Don't worry, we can still have fun!" They played with the toys Tim packed, and had a great time. Tim learned that even if he forgot something, he could still have fun with his uncle.

One day, a little girl named Lucy woke up and went to the kitchen. She wanted to eat her favorite cereal for breakfast. But when she opened the cereal box, she found it was empty! "Oh no!" she said, "I need more cereal!"
Lucy put on her shoes and walked to the store. In the store, she saw a crazy man. The man was running around and making loud noises. Lucy was scared, but she knew she had to get her cereal. She grabbed the cereal box and went to the cashier. The crazy man was still running around, and Lucy was worried.
As Lucy paid for her cereal, the crazy man stopped running. He said, "I'm sorry for being loud. I just wanted to reverse my bad day." Lucy smiled and said, "That's okay. We all have bad days." The man thanked her and left the store. Lucy went home, happy to have her cereal and happy to have helped someone feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little bunny named Ben. Ben loved nature and liked to play outside with his friends. One day, Ben saw a big, pretty butterfly. He wanted to say "hi" but felt too shy.
Ben's friend, Sam the squirrel, saw Ben looking at the butterfly. Sam said, "Why don't you go say 'hi', Ben?" Ben was scared and said, "I am too shy, Sam. What if the butterfly does not like me?"
Sam told Ben, "Don't delay, just say 'hi' and be nice." Ben took a deep breath and hopped over to the butterfly. He said, "Hi, I am Ben. I like your pretty wings." The butterfly smiled and said, "Thank you, Ben. I like your soft fur." They became good friends and played together in nature all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She loved to sign her name on her drawings. One day, she drew a big sun with a smiley face. Sue was very happy with her drawing, so she signed her name at the bottom.
Sue had a friend named Tim. Tim saw Sue's drawing and felt envious. He wanted to sign his name on a drawing too. Sue saw that Tim was sad and had an idea. She took a crayon from her pocket and gave it to Tim.
Together, Sue and Tim drew a big tree with lots of leaves. Tim signed his name next to Sue's on the tree drawing. They both felt happy and proud of their work. From that day on, Sue and Tim loved to draw and sign their names on all their pictures.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the park with her mom. Mia wore a pink dress and her favorite pink shoes. She loved to play at the park. There was a big fountain in the park that Mia liked to look at.
Mia saw a boy named Tim near the fountain. Tim had a toy boat. Mia asked, "Can I play with your boat?" Tim said, "Yes, but be careful. The boat might go in the fountain."
They played with the boat near the fountain. The boat went fast on the ground. Mia was having fun. But then, the boat went too fast and fell into the fountain. Mia and Tim looked at each other, sad.
Mia's mom saw what happened. She walked over and took the boat out of the fountain. She gave the boat back to Tim and said, "Be careful next time." Mia and Tim were happy again. They played with the boat away from the fountain and had a great day at the park.

One day, a little girl named Lucy was very excited. She saw a beautiful pattern on a big butterfly. She wanted to draw the same pattern for her mom. But Lucy didn't know how to make the pattern.
Lucy went to her friend, Tom. She asked Tom, "Can you help me draw the butterfly pattern?" Tom said, "Yes, I can help you!" They both sat down with paper and colors.
Tom showed Lucy how to make the pattern. They drew big wings with many colors. They drew small circles and lines. Lucy was happy. She said, "Thank you, Tom!" Now, Lucy could give her mom a beautiful butterfly picture.

Once upon a time, there was a pale boy named Tim. Tim had a flute. He loved to play it all day. The flute made a nice sound. Tim was very happy.
One day, Tim saw a big cat. The cat stared at Tim. Tim stared back. He played his flute for the cat. The cat liked the sound. They became friends.
Then, something unexpected happened. The cat played the flute too! Tim was very surprised. They played the flute together and made beautiful music. Tim and the cat were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lily. She was an obedient girl who always listened to her mom and dad. One day, her mom told her to unpack her toys from the big box in her room.
As Lily unpacked her toys, she found a pretty, bouncy ball. It was very colorful and looked like it had a spring inside. She decided to go outside and play with it.
Lily went to the park and met a new friend named Tim. They played with the bouncy ball all day in the warm sun. They had so much fun with the ball that went high in the sky like a bird. At the end of the day, Lily and Tim said goodbye, and they promised to play together again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lisa. She had a soft, velvet dress that she loved to wear. One day, Lisa was getting ready to go to a friend's birthday party. She was so excited and ready to have fun.
As she got ready, she heard her mommy say, "Don't forget to bring a gift for your friend!" Lisa ran to her room and picked up a big, red ball. She knew her friend would love it.
At the party, Lisa played with her friends and ate yummy cake. She had a great time. When it was time to go home, she said to her friend, "I almost forgot! I have a gift for you!" She gave her friend the big, red ball, and they both smiled. Lisa was happy she didn't forget the gift, and her friend was happy too.

One day, a little blueberry was sitting on a bush. The blueberry was sad because it felt stupid. All the other berries were red and shiny, but this blueberry was blue and dull.
Then, a bunny came to the bush. It saw the little blueberry and wanted to eat it. The blueberry was scared and wanted to run away. But it could not run because it was just a berry.
The blueberry had an idea. It used all its power to spring off the bush. It jumped so high that the bunny could not catch it. The blueberry was happy because it was not stupid after all.
The blueberry fell back to the ground and rolled away from the bunny. It found a new bush to live on. The blueberry was proud and happy. It learned that even if you feel stupid, you can still do great things.

One day, a chubby duck named Bob went to the pond to swim. He put on his sunglasses to keep the sun out of his eyes. Bob loved to swim and play in the water with his friends.
While Bob was swimming, he saw something shiny at the bottom of the pond. He dove down and picked it up. It was a golden key! Bob was very excited and showed it to his friends.
Bob and his friends decided to look for a treasure chest that the key might open. They searched all around the pond, but they couldn't find any chest. Then, they saw a little girl crying. She had lost her key to her toy box. Bob gave the golden key to the girl, and it fit! The girl was so happy that she shared her toys with Bob and his friends. They all played together and had a great day.

One day, a boy named Tim wanted to read a book. He sat down and opened the book. He was very careful with the pages. Tim liked to read a lot.
While Tim was reading, he saw a bottle of glue. He thought it would be fun to play with the glue. Tim put glue on the edges of the book's pages. He thought it was funny.
But then, something unexpected happened. The glue made the pages stick together. Tim couldn't read the book anymore. He was sad that he couldn't read his favorite book. The story had a bad ending.

Anna and Ben are playing with scissors and paper. They like to cut shapes and make things. Anna cuts a star, a heart and a flower. Ben cuts a circle, a square and a triangle.
"Look, I made a lock!" Ben says. He shows Anna his paper lock. He cut a hole in the middle of the square and put the circle through it. "Now I can lock things!"
Anna thinks Ben's lock is cool. She wants to make one too. She cuts a hole in the middle of her flower and puts her star through it. "Now I have a lock too!" she says.
They look around for things to lock. They see a box, a book and a doll. They try to lock them with their paper locks. But the paper locks are too weak. They tear and fall off. The box, the book and the doll are still open.
Anna and Ben are sad. Their locks do not work. They want to lock things. They see a door. The door has a real lock. A metal lock. A strong lock.
"Let's lock the door!" Ben says. He takes the key from the lock and gives it to Anna. "You lock the door and I will hide the key!"
Anna nods. She puts the key in the lock and turns it. The door is locked. She hears a click. She gives the key back to Ben. Ben runs and hides the key under a pillow.
They laugh and clap. They locked the door. They are happy. They think they are clever.
But then they hear a voice. A loud voice. A angry voice. It is Mom.
"Anna! Ben! What have you done? Why did you lock the door? Where is the key? Open the door right now!" Mom says.
Anna and Ben are scared. They did not think of Mom. They did not think of the key. They do not know what to do. They look at each other. They look at the door. They look at the pillow.
They are in trouble.

One day, a little alligator named Ally went to play near the lake. Ally was very fragile and small. She loved to swim and splash in the water. She saw a big frog and wanted to be friends.
"Hi, frog!" said Ally. "Do you want to play with me?" The frog looked scared. He did not want to play with an alligator. He thought alligators were big and mean. So, the frog jumped away very fast.
Ally felt sad. She wanted to show the frog that she was nice. She saw a big net in the water. The frog was caught in the net! Ally knew she had to help him escape. She used her teeth to break the net.
The frog was free! He looked at Ally and said, "Thank you for helping me escape. You are a nice alligator. I want to be your friend." Ally was happy. She and the frog played in the water all day.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to watch films together. Today, they are watching a film about animals. They see lions, monkeys, birds and fish.
Sara says, "Look, Tom, the lion is eating a zebra. That is his food."
Tom says, "Yes, Sara, the lion is hungry. He needs food to be strong. But I do not like to eat zebra. I like to eat pizza."
Sara says, "Me too, Tom. Pizza is delicious. It has cheese and tomato and ham. Do you want to eat pizza after the film?"
Tom says, "Yes, Sara, I want to eat pizza with you. And we can have ice cream too. Ice cream is cold and sweet. What flavor do you like?"
Sara says, "I like chocolate ice cream. And you, Tom?"
Tom says, "I like vanilla ice cream. And I like sprinkles on top. They are colorful and crunchy."
Sara and Tom smile. They are happy. They like the film and they like pizza and ice cream. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She liked to play with her toy cars under the big tree in her yard. One sunny day, she saw a tiny bug under the tree. The bug was very rude and pinched her finger. Sue was sad and ran to her mom.
Her mom saw the pinch on Sue's finger and told her, "Don't worry, the bug was just scared. It didn't know you were a nice girl." Sue thought about it and decided to be kind to the bug next time.
The next day, Sue went back under the tree and saw the same bug. This time, she smiled and said, "Hi, bug! I won't hurt you." The bug didn't pinch her this time. Instead, it waved its little legs and seemed happy. Sue learned that being kind is better than being rude.

Once upon a time, there was a brown dog named Max. Max had a pink ball that he loved to play with. One day, Max's friend, a little girl named Lily, came to play with him.
"Max, let's play sack with your pink ball!" said Lily. Max wagged his tail and barked happily. They played sack with the pink ball, tossing it back and forth. They were having so much fun.
But then, the pink ball got stuck in a tree. Max and Lily were sad. They tried to get the ball back, but they couldn't reach it. Max looked at Lily and had an idea. He saw a big stick on the ground.
Max picked up the stick with his mouth and gave it to Lily. Lily used the stick to poke the pink ball out of the tree. The ball fell down, and Max caught it. They were so happy and played sack with the pink ball all day long.

One day, Tom and Sue were playing in their room. They had many toys, like dolls and cars. Tom was trying to build an enormous tower with his blocks. He wanted it to be very tall.
Suddenly, the floor started to shake. It was an earthquake! Tom and Sue were scared. They held hands and ran to their mom. "Mom, what is happening?" asked Tom.
Mom hugged them and said, "It's an earthquake, but don't worry. We will be safe." She took them outside, away from the big house. The earthquake stopped, and they were all safe.
Tom and Sue were happy that the earthquake was over. They went back to their room and saw the tower of blocks had fallen. "Let's try to build it again," said Sue. They worked together and built an even bigger tower. They were very proud of their work.

One day, a little boy named Tim was playing outside. He saw a big black rock. His mom said, "That is coal." Tim was very excited about the coal. He wanted to show it to his friend, Sam.
Tim ran to Sam's house. He was impatient to show Sam the coal. Tim knocked on the door. Sam came out and said, "What do you have?" Tim said, "I found coal!" Sam looked at the coal and said, "I want to play with it too!"
Tim and Sam played with the coal. Tim said, "I insist we take turns with the coal." Sam agreed. They took turns holding the coal. Suddenly, the coal began to shake. They were surprised. The coal turned into a friendly talking bird! The bird said, "Thank you for playing with me! I was stuck as coal, but your fun helped me change back!" Tim and Sam were happy to have a new bird friend.

Lily liked to jog with her dad every morning. They would put on their shoes and hats and go outside. They would jog around the park and see the birds and flowers. Lily felt happy and strong when she jogged with her dad.
One day, it was very cold outside. Lily saw white flakes falling from the sky. She had never seen them before. She asked her dad what they were. He said they were snowflakes. He said they were rare in their town. He said they were very pretty and soft, but they would melt if they touched something warm.
Lily wanted to touch the snowflakes. She reached out her hand and caught one. It felt cold and wet. She looked at it closely. It had a shape like a star. She thought it was beautiful. She wanted to keep it. She closed her hand around it and ran to show her dad.
But when she opened her hand, the snowflake was gone. There was only a drop of water on her palm. She felt sad and confused. She asked her dad what happened. He said the snowflake melted because her hand was warm. He said snowflakes were very special, but they could not last long. He said she had to enjoy them while they were there.
Lily understood. She smiled and hugged her dad. She said she was glad she saw the snowflakes. She said they were a gift from the sky. She said she would remember them always. Then she and her dad jogged back home, feeling the snowflakes on their faces.

Tom and Mia were playing hide and seek in their house. Tom was the seeker and Mia was the hider. Mia ran to her room and looked for a good spot. She saw her closet and opened the door. She saw a lot of clothes and toys inside. She thought it was a perfect place to hide. She crawled in and closed the door behind her.
Tom counted to ten and then shouted, "Ready or not, here I come!" He searched the living room, the kitchen, and the bathroom, but he could not find Mia. He went to her room and looked under the bed, behind the curtains, and in the drawers, but he still could not find her. He scratched his head and wondered where she was.
He heard a giggle from the closet. He smiled and walked to the closet. He opened the door and saw Mia sitting among the clothes and toys. She looked at him and said, "You found me!"
Tom said, "Yes, I did! You are a good hider, Mia. But you should not laugh when you hide. It can reveal your spot."
Mia said, "I know, I know. But I could not help it. It was fun to hide in the closet. There are so many things to see and touch."
Tom said, "Can I see too?" He crawled in the closet and joined Mia. They looked at the clothes and toys and played with them. They had a lot of fun in the closet.
They were humble children. They did not need fancy things to have fun. They just needed their imagination and each other. They were happy in the closet.

One day, a blue bird sat on a bookshelf. The bird looked out the window and saw it was going to rain. The bird told its friend, the cat, "Rain is coming, we should stay inside."
The cat looked at the bird and said, "I will find a game for us to play inside." The cat and the bird played with a ball and had fun. They played until they were tired and then they sat on the bookshelf together.
After some time, the rain stopped. The sun came out and made everything bright. The cat and the bird looked at each other and smiled. They knew they could now go outside and play in the sun. They were happy they had a fun time inside when it rained.

One day, a fine cat and a fine dog were playing in the yard. They saw a big barrel near the tree. The cat and dog were very curious about the barrel.
The cat said to the dog, "Let's go see what's inside the barrel!" The dog agreed, and they both went to the barrel. They looked inside, but it was too dark to see anything. The cat whispered to the dog, "Let's roll the barrel to let out what's inside."
So, the cat and the dog rolled the barrel. They rolled and rolled it until it hit a rock. The barrel opened and out came a lot of balls! The cat and the dog were so happy and surprised. They played with the balls all day long and had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a nice lady. She lived in a small house. The house was very comfortable. The lady had a big chair. She liked to sit in the chair and read books.
One day, it was very cold outside. The lady felt cold too. She went to her room and got a big, warm cover. She put the cover on her chair to make it more comfortable.
The lady sat in her chair with the cover. She felt warm and happy. Then, her friend came to visit her. Her friend saw the lady in the chair with the cover.
The friend said, "You look very comfortable with your cover."
The lady smiled and said, "Yes, I am. Do you want to sit with me?"
Her friend sat with her, and they shared the warm cover. They talked and laughed. They were very happy together.

John had a friend who was very ignorant. Everyday, John tried to teach her something new so she wouldn't be so ignorant. One day, John asked his friend, "Do you know what a person is?"
His friend frowned and said, "No, I don't know what a person is."
John smiled and then said, "A person is someone who has two arms, two legs, a head, and a heart. A person is someone who can think and feel."
His friend's face lit up with understanding. She said, "Oh, now I know what a person is! Thank you, John!"
John smiled. He was glad that his friend was no longer so ignorant.

Tom and Anna are twins. They like to play outside with their bikes. One day, they go to the park with Mom. Mom says, "Be careful and stay close to me."
Tom and Anna nod and ride their bikes on the path. They see a big hill and want to go down fast. Tom says, "Let's race to the bottom!" Anna says, "OK, ready, set, go!"
They pedal hard and zoom down the hill. But there is a rock on the path. Tom does not see it and hits it with his bike. He falls off and hurts his leg. He cries out loud. Anna stops and runs to him. Mom hears him and comes too.
Mom kneels down and looks at Tom's leg. It is bleeding and swollen. She says, "Oh no, Tom, you are hurt. We need to go to the doctor." She picks him up and puts him in the car. Anna follows with the bikes.
They go to the doctor. The doctor takes an x-ray of Tom's leg. He says, "Tom, you have a broken bone. You need a cast and crutches. You have to rest your leg for a long time. No more bike riding for a while."
Tom feels sad and scared. He does not like the cast and the crutches. He does not want to rest his leg. He wants to play with Anna and his bike. He says, "But I don't like it. It hurts and it's boring. I want to go home."
Mom says, "I know, Tom, but you have to do what the doctor says. It will get better soon. Anna and I will help you and play with you. Don't worry."
But Tom does worry. He is restless and unhappy. He misses his bike and the park. He thinks it is not fair. He wishes he never saw the rock. He wishes he never raced with Anna. He wishes he never went to the park. He wishes he never had a broken leg. He wishes he could go back in time and change everything. But he can't. He is stuck with his cast and his crutches and his pain. He thinks this is the worst day ever. He thinks this is a bad ending.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk. On his walk, he saw a big volcano. The volcano was very tall and had red, spicy smoke coming out of the top. Tim was a little scared, but he wanted to see what was inside the volcano.
As Tim got closer, he saw a friendly dragon living in the volcano. The dragon was red and had big wings. The dragon said, "Hi, my name is Dara. Do you want to play with me?" Tim was happy and said, "Yes, I want to play with you, Dara!"
Dara and Tim played near the volcano. They had lots of fun. Then, Dara offered Tim a spicy snack. It was a hot, red pepper. Tim tried the spicy snack and liked it. They both laughed and played until it was time for Tim to go home. Tim and Dara said goodbye and promised to play together again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a funny cat named Tom. Tom lived in a small house with his best friend, a little girl named Emma. They loved to play all day long.
One sunny day, Tom and Emma found a big watermelon. They wanted to eat it, but they didn't know how. So, Tom said, "Let's split it!" Emma nodded and they split the watermelon in half. Inside, they saw lots of yummy red fruit and zero seeds. They were very happy.
They ate the watermelon and laughed. Tom said, "This is the best day ever!" Emma agreed, and they played more games. From that day on, they always remembered the funny time they split the watermelon with zero seeds.

Once upon a time there was a mommy, a daddy and a baby. The baby was three years old.
One day, the mommy was making a big, fat salad. She used lots of yummy ingredients such as tomatoes, carrots and cucumbers. The baby saw it and his tummy began to grumble.
Mommy said to the baby: "Don't worry, I will give you some of the salad once it is finished!" The baby smiled.
The mommy warned the baby: "But remember, you must only eat a little bit or you will get too fat!" The baby nodded his head.
The mommy smiled at the baby and said: "I will remind you not to eat too much when I am ready to serve the salad." The baby nodded.
Soon, the salad was ready and the mommy served it. The baby was very happy and remembered not to eat too much.
The end.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient robot. The robot was very old and lived in a big house. The robot had many friends, but sometimes they would fight and separate.
One day, the robot's friends came to the house. They played with toys and had fun. But then, they started to fight over a toy. The robot said, "Please don't fight. We are friends, and friends should not separate."
The friends listened to the robot and stopped fighting. They said sorry to each other and shared the toy. They learned that it is better to be kind and share than to fight and separate.
The ancient robot and its friends played happily together. They never fought again and always shared their toys. The moral of the story is to be kind and share with others, so that you can stay happy with your friends.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, a bear and a rabbit. Every day they would go on different adventures and have lots of fun. One day, the bear had a great idea.
The bear said, "Let's get a mattress!"
The rabbit thought this was a wonderful idea and agreed. So off they went to get a mattress.
When they got to the mattress shop, the bear saw the most delicious mattress he had ever seen. It was big, fuzzy, and had rainbow stripes. He knew it was the one.
The bear and rabbit bought the mattress. On the way home, they stopped to get some delicious treats. They got ice cream, cookies, and candy.
When they finally reached home, they were so tired. So they spread out the new mattress, ate their treats, and took a nap. They had the most wonderful time.

Tom and Lily are twins. They like to play with blocks and cars and dolls. But they do not like to share. They always fight over the toys.
One day, Mom gives them a big cake. She says, "This is for both of you. You can cut it and eat it. But you have to be fair and nice."
Tom and Lily look at the cake. It is round and brown and has white cream on top. It smells good. They want to eat it.
But they do not agree on how to cut it. Tom says, "I want the big side. You can have the small side." Lily says, "No, I want the big side. You can have the small side."
They start to pull the knife. They yell at each other. "I hate you!" "No, I hate you more!"
Mom hears them. She is not happy. She comes to the kitchen. She sees the cake and the knife and the twins. She says, "Stop! What are you doing? You are being mean and greedy. You are not sharing. You are not being fair and nice."
She takes the knife and the cake. She says, "You do not deserve this cake. You have to learn to get along. You have to say sorry to each other. And you have to hug and kiss."
Tom and Lily feel bad. They do not want to lose the cake. They do not want to make Mom sad. They look at each other. They say, "Sorry." They hug and kiss.
Mom smiles. She says, "That's better. Now you can have the cake. But you have to cut it in half. And you have to eat it with a fork. And you have to say thank you."
Tom and Lily nod. They cut the cake in half. They see that the cake is thick and soft and yummy. They eat it with a fork. They say, "Thank you, Mom. Thank you, Tom. Thank you, Lily."
They are happy. They do not fight. They do not hate. They share. They are fair and nice.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to a big field. She saw a sweet bunny in the field. Lucy wanted to play with the bunny. But the bunny was scared and ran away. Lucy felt sad and started to wonder why the bunny didn't want to play with her.
Lucy tried to think of a way to make the bunny like her. She thought that maybe if she gave the bunny some sweet treats, it would want to play. So, Lucy went to her house and got some sweet carrots. She went back to the field and looked for the bunny.
When Lucy found the bunny, she gave it the sweet carrots. The bunny ate the carrots and started to like Lucy. They played together in the field and became good friends. The bunny was no longer scared of Lucy and they had fun every day.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a loyal dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his best friend, a little girl named Lily. They liked to run, jump, and laugh together. One sunny day, they went on an adventure to find a treasure.
As they walked through the forest, they saw a sharp rock. Spot was very careful not to step on it. Lily said, "Good job, Spot!" They kept walking and looking for the treasure. They looked under rocks, in trees, and by the river.
Finally, they found a big, shiny treasure box under a tree. Spot and Lily were so happy! They opened the box and found lots of toys and treats inside. They shared the treasure and played all day long. And from that day on, Spot and Lily knew that the best treasure of all was their loyal friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a lion who lived in the jungle. He was lazy and didn't want to move around much. One day, he heard a noise coming from the other side of the jungle.
The lion went to the noise and found a family of monkeys. They were dancing around and making so much noise. The lion watched for a while and then decided to join them.
He started to dance too! He hopped around and clapped his paws. The monkeys were so surprised to see the lion dancing, but they started to dance around him.
The lion danced for the rest of the afternoon. By the evening, he was so tired he couldn't dance anymore. He thanked the monkeys and went back to his home.
He was still lazy, but he was very happy. He had made some new friends and he had danced a lot. He smiled and thought about how much fun he had dancing with the monkeys.

Once there was a very cheerful boy named Timmy. He went to school every day and had lots of fun with his friends at the classroom. He loved exploring and playing with his friends in the classroom.
One day, his teacher told his class to record something. Timmy thought hard and decided he wanted to record the sound of his friends playing together. So he grabbed some paper and pen and ran to the classroom.
When he got to the classroom, he could hear lots of laughter and cheerfulness. He looked around and saw that all his friends were playing with toys and having a good time. He smiled and then held out his paper and pen and started recording.
He made sure to record everyone's laughs and smiles and cheerful conversations. After a few minutes, he was finished and he had a big smile on his face. He was so proud of his work and showed his teacher the recording he made.
His teacher was so impressed that she shared it with all the other classes in the school! Everyone in the school loved it and thought the recording was super cheerful!

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play with blocks and make towers. One day, they have a big bag of blocks to share. Anna wants to make the tallest tower ever. Ben wants to make a long bridge. They start to build their own things.
But Anna is not happy. She looks at Ben's bridge and feels jealous. She thinks his bridge is better than her tower. She wants to have his blocks too. She says to Ben, "Give me some of your blocks. I need more blocks for my tower."
Ben says, "No, these are my blocks. You have enough blocks for your tower. Go away."
Anna gets angry. She tries to grab some of Ben's blocks. Ben pushes her away. They start to fight. They pull and tug and shout.
Suddenly, they feel the ground shake. It is an earthquake. The blocks fall down. The tower and the bridge are gone. Anna and Ben are scared. They stop fighting. They hug each other. They say, "I'm sorry. I'm sorry."
They look at the mess of blocks. They feel sad. They have lost their tower and their bridge. They have no more blocks to play with. They wish they had not been jealous and mean. They say, "Let's be friends again. Let's share the blocks and make something new together."

Once upon a time, there was a naughty boy named Tim. He liked to run around and play with his toys. One day, he found a pair of scissors in his mom's room. Tim knew he should not play with scissors, but he did it anyway.
Tim went to his friend Sam's house. They were playing with their toys when Tim said, "Look what I have! Let's use the scissors to cut our toys." Sam was scared, but he didn't want Tim to call him a baby. So, they started cutting their toys with the scissors.
Soon, they heard Sam's mom coming. They tried to hide the scissors and the cut toys, but it was too late. Sam's mom saw the mess and was very angry. She said, "You boys were naughty and played with scissors. Now your toys are broken and you can't play with them anymore." Tim and Sam were sad because they didn't listen and now their toys were gone.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named John. John was three years old and he loved to talk. One day, John was walking in the park when he saw something bright and red. He got closer and discovered it was a big strawberry! He talked to the strawberry and asked if he could pick it.
The strawberry said yes, so John plucked it off of the bush and took a bite. The strawberry was delicious and sweet. It was so soft John felt like he was eating a cloud! He sat down and enjoyed the strawberry until it was finished.
John was glad he had talked to the strawberry because it was so delicious! He decided to find some more strawberries to eat. He was so excited!
John found four more strawberries. He talked to each of them and asked if he could pick them. After he had finished eating all five strawberries, John smiled with happiness.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a beautiful temple. Many people went to visit it every day. The temple was big and shiny, and it made everyone happy.
One day, a little girl named Lily went to the temple with her mom. They walked and talked, and Lily was very obedient. She held her mom's hand and stayed close. When they got to the temple, Lily's mom pointed at the temple's door and said, "Look, Lily! That's the temple we came to see!"
Lily looked at the temple and smiled. She pointed at the temple too and said, "Mom, it's so big and pretty!" They went inside and saw many nice things. They had a great time together at the temple.

Ben and Sam like to play football in the park. They have a big ball that is red and white. They kick the ball to each other and try to score goals. Sometimes they miss and the ball goes high in the air.
One day, they see a man with a hose. He is spraying water on the flowers and the grass. The water makes a rainbow in the sun. Ben and Sam think it is pretty. They run to the man and say hello.
"Hello, boys. Do you like the water?" the man asks.
"Yes, we do. It is cool and wet," Ben says.
"Can we play with the hose?" Sam asks.
"Sure, but be careful. Don't spray the water on people or cars," the man says. He gives them the hose and smiles.
Ben and Sam take turns to hold the hose. They spray the water on the ball and make it wet and slippery. They spray the water on the ground and make it muddy and fun. They spray the water on each other and laugh and scream.
They have a lot of fun with the hose and the ball. They forget about the time and the goals. They only care about the spray and the splash. They are happy and wet.

Once upon a time, there was a big room with a blackboard. The blackboard was very high on the wall. Many kids came to the room to learn and have fun. They liked to draw on the blackboard with colorful chalk.
One day, a small girl named Lily wanted to draw on the blackboard too. But she was not tall enough to reach it. She felt sad and asked her friends for help. They had a good idea to help Lily gain height.
Her friends found a big box for Lily to stand on. Now, Lily was high enough to reach the blackboard. She was very happy and drew a big sun with a smiley face. All the kids clapped and cheered for Lily. They all had fun drawing on the blackboard together.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim liked to fly around and find things. One day, he found a small, shiny twig. It was so pretty that he took it to his nest.
Tim had a nosy friend, the squirrel named Sam. Sam saw the shiny twig and wanted it too. So, when Tim went to find food, Sam took the twig and ran away. Tim came back and saw that the twig was gone. He felt very sad.
Tim looked and looked for the shiny twig. He asked his friends if they saw it. They told him that Sam took it. Tim went to Sam's tree and asked him to return the twig. Sam felt bad and gave it back. Tim was happy to have his shiny twig again. From that day on, Sam learned not to take things that were not his, and they both became better friends.

Once upon a time, there was a cheap toy comet. The comet was sad because no one wanted to play with it. The comet had a dream to build a big, fun house for all the toys to play in.
One day, the comet met a big, strong toy truck. The comet asked the truck to help build the house. The truck said, "You are too cheap and small. I will not help you." This made the comet very sad.
The comet tried to build the house all by itself. It worked very hard, but the house fell down. The other toys laughed at the comet. The comet was so sad that it flew far away and never came back.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was very enthusiastic and loved to ask questions. One day, he found a big tube in his backyard. He was very excited and wanted to know what was inside it.
Tim asked his mom, "What is in the tube?" His mom didn't know the answer. So, Tim decided to open the tube and find out. He pulled and pulled, but the tube just wouldn't open. He was about to give up when he heard a small voice say, "I can help you!"
Tim looked around and saw a tiny bug. The bug said, "I know the answer to open the tube. Just say 'please open' and the tube will open." Tim was surprised that the bug could talk, but he was happy to have help. So, he said, "Please open."
The tube opened, and out came a big, colorful ball. Tim was so happy to have a new toy. He played with the ball all day long. And from that day on, Tim and the talking bug became best friends. They had many fun adventures together and always helped each other when they needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside in the open yard with his toys. One day, Tim found some big equipment in the yard. It was a shovel and a bucket.
Tim decided to use the equipment to bury his toys in the dirt. He dug a big hole with the shovel and put his toys in the hole. Then, he covered the hole with dirt. Tim felt happy because he had made a secret hiding spot for his toys.
Later, Tim wanted to play with his toys again, but he couldn't find them. He forgot where he had buried them. Tim felt sad and cried. His mom came outside and helped him find the toys. They dug up the toys together. Tim learned that it is important to remember where you put things and to not hide them too well. From that day on, Tim always kept his toys in an open box, so he could find them easily.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big calendar on her wall. The calendar had many different colors. Lily liked to look at the pictures and learn the days.
One day, Lily's mom said, "We will go to the park next week." Lily was very happy. She asked, "Mom, can I mark the calendar?" Her mom said, "Yes, you can." Lily took a red pen and marked the day on the calendar.
Each day, Lily looked at the calendar. She saw the red mark and knew the park day was coming. When the day came, Lily and her mom went to the park. They had lots of fun. Lily was glad she marked the calendar.

Once upon a time in a far away land, there lived a little girl named Lilly. Lilly loved to go on adventurous journeys.
One day Lilly decided to go explore the forest. As she stepped into the forest, she noticed lots of berry bushes. She was so excited to see all of the different kinds of berries.
She went over to the berry bushes and began to pick the biggest and juiciest berries. She was very careful not to pick too many though, so the animals could enjoy them too.
As she finished picking the berries, it started to rain. Lilly needed to find a place to cover up with. She looked around, but it was difficult!
Luckily, she found a big tree to cover her up. She ran over to it and hugged it tightly. The rain stopped and Lilly smiled. She was so happy she found a place to cover up and eat her yummy berries.

Once upon a time, in a big, big forest, there was a tall, tall tree. This tree was so high that all the animals could see it from far away. The tree was home to many small things like birds and bugs. They all loved living in the high tree.
One day, a little bird named Tim wanted to fly very high. He told his friend, Sam the squirrel, "I want to fly high up in the sky today!" Sam said, "Wow! That sounds fun. I will cheer for you!" So, Tim started to flap his wings and flew higher and higher. All the other animals in the forest watched him and started to clap their hands and paws.
As Tim flew higher, everyone began to applaud. They were so happy for him. Tim felt proud and smiled as he flew. When he came back down, all the animals hugged him and said, "Good job, Tim! You flew so high!" Tim was very happy and thanked all his friends for cheering for him. From that day on, Tim and his friends always cheered each other on when they tried new things.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. It was a cold, icy day, but Tim wanted to play outside. At noon, they got to the park and Tim saw his friend, Sam.
"Hi Sam!" Tim said. "It's so icy today!" Sam said, "Yes, but I like it!" They played on the slide and swings, but did not complain about the cold.
Then, something unexpected happened. A big, warm sun came out and all the ice melted away. Tim and Sam were very happy. They played in the park all day, and never complained about the cold again.

One day, a baby and a dog were playing in the park. They were having a lot of fun. The baby was laughing and the dog was barking.
Suddenly, the baby saw a big red ball. The baby wanted to play with the ball. The dog wanted to play too. They both rush to the ball, but the dog got there first. The baby was sad.
The dog saw the baby was sad and felt sorry. The dog gave the ball to the baby. They both played with the ball and were happy again. They played in the park until the sun went down.

One day, a little cat named Tom went for a walk. He saw a big rail near his home. He wanted to walk on the rail, but his mom said, "No, Tom! It is not safe!"
Tom did not listen. He went to the rail and tried to walk on it. A big dog named Max saw Tom. Max was terrible and liked to chase cats. Max said, "I will catch you, little cat!"
Tom was scared. He tried to run, but he could not. He was stuck on the rail. He called for help, but no one came. He thought about what his mom said and knew he should have listened.
Then, a big bird named Sue saw Tom. Sue was kind and wanted to help. She flew down and picked Tom up. She took him away from the rail and the terrible dog. Tom was safe and happy. He thanked Sue and promised to listen to his mom from now on.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Fin. Fin lived in a deep part of the sea. He liked to swim around and play with his friends. One day, Fin saw a beautiful sunset. The sky was full of pretty colors like red, orange, and pink. He wanted to see more sunsets, but they only happened when it was time for bed.
That night, Fin had a dream. In his dream, he swam up to the top of the sea and saw the sunset again. It was even more beautiful than before. Fin was so happy that he could see the sunset in his dream. He swam and played with his friends under the colorful sky.
When Fin woke up, he told his friends about his dream. They all wished they could see the sunset too. So, they all decided to swim up to the top of the sea just before bedtime. Together, they saw the beautiful sunset and played under the colorful sky. From that day on, Fin and his friends would always watch the sunset before going to sleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to walk in her garden every day. One day, she found a big, round thing in the ground. It was a bulb! Lily was very happy.
Lily felt a little anxious. She wanted the bulb to grow into a beautiful flower. So, she took care of the bulb every day. She gave it water and talked to it. She told the bulb, "Please grow big and strong, so we can see your pretty colors."
One morning, Lily walked to the garden and saw a surprise. The bulb had grown into a tall, lovely flower. It was red and yellow, and it smelled sweet. Lily was so happy and not anxious anymore. She walked in her garden every day, looking at her pretty flower and smiling.

One day, Tom and his dog, Spot, went for a walk in the park. It was getting dark, so Tom carried a flashlight. They saw a big tree and wanted to see what was behind it.
As they walked around the tree, they found a little bird. The bird was angry because it could not fly. Tom and Spot wanted to help the bird, so they thought of a plan.
Tom used the flashlight to find a soft nest for the bird. Spot carried the bird to the nest very carefully. The bird was happy now and not angry anymore. Tom and Spot went home, smiling because they had helped a friend.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play outside. He saw his friend, Sam, and they decided to play in the clean mud near the big tree. They loved to make mud pies and get dirty.
Tim said, "I hate silence when we play." So, they laughed and talked loudly while making their mud pies. They were having so much fun that they didn't notice the dark clouds coming.
Soon, it started to rain very hard. Tim and Sam tried to hide under the tree, but they still got wet. The rain washed away their mud pies, and they felt sad. They wished they had gone inside when they saw the dark clouds.
As they walked home, Tim said, "I don't like the rain. It ruined our fun day." Sam agreed and they both went to their houses, feeling sad about their bad day.

Once upon a time, there was a tall tower in a big field. A small boy named Tim lived near the tower. One day, Tim went to the tower to pick some flowers for his mom.
As Tim picked the flowers, he heard a loud noise. He was frightened. "Who is there?" Tim asked. A big, friendly bear came out from behind the tower. "Hi, I am Ben the bear," he said.
Tim was not frightened anymore. He and Ben the bear became good friends. They played in the field and picked more flowers together. And that was the start of a fun and unexpected friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had an incredible toy that could turn into anything he wanted. One day, he turned his toy into a big cup.
Tim's friend, Sam, came over to play. "Wow!" said Sam. "That is a big cup! Can I play with it too?" Tim smiled and said, "Of course! Let's share and have fun together."
So, they decided to split the cup in half. Now, they each had a piece of the incredible cup. They played together all day long, having so much fun with their new toy. And from that day on, Tim and Sam were always happy to share their toys with each other.

Mommy was baking in the kitchen. She had a bowl of dough on the table and smiled when she saw it.
"Is it time to make some cookies, Mommy?" asked a little girl. She was three years old and her name was Grace.
"Yes!" replied Mommy. "Let's make something special!"
Grace was so excited to help. She began to stretch and shape the dough into star shapes, a bright smile on her face.
Mommy and Grace took the tray of cut-out stars to the oven. Mommy opened the door and spring the stars onto the tray.
Mommy and Grace sat and watched as the stars cooked in the oven. In minutes, the kitchen was filled with the smell of warm, freshly-baked cookies. They had become bright and golden.
Mommy and Grace couldn't wait to take the cookies out of the oven and eat them. They both agreed they were delicious!

Once upon a time, there was a bee named Buzz who lived in a hive with all her bee friends. Each day, Buzz and her bee friends would fly around the meadow and try to find the sweetest flowers.
One day, while they were flying, they noticed a big yellow flower. It was huge and the bees were curious. So, they decided to try to get some of the sweet nectar from the flower.
The bees hovered around the flower, but it suddenly started to get dark outside. Buzz said to the other bees, "It's getting late, time to head back!" They all flew back to the hive, but not before Buzz said, "Let's come back here again tomorrow and try again!"
The next day, the bee friends returned to the big yellow flower. All of the bees quickly put their buzzers to work and tried their hardest to get the nectar from the flower. After many tries, Buzz finally managed to get the nectar out of the flower.
From then on, Buzz and her bee friends would go to the flower each day and try to get the nectar out. It became a regular happening for them and they even started sharing the nectar with other insects in the flower meadow.
In the end, Buzz and her bee friends were very happy and had a lot of fun!

One day, a helpful dog named Spot saw a little girl named Jane. Jane was playing a sport called catch. She was trying to throw a ball, but she was struggling.
"Can you help me?" Jane asked Spot. Spot wagged his tail and said, "Yes, I can help you."
Spot showed Jane how to throw the ball better. They played catch together and had lots of fun. Jane was happy that Spot was helpful, and they became good friends.

One day, a young girl named Mia decided to explore a forest near her house. As she was walking, she saw a tall crane stretching its long neck up to the sky. Mia was excited and decided to stretch her arms up and join the crane. She felt safe and secure with the friendly crane.
Mia and the crane played for hours until the sun started to set. The crane flew away back to its nest and Mia ran home. She went to bed feeling happy and safe from her day in the forest.
Mia dreamed of exploring more and began to plan her next adventure.

Once there was a lively pup named Spot. Spot liked to run around and explore the world. One day, Spot was running around and he got very tired. He decided to rest for a while in a corner but he soon realised he had been there for way too long.
Spot felt sad, so he started looking around for something to do. Suddenly, he saw a group of people working on a building. They were fixing the walls and making it look new again. Spot was curious to see what was happening, so he went closer.
The workers were doing an amazing job and Spot could see that they were restoring the building. Spot saw a man wearing glasses, he was pointing at things and giving instructions. Spot learned that he was a teacher and that all the people working around him were his pupils.
The teacher was very lively and his pupils followed his instructions carefully. Spot couldn't believe his eyes, he was so happy to see the building being restored. Spot stayed and watched until the building was completely restored. When that happened, everyone cheered and Spot knew that the world could be a better place.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Alex. One day, Alex wanted to be a superman and he put on dad’s cape and ran around the house. Suddenly, he stopped at the kitchen. He opened the cupboard and saw a bottle of oil inside.
He asked his dad, “Can I play with this?”
Dad said, “Yes, but don’t forget to put it back when you’re done.”
Alex took the bottle of oil and ran around. He was so busy playing he forgot to put the oil back.
The next morning, Alex decided to play superman again. But when he opened the cupboard, he saw a mess. The oil had spilled everywhere and it was very soft.
Dad was angry and said, “You should not forget things like this. Now, we have to clean up this mess.”
Alex was so sorry and he was scared of his dad. He started to cry.
That was when Alex learnt that if he does not follow dad’s instructions, bad things will happen.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly rabbit named Bob. Bob loved to hop and play in the big field near his home. Every day, he would run and jump with his friends, the birds, the bugs, and the other rabbits.
One day, while playing, Bob found a big box in the field. He called his friends to come and see. They all gathered around the box, wondering what was inside. Bob, being a brave rabbit, decided to open the box and reveal what was inside.
To their surprise, the box was filled with yummy treats for all the animals. They all shared the treats and had a big party. The unexpected gift made them very happy. The moral of the story is that sharing with friends can bring joy and happiness to everyone.

Once, there was a nice truck. It could provide lots of things to people. It was a very useful truck.
One day, the truck was taking things to a big building. Suddenly, the truck stopped working. It couldn't provide anymore.
The people were very sad that the truck had stopped. They needed it to provide things to the building.
After trying to fix it, the people saw that the truck couldn't be fixed. They had to get a new truck to provide for the building.
It was a sad ending for the truck. But it was a good thing that now the people could get a new truck to provide them with things.

Once upon a time, there was a bright sun in the sky. A little bird named Timmy lived in a tree. Timmy was very happy.
One day, a big hurricane came. The wind blew hard and fast. Timmy was scared. He screamed, "Help me, please!"
A kind squirrel named Sally heard Timmy's scream. She ran to him and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. I will help you." Sally took Timmy to a safe place in the tree. The wind stopped, and the sun came back.
Timmy said, "Thank you, Sally. You are a good friend." They played together in the bright sun, happy and safe.

One day, a boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went for a walk. They saw a long trail in the park. Tim said, "Let's go, Spot!" They walked on the trail, and the sun was up in the sky. The trail was very long, but Tim and Spot were not tired.
As they walked, they saw a dull, old box on the side of the trail. Tim said, "What's this, Spot?" Tim pulled the box open. Inside the box, they found a big, red ball. Tim and Spot were very happy.
Tim threw the ball, and Spot ran to catch it. But when Spot picked up the ball, it started to talk! The ball said, "Hello, I am a magic ball!" Tim and Spot were very surprised. They played with the magic ball all day and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue. Sue liked to write her name on paper. One day, she found a soft veil. She thought it was pretty and wanted to show her mom.
Sue took the soft veil and went to find her mom. She saw her mom in the kitchen. "Mom, look what I found!" said Sue. Her mom smiled and said, "It's very nice, Sue!"
Sue went back to her room and had an idea. She wanted to write her name on the soft veil. She found a pen and wrote "Sue" on the veil. She was very happy and proud of her work.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Lily and her brown dog, Max. They loved to play outside together. One sunny day, they went to the park to have fun.
At the park, Lily found a big brush under a tree. She picked it up and said, "Max, let's use this brush to paint!" Max barked happily, and they started to paint on the ground. They made pretty pictures with the brush.
As they painted, a soft wind blew. Lily had an idea. She took off her scarf and said, "Max, let's wrap the brush in my scarf and make it a toy!" Max wagged his tail and barked, "Woof, woof!" Lily wrapped the brush in her scarf and they played with it all day long.
When it was time to go home, Lily and Max took the wrapped brush with them. They had a lot of fun at the park, and now they had a new toy to play with at home. They couldn't wait for their next adventure together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lisa. She had a wardrobe in her bedroom, and every day she liked to choose a special dress to wear.
One day, Lisa noticed her bedroom door was open. Her nosy little brother Jake was peering into her room. Lisa shouted,"Jake! What are you doing?"
Jake said,"I'm looking at your wardrobe! Can I choose a dress?"
Lisa frowned and said,"No, this is my special wardrobe. You can't choose!"
Jake said,"Please, Lisa - can I just choose one dress? Please?"
Lisa thought for a moment. Finally, she said,"Ok, one dress. But that's all! You can't choose anything else."
Jake was so excited, he ran towards the wardrobe and chose the brightest dress. He smiled, and Lisa smiled too. And they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big subway train. The subway would rock back and forth as it moved. One day, a rare bird flew into the subway. The bird was lost and scared. People on the subway saw the bird and knew it was special.
The rare bird liked the rocking of the subway. It made the bird feel safe. The people on the subway would watch the bird as they rode. They knew that the bird was not from around here. They wanted to help the bird find its way back home.
One day, a kind man on the subway saw the rare bird. He knew where the bird was from. He took the bird off the subway and back to its home. The bird was so happy to be back. The people on the subway missed the bird, but they were happy that it was home. And the subway kept rocking back and forth, just like always.

One day, a little boy named Tim was sad. He did not want to go to a talk called a lecture with his mom. Tim wanted to play with his toys.
His mom said, "Tim, we have to go to the lecture. It is important, but I promise we can play after." Tim agreed, but he was still sad.
At the lecture, a funny clown appeared! The clown made everyone laugh. Tim was not sad anymore. After the lecture, Tim and his mom played with toys and had a great day.

One day, a dog named Spot went for a walk. He saw a big red box on the street. It was a mail box. Spot was glad because he liked to look at the mail box.
As Spot was looking at the mail box, he saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was walking with her mom. Spot went to meet Sue. Sue was happy to meet Spot, too. They said "hi" to each other.
Sue and Spot played near the mail box. They had fun running and jumping. Then, it was time for Sue to go home. Spot and Sue said "bye" to each other. Spot was glad he met Sue by the mail box.

One day, a little boy named John was playing in his garden. He saw a puzzle scattered across the floor. It looked so organized! He wanted to try it out.
John was so excited, he immediately got started. But in the middle of solving the puzzle, he heard a loud noise. It scared him!
John ran to his mother and said, "Mama, what was that noise?"
Mama laughed and said, "Aww, don't worry, that was just a bird chirping. You can go back and finish your puzzle. But make sure you don't scare the bird away!"
John smiled and ran back to his puzzle. He carefully placed the pieces together and soon he had finished the puzzle. John was so proud that he had made a big organized puzzle all by himself!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Poppy. She was a fearful girl who lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy. One day, she went outside to play with her friends, but she couldn't find them.
Poppy walked around, looking for her friends. She saw a big tree and thought her friends might be behind it. But when she looked, she only found a little boy who was also fearful. "Hi, I'm Poppy. What's your name?" she asked. "I'm Tim," said the little boy.
Poppy and Tim decided to play a game together. They played "match," where they had to find two things that looked the same. They found matching leaves, rocks, and even bugs. They had so much fun that they forgot they were fearful. And from that day on, Poppy and Tim were best friends.

One day, a funny bunny named Bob went outside to play. He saw a big sand castle. It was so big that Bob wanted to destroy it. So, he hopped and hopped, and then he jumped on the castle.
When Bob destroyed the castle, there was dust everywhere. The dust was all over Bob's face and body. He sneezed and laughed because it tickled.
Bob's friends, a dog and a cat, came to see what happened. They laughed too because Bob looked so funny with dust all over him. They all played together, making more sand castles and destroying them. They had a great day playing in the dust.

Once upon a time, there was a creative mole. The mole lived in a small hole in the ground. He liked to make things with his hands, like toys and pictures. He had many friends who liked to play with the toys he made.
One day, a big cat came to the mole's home. The cat wanted to catch the mole and his friends. The mole did not want to give up, so he thought of a plan. He told the cat, "If you do not catch us, we will give you a toy."
The big cat thought about it and said, "Okay, I will not catch you. Show me the toy." The creative mole made a toy for the cat. The cat liked the toy very much and decided to surrender. The mole and his friends were safe.
From that day on, the mole and his friends lived happily. They played with the toys the mole made and had lots of fun. The big cat became their friend too and they all played together. The mole's creative toys made everyone happy.

Sam and Lily are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big pond with ducks. They want to feed the ducks. They have some bread.
They go near the pond. They throw some bread to the ducks. The ducks come closer. They make loud noises. Sam and Lily laugh. They think the ducks are funny.
Sam sees a big duck with a green head. He likes the duck. He wants to kiss the duck. He thinks the duck will like him. He moves closer to the duck. He puts his face near the duck's beak.
But the duck does not like Sam. The duck is angry. The duck thinks Sam is trying to take his bread. The duck bites Sam's nose. Sam screams. He feels pain. He feels blood. He feels wet.
Lily hears Sam scream. She looks at Sam. She sees his nose. She sees the blood. She sees the wet. She is scared. She cries. She runs away. She leaves Sam alone.
Sam is sad. He is hurt. He is wet. He is alone. He wishes he did not kiss the duck. He wishes he had Lily. He wishes he could go home. He learns a hard lesson. He will never kiss a duck again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a small toy named Peanut. Peanut was a clean, happy toy. They played together every day.
